Lye limu ku ago abantu ge batafaako nnyo. Yesu yayogera nti, “Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima, ate Kitange ye mulimi.” Tetulina ye yekka, Omwana wa Katonda agulumiziddwa, mu bujjuvu bwe obw’obwakatonda, mwe tuyinza okusena okuva mu bujjuvu bw’obulamu bwe n’ekisa kye,—kino kya kitalo nnyo,—naye waliwo ekintu ekirala eky’omukisa n’okusingawo. Tulina Kitaffe, ng’Omulimi, alabirira okubeera kwaffe mu Muzabbibu, okukula kwaffe n’okubala kwaffe ebibala. Okukuuma okwegatta kwaffe ne Kristo tekulekeddwa ku kukkiriza kwaffe oba ku bwesigwa bwaffe: Katonda, Kristo gw’ayita Kitange, era eyatugatta naye,—Katonda yennyini ajja kulaba nti ettabi liba nga bwe lisaanidde okuba, ajja kutusobozesa okubala ebibala ddala bye twateekerwawo okubala. Wulira Kristo bye yayogera ku kino: “Buli ttabi eribala ebibala, alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala.” Kitaffe anoonya ebibala ebisingawo; era Kitaffe yennyini ajja kuleeta ebibala ebisingawo. Kino kye kimuleetera, ng’Omulimi w’emizabbibu, okulongoosa amatabi. Lowooza akaseera katono kino kye kitegeeza. Kigambibwa nti mu bimera byonna ebibala ebibala ku nsi, tewali kibala bibala ebijjudde omwenge omuka bwe bityo, era okuva mu byo omwenge omuka mwe guyinza okusogolwa mu bungi bwe butyo, ng’omuzabbibu. Era mu bimera byonna ebibala ebibala, tewali kyanguyirwa nnyo okukulamu emiti egy’omu nsiko egitaliiko bibala, era kye kyetaagisa ennyo okusalirwa n’okulongoosebwa, ng’omuzabbibu. Omulimu omunene ogumu omulimi w’emizabbibu gw’alina okukolera ettabi buli mwaka kwe kulisalira. Ebimera ebirala biyinza okumala ekiseera nga tebisaliddwa, ate ne bibala ebibala: omuzabbibu gulina okusalirwa. Noolwekyo ekintu kimu ettabi eryagala okubeera mu Kristo n’okubala ebibala bingi, n’okusobola okusaba buli kye lyagala, kye lirina okukola, kwe kwesiga n’okwewaayo eri okulongoosa kuno okw’obwakatonda. Kiki omulimi w’emizabbibu ky’asalako n’akambe ke ak’okusalira? Tewali kirala wabula omuti ettabi gwe lyakuza—omuti omutuufu era ogw’amazima, ogulimu obutonde bw’omuzabbibu ow’amazima. Guno gulina okusalibwako. Lwaki? Kubanga gusika amaanyi n’obulamu bw’omuzabbibu, era guziyiza omubisi okukulukutira mu zabbibu. Gye gukoma okusalibwa, omuti gye gukoma okukendeera mu ttabi, n’omubisi gwonna gye gukoma okuyinza okugenda mu zabbibu. Omuti gw’ettabi gulina okukendeera, ebibala by’omuzabbibu biryoke byeyongere; mu kugondera etteeka ly’obutonde bwonna, nti okufa lye kkubo erituusa ku bulamu, nti amagoba gajjira mu ssaddaaka, okukula okw’omuti okungi era okw’amaanyi kulina okusalibwako ne kusuulibwa, obulamu obusingawo obungi bulyoke bulabikire mu kirimba ky’ebibala. Bw’otyo, ggwe omwana wa Katonda, ettabi ly’Omuzabbibu ow’omu ggulu, mu ggwe mulimu ekirabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi era nga kikkirizibwa ddala, naye ate nga kisika nnyo okwagala kwo n’amaanyi go, ne kiba nti kirina okusalibwako n’okulongoosebwako. Twalaba obuyinza mu kusaba abasajja nga Ibulayimu ne Musa ne Eriya bwe baalina, era tumanyi ebibala bye baabala. Naye era tumanyi ekyo kye baasasula; engeri Katonda gye yalina okubaawula ku bibeetoolodde, n’okubasikanga buli kiseera okuva ku kwesiga kwonna mu bo bennyini, banoonye obulamu bwabwe mu ye yekka. Okwagala kwaffe ffe kennyini, n’amaanyi gaffe, n’okufuba kwaffe, n’essanyu lyaffe, ne bwe biba nga birabika nga bya butonde era nga tebiriimu kibi, bwe binaasalibwako, amaanyi gonna ag’obuntu bwaffe ne gaba nga ga ddembe era nga gaggule okufuna omubisi gw’Omuzabbibu ow’omu ggulu, Omwoyo Omutukuvu, olwo lwe tunaabala ebibala bingi. Mu kuwaayo ebyo obutonde bye bunywezezza, mu kugonda okujjuvu era okw’omwoyo omumalirivu eri akambe akatukuvu aka Katonda ak’okusalira, mwe tunaatuukira ku ekyo Kristo kye yatulondera era kye yatuteekerawo—okubala ebibala, buli kye tunaasaba Kitaffe mu linnya lya Kristo alyoke atuwe. Akambe ako ak’okusalira kye ki, Kristo atubuulira mu lunyiriri oluddirira. “Mmwe kaakano muli balongoofu olw’ekigambo kye mbagambye.” Nga bw’ayogera oluvannyuma nti, “Obatukuze mu mazima; ekigambo kyo ge mazima.” “Ekigambo kya Katonda … kisala okusinga ekitala eky’obwogi obubiri, era kiyitamu ne kituukira ddala ku mmeeme n’omwoyo.” Ebigambo Kristo bye yali agambye abayigirizwa be byali bikebera nnyo omutima: ku kwagala n’obwetoowaze, ku kuba asembayo, era, nga ye bw’ali, omuweereza wa bonna, ku kwefiiriza, n’okwetikka omusaalaba, n’okufiirwa obulamu. Okuyita mu kigambo kye, Kitaffe yali abalongoosezza, ng’asazeeko okwesiga kwonna mu bo bennyini oba mu nsi, n’abateekateeka okuyingirwa n’okujjuzibwa Omwoyo w’Omuzabbibu ow’omu ggulu. Si ffe tuyinza okwerongoosa: Katonda ye Mulimi w’emizabbibu: tuyinza okwewaayo mu mikono gye nga tuli bagumu. Ab’oluganda abaagalwa,—abasumba, abaminsani, abasomesa, abakozi, abakkiriza abakadde n’abato,—munakuwala olw’obutasaba kwammwe, era, ekiddirira, olw’obutaba na buyinza mu kusaba? Ai! mujje muwulirize Mukama wammwe omwagalwa ng’abagamba nti, “mubeere matabi bubeezi, ageegatta ku Muzabbibu ow’omu ggulu era agafuuse kimu nagwo, era okusaba kwammwe kujja kubeera kwa maanyi era kubeere n’obuyinza bungi.” Munakuwala nti kino kyennyini kye kizibu kyammwe—temubeera, temusobola kubeera, mu bulamu buno obw’ettabi, nga mubeera mu ye? Ai! mujje muwulirize nate. “Ebibala ebisingawo” si kye mwagala mmwe mwokka, naye ne Kitaffe kye yagala. Ye Mulimi alongoosa ettabi eribala ebibala, lyeyongerenga okubala. Mwesuule ku Katonda, akole mu mmwe ekitayinzika eri abantu. Mwesigame ku kulongoosa okw’obwakatonda, okusalako n’okuggyawo okwesiga kwonna n’okufuba kwonna okw’omuntu ku bubwe, ebibadde ensonga y’okulemererwa kwammwe. Katonda eyabawa Omwana we omwagalwa okuba Omuzabbibu gwammwe, eyabafuula amatabi ge, talikola mulimu gwe ogw’okulongoosa, okubafuula ab’okubala ebibala mu buli mulimu omulungi, ne mu mulimu gw’okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala? Buno bwe bulamu obuyinza okusaba. Ettabi eryewaddeyo ddala eri Omuzabbibu n’ebigendererwa byagwo, nga litadde obuvunaanyizibwa bwonna obw’okulongoosebwa kwalyo ku Mulimi w’emizabbibu; ettabi eribeera mu Kristo, eryesiga Katonda era eryewaayo gy’ali alirongoose, liyinza okubala ebibala bingi. Mu buyinza bw’obulamu obw’engeri eyo tujja kwagala okusaba, tujja kumanya engeri y’okusaba, tujja kusaba, era tujja kuweebwa buli kye tusaba.

fields.title: Okuziyiza Okusaba—Kibi?
fields.body_html:
“…n’oziyiza okwewaayo eri Katonda.”—Yobu 15:4.

“Kiki kye tuganyulwa bwe tumusaba?”—Yobu 21:15.

“Kikafuuwe, okwonoona eri Mukama ne ssibasabira.”—1 Samwiri 12:23.

Siribeera nammwe nate “okuggyako nga muzikiriza omubi ali mu mmwe.”—Yoswa 7:12.

Okuzuukuka kwonna okw’amaanyi mu bulamu obw’omwoyo obw’Ekkanisa bulijjo kujja kugenda wamu n’okutegeera ekibi mu ngeri esingawo obuziba. Kino tekijja kutandikira mu kuyiga kw’eby’eddiini; okwo kusobola kwolesa bwolesa ebyo Katonda by’akola mu bulamu bw’abantu be. Era tekitegeeza nti okutegeera ekibi okwo okw’obuziba kujja kulabikira mu bigambo eby’amaanyi eby’okwenenya oba eby’okwejjusa byokka: ebyo oluusi bisangibwa nga bigenda wamu n’okusigaza ekibi, n’obutakkiriza nti omuntu asobola okununulibwa. Naye okutegeera okw’amazima okw’obubi bw’ekibi, n’okukikyawa, kujja kukakasibwa amaanyi g’okwegomba okununulibwa, n’okulwana okumanya mu bujjuvu bwonna Katonda ky’asobola okukola mu kutulokola okuva mu kyo—obuggya obutukuvu obw’obutayonoona eri Katonda mu kintu na kimu.

Bwe tuba ab’okukola ku bubulwa bw’okusaba mu ngeri ey’amaanyi, tulina okukutunuulira nga tuyima wano ne tubuuza nti, Okuziyiza okusaba, kibi? Era bwe kiba nga kibi, kikolebwako kitya—kizuulibwa kitya, kyatulwa kitya, omuntu akigoba kitya, era Katonda akinaazaawo kitya? Yesu ye Mulokozi atulokola okuva mu kibi. Tusobola okumanya mu mazima amaanyi agalokola okuva mu kibi nga tumanyi ekibi mu mazima kyokka. Obulamu obusobola okusaba n’amaanyi bwe bulamu bw’ettabi eryalongoosebwa—obulamu obumanyi okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw’okwerowoozaako. Okulaba nti ebibi byaffe mu kusaba ddala bibi, gwe mutendera ogusooka eri okununulibwa okw’amazima era okw’obwakatonda okuva mu byo.

Mu byafaayo bya Akani mwe tusanga obumu ku bujulizi obusinga amaanyi mu Byawandiikibwa nti ekibi kye kinyaga abantu ba Katonda omukisa gwe, era nti Katonda tajja kukigumiikiriza; era mu kiseera kye kimu mwe tusanga ekiraga mu ngeri esinga obutangaavu amateeka Katonda g’agoberera ng’akikolako era ng’akiggyawo. Ka tulabe mu kitangaala ky’ebyafaayo bino obanga tuyinza okuyiga engeri y’okutunuulira ekibi ky’obutasaba, n’obwonoonefu obuli ku mulandira gwakyo. Ebigambo bye njogedde waggulu, Siribeera nammwe nate “okuggyako nga muzikiriza omubi ali mu mmwe,” bitutwala mu mutima gwennyini ogw’ebyafaayo bino, era bituwa olukalala lw’amagezi ag’omuwendo ennyo agakwata ku mazima ge byogera: nti okubeerawo kw’ekibi kulemesa okubeerawo kwa Katonda.

1. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda kye kirabo ekisinga obukulu eky’abantu ba Katonda, era ge maanyi gaabwe gokka ku mulabe.—Katonda yali asuubizza Musa nti, Ndibaleeta mu nsi. Musa yalaga nti kino yakitegeera, Katonda bwe yayogera, oluvannyuma lw’ekibi ky’ennyana eya zaabu, ku kuggyawo okubeerawo kwe n’okutuma malayika. Yagaana okukkiriza ekintu kyonna ekitali kubeerawo kwa Katonda kwennyini. “Kale abantu balitegeerera ku ki nga Nkusanyusizza, nze n’abantu bo? Si lwa kubanga onooba ogenze naffe?” Kino kye kyawa Kalebu ne Yoswa obuvumu bwabwe: Mukama ali wamu naffe. Kino kye kyawa Isirayiri obuwanguzi ku Yeriko: okubeerawo kwa Katonda. Kino mu Byawandiikibwa byonna kye kisuubizo ekikulu ekiri wakati: Nze ndi wamu naawe. Kino kye kyawula omukkiriza eyeewaddeyo n’omutima gwe gwonna ku bantu ab’ensi n’Abakristaayo ab’ensi abamwetoolodde: abeera mu bulamu ng’amanyi nti akwekeddwa mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’okubeerawo kwa Katonda.

2. Okuwangulwa n’okulemererwa bulijjo biva ku kufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda.—Bwe kyali bwe kityo e Ayi. Katonda yali aleese abantu be mu Kanani n’ekisuubizo eky’okubawa ensi. Okuwangulwa e Ayi bwe kwabaawo, amangu ago Yoswa n’awulira nti ensonga erina okuba nti amaanyi ga Katonda gaali gabaggiddwako. Katonda teyali abalwanidde. Okubeerawo kwe kwali kubaggiddwako.

Mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo ne mu mulimu gw’Ekkanisa, okuwangulwa bulijjo kabonero akalaga okufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda. Bwe tukozesa kino ku kulemererwa kwaffe mu bulamu obw’okusaba, era ekiva mu ekyo, ku kulemererwa kwaffe mu mulimu gwa Katonda, tutuuka okulaba nti byonna biva bivi ku kuba nti tetuyimiridde mu kussa kimu na Katonda okutangaavu era okujjuvu. Okubeera kwe okumpi naffe, okubeerawo kwe okw’amangu ago, si kye kibadde ekintu ekikulu kye tunoonya era kye twesiga. Teyasobola kukola mu ffe nga bwe yandyagadde. Okufiirwa omukisa n’amaanyi bulijjo kuva ku kufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda.

3. Okufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda bulijjo kuva ku kibi ekimu ekikwekebwa.—Nga obulumi bwe bwategekebwa mu butonde okulabula ku bulwadde obukwese mu mubiri, bwe kityo n’okuwangulwa ddoboozi lya Katonda eritugamba nti waliwo ekikyamu. Yeewaddeyo ddala eri abantu be, asanyuka nnyo okubeera nabo, era ayagala nnyo okubalagiramu okwagala kwe n’amaanyi ge, n’olwekyo tabeekutulako n’akatono okuggyako nga bamuwalirizza olw’ekibi.

Mu Kkanisa yonna mulimu okwemulugunya ku kuwangulwa. Ekkanisa erina amaanyi matono nnyo ku bantu abangi, oba ku abo abaasoma. Okukyuka okw’amaanyi kutono nnyo bw’okugeraageranya. Obutono bw’Abakristaayo abatukuvu, abeewaddeyo, ab’omwoyo, abeemalidde ku kuweereza Katonda ne bantu bannaabwe, buwulirwa buli wamu. Amaanyi g’Ekkanisa ag’okubuulira enjiri eri amawanga agatamanyi Katonda gasannyaladde olw’obutono bwa ssente n’abantu; era byonna biva ku bubulwa bw’okusaba okw’amaanyi okuleeta Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu maanyi, okusooka ku basumba n’abakkiriza, oluvannyuma ku baminsani n’abatamanyi Katonda. Tuyinza okwegaana nti obubulwa bw’okusaba kye kibi ekiremesa okubeerawo kwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge okweyoleka mu ngeri esingawo mu ffe?

4. Katonda yennyini ye ajja okuzuula ekibi ekikwekebwa.—Tuyinza okulowooza nti tumanyi ekibi kye ki: Katonda yekka y’asobola okubikkula amakulu gaakyo amatuufu ag’omunda. Bwe yayogera ne Yoswa, nga tannaba kulanga kibi kya Akani, Katonda yasooka n’agamba nti, “…bavudde ku ndagaano gye nabakuutira…” Katonda yali alagidde (6:19) nti omunyago gwonna ogw’e Yeriko, zaabu ne ffeeza ne byonna ebyalimu, bibeere ebiwonge, bitukuvu eri Mukama era byakutereka mu ggwanika lya Mukama. Ne Isirayiri yali emenye obweyamo buno obw’okwewaayo: teyawa Katonda ekimusaanira; yanyaga Katonda.

Kino kye twetaaga: Katonda atubikkulire engeri obubulwa bw’okusaba gye bulaga obutaba beesigwa eri obweyamo bwaffe obw’okwewaayo, nti Katonda alina okufuna omutima gwaffe gwonna n’obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Tulina okulaba nti okuziyiza okusaba kuno, wamu n’ebyekwaso bye tukuwolereza nabyo, kibi kinene okusinga bwe tubadde tulowooza; kubanga kitegeeza ki? Kitegeeza nti tetulina kwagala kunene na kuwoomerwa kussa kimu na Katonda; nti okukkiriza kwaffe kwesigama nnyo ku mirimu gyaffe n’okufuba kwaffe okusinga ku maanyi ga Katonda; nti tetutegeera nnyo omukisa ogw’omu ggulu Katonda gw’alindirira okutufukako; nti tetuli beetegefu kuwaayo kwewummuza n’obwesige bw’omubiri olw’okulindirira Katonda nga tugumiikiriza; nti obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, n’okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo, binafu nnyo ddala okutusobozesa okuwangula mu kusaba. Omulimu gwa Kristo omungi bwe tugukkiriza okuba ekyekwaso ky’obutafuna budde okunoonya n’okufuna okubeerawo kwe yennyini n’amaanyi ge mu mulimu ogwo, ng’ekyetaago kyaffe ekisinga obukulu, mazima ddala kikakasa nti tetutegeera bulungi nti twesigamye ddala ku Katonda; tetutegeera mu buziba mulimu gwa Katonda ogw’obwakatonda era ogusukkulumye ku butonde, mwe tuli ebikozesebwa bye byokka; tetuyingidde ddala mu kitegeeza obubaka bwaffe n’ebigendererwa byaffe nga bya mu ggulu, ebitali bya nsi eno n’akatono; tetwewaddeyo mu bujjuvu eri Kristo Yesu yennyini era tetumusanyukiramu.

Singa tuwaayo eri Omwoyo wa Katonda atulage nti bino byonna ddala bye bitegeeza obugayaavu mu kusaba, n’okukkiriza kwaffe ebintu ebirala okukusindiikiriza ebweru, ebyekwaso byaffe byonna byandiggweerewo, ne tugwa wansi ne tukaaba nti, “Twonoonye! twonoonye!” Samwiri yagamba lumu nti, “Nze ku lwange, kikafuuwe, okwonoona eri Mukama ne ssibasabira.” Okulekera awo okusaba kwe kwonoona eri Katonda. Katonda atubikkulire kino. (Laba Ekyongerezo A.)

5. Katonda bw’azuula ekibi, kirina okwatulwa n’okugobwa.—Okuwangulwa e Ayi bwe kwajja, Yoswa ne Isirayiri tebaamanya nsonga yaakwo. Katonda yakolagana ne Isirayiri ng’eggwanga, ng’omubiri gumu, era ekibi ky’omu ku bo ne kibonerezebwa bonna. Isirayiri yonna yali tetegeera kibi ekyo, naye n’ebonaabona olw’ekyo. Ekkanisa eyinza obutamanya bunene bwa kibi kino eky’okuziyiza okusaba; abasumba oba abakkiriza kinnoomu bayinza obutakitwalangako ng’okusobya okwa ddala; naye ekyo tekikiremesa kuleeta kibonerezo kyakyo. Naye ekibi bwe kiba nga tekikyakwekeddwa, Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’atandika okukirumiriza abantu, olwo ne kituuka ekiseera eky’okwekebera mu mutima. Mu byafaayo byaffe okugatta obuvunaanyizibwa bwa buli muntu kinnoomu n’obw’awamu kya maanyi nnyo era kya kwegendereza. Obwa buli muntu: nga bwe tukisanga mu bigambo nti “muntu ku muntu”; buli muntu yawulira ng’ali mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’alina okusalirwa omusango. Era Akani bwe yamala okulondebwa, yalina okwatula. Obw’awamu: nga bwe tukiraba mu Isirayiri yonna okusooka okubonaabona n’okukolebwako Katonda, oluvannyuma n’okukwata Akani, n’ab’omu nju ye, n’ekintu ekiwonge, n’okubazikiriza okuva wakati mu bo.

Bwe tuba n’ensonga okulowooza nti kino kye kibi ekiri mu lusiisira, ka tutandike n’okwatula kinnoomu n’okwatula awamu. Era oluvannyuma ka tujje mu maaso ga Katonda tuggyewo era tuzikirize ekibi. Wano ku mulyango gwennyini ogw’ebyafaayo bya Isirayiri mu Kanani wayimiridde entuumu y’amayinja mu kiwonvu kya Akoli, okutubuulira nti Katonda tasobola kugumiikiriza kibi, nti Katonda tajja kubeera wamu na kibi, era nti bwe tuba nga ddala twagala okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu maanyi, ekibi kirina okuggibwawo. Ka tutunuulire amazima gano ag’amaanyi nga bwe gali. Wayinza okubaawo ebibi ebirala, naye kino mazima ddala kye kimu ku ebyo ebireeta okufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda—tetusaba nga Kristo n’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bituyigiriza. Ka tukireete mu maaso ga Katonda, tuwaayo ekibi kino kittibwe. Ka twewaayo eri Katonda okugondera eddoboozi lye. Waleme kubaawo kutya kwa kulemererwa okw’edda, waleme kubaawo kibinja kya bikemo ebitiisa, oba emirimu, oba ebyekwaso, ebituziyiza. Kino kibuuzo kyangu ekya buwulize. Tugenda kwewaayo eri Katonda n’Omwoyo we tubeere mu bulamu obw’okusaba, obumusanyusa? Mazima ddala, obanga ye Katonda abadde aziyiza okubeerawo kwe, abadde abikkula ekibi, ayita kizikirizibwe era tudde mu buwulize, mazima ddala tusobola okwesiga ekisa kye okutukkiriza n’okutuwa amaanyi olw’obulamu bw’atusaba. Si kibuuzo kya ki ky’osobola okukola; kibuuzo kya kuba nti kaakano, n’omutima gwo gwonna, okyuka okuwa Katonda ekimusaanira, n’owaayo ggwe kennyini okuleka okwagala kwe n’ekisa kye bikole mu ggwe.

6. Ekibi bwe kigobwa, okubeerawo kwa Katonda kuzzibwawo.—Okuva ku lunaku olwo n’okweyongerayo, mu kitabo kya Yoswa temuli kigambo na kimu ku kuwangulwa mu lutalo. Ebyafaayo bibalaga nga bava ku buwanguzi bagenda ku buwanguzi. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda bwe kukakasibwa, kuwa amaanyi okuwangula buli mulabe.

Amazima gano ganyangu nnyo ne kiba nti obwangu bwe tugakkiriza nabwo bugaggyako amaanyi gaago. Ka tuyimirireko tulowooze kye gategeeza. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda bwe kuzzibwawo kitegeeza obuwanguzi obukakafu. Kale, ffe tuvunaanyizibwa olw’okuwangulwa. Kale, walina okubaawo ekibi wonna wonna ekikireeta. Kale, tusaanidde amangu ddala okuzuula n’okuggyawo ekibi. Tuyinza okusuubira n’obwesige okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu kaseera ekibi lwe kinaaba kiggiddwawo. Mazima ddala buli omu alina obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amaanyi okwekebera obulamu bwe alabe ekitundu ky’ayinza okuba nakyo mu bubi buno.

Katonda tayogera n’abantu be ku kibi okuggyako nga agenderera okubalokola okuva mu kyo. Ekitangaala kye kimu ekiraga ekibi kye kijja okulaga n’ekkubo ery’okukivaamu. Amaanyi ge gamu agamenya ne gasalira omusango, bwe tunaagagondera n’obwetoowaze ne tugalindirira mu kwatula ne mu kukkiriza, gajja kutuwa amaanyi okugolokoka n’okuwangula. fields.body_text: “…n’oziyiza okwewaayo eri Katonda.”—Yobu 15:4. “Kiki kye tuganyulwa bwe tumusaba?”—Yobu 21:15. “Kikafuuwe, okwonoona eri Mukama ne ssibasabira.”—1 Samwiri 12:23. Siribeera nammwe nate “okuggyako nga muzikiriza omubi ali mu mmwe.”—Yoswa 7:12. Okuzuukuka kwonna okw’amaanyi mu bulamu obw’omwoyo obw’Ekkanisa bulijjo kujja kugenda wamu n’okutegeera ekibi mu ngeri esingawo obuziba. Kino tekijja kutandikira mu kuyiga kw’eby’eddiini; okwo kusobola kwolesa bwolesa ebyo Katonda by’akola mu bulamu bw’abantu be. Era tekitegeeza nti okutegeera ekibi okwo okw’obuziba kujja kulabikira mu bigambo eby’amaanyi eby’okwenenya oba eby’okwejjusa byokka: ebyo oluusi bisangibwa nga bigenda wamu n’okusigaza ekibi, n’obutakkiriza nti omuntu asobola okununulibwa. Naye okutegeera okw’amazima okw’obubi bw’ekibi, n’okukikyawa, kujja kukakasibwa amaanyi g’okwegomba okununulibwa, n’okulwana okumanya mu bujjuvu bwonna Katonda ky’asobola okukola mu kutulokola okuva mu kyo—obuggya obutukuvu obw’obutayonoona eri Katonda mu kintu na kimu. Bwe tuba ab’okukola ku bubulwa bw’okusaba mu ngeri ey’amaanyi, tulina okukutunuulira nga tuyima wano ne tubuuza nti, Okuziyiza okusaba, kibi? Era bwe kiba nga kibi, kikolebwako kitya—kizuulibwa kitya, kyatulwa kitya, omuntu akigoba kitya, era Katonda akinaazaawo kitya? Yesu ye Mulokozi atulokola okuva mu kibi. Tusobola okumanya mu mazima amaanyi agalokola okuva mu kibi nga tumanyi ekibi mu mazima kyokka. Obulamu obusobola okusaba n’amaanyi bwe bulamu bw’ettabi eryalongoosebwa—obulamu obumanyi okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw’okwerowoozaako. Okulaba nti ebibi byaffe mu kusaba ddala bibi, gwe mutendera ogusooka eri okununulibwa okw’amazima era okw’obwakatonda okuva mu byo. Mu byafaayo bya Akani mwe tusanga obumu ku bujulizi obusinga amaanyi mu Byawandiikibwa nti ekibi kye kinyaga abantu ba Katonda omukisa gwe, era nti Katonda tajja kukigumiikiriza; era mu kiseera kye kimu mwe tusanga ekiraga mu ngeri esinga obutangaavu amateeka Katonda g’agoberera ng’akikolako era ng’akiggyawo. Ka tulabe mu kitangaala ky’ebyafaayo bino obanga tuyinza okuyiga engeri y’okutunuulira ekibi ky’obutasaba, n’obwonoonefu obuli ku mulandira gwakyo. Ebigambo bye njogedde waggulu, Siribeera nammwe nate “okuggyako nga muzikiriza omubi ali mu mmwe,” bitutwala mu mutima gwennyini ogw’ebyafaayo bino, era bituwa olukalala lw’amagezi ag’omuwendo ennyo agakwata ku mazima ge byogera: nti okubeerawo kw’ekibi kulemesa okubeerawo kwa Katonda. 1. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda kye kirabo ekisinga obukulu eky’abantu ba Katonda, era ge maanyi gaabwe gokka ku mulabe.—Katonda yali asuubizza Musa nti, Ndibaleeta mu nsi. Musa yalaga nti kino yakitegeera, Katonda bwe yayogera, oluvannyuma lw’ekibi ky’ennyana eya zaabu, ku kuggyawo okubeerawo kwe n’okutuma malayika. Yagaana okukkiriza ekintu kyonna ekitali kubeerawo kwa Katonda kwennyini. “Kale abantu balitegeerera ku ki nga Nkusanyusizza, nze n’abantu bo? Si lwa kubanga onooba ogenze naffe?” Kino kye kyawa Kalebu ne Yoswa obuvumu bwabwe: Mukama ali wamu naffe. Kino kye kyawa Isirayiri obuwanguzi ku Yeriko: okubeerawo kwa Katonda. Kino mu Byawandiikibwa byonna kye kisuubizo ekikulu ekiri wakati: Nze ndi wamu naawe. Kino kye kyawula omukkiriza eyeewaddeyo n’omutima gwe gwonna ku bantu ab’ensi n’Abakristaayo ab’ensi abamwetoolodde: abeera mu bulamu ng’amanyi nti akwekeddwa mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’okubeerawo kwa Katonda. 2. Okuwangulwa n’okulemererwa bulijjo biva ku kufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda.—Bwe kyali bwe kityo e Ayi. Katonda yali aleese abantu be mu Kanani n’ekisuubizo eky’okubawa ensi. Okuwangulwa e Ayi bwe kwabaawo, amangu ago Yoswa n’awulira nti ensonga erina okuba nti amaanyi ga Katonda gaali gabaggiddwako. Katonda teyali abalwanidde. Okubeerawo kwe kwali kubaggiddwako. Mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo ne mu mulimu gw’Ekkanisa, okuwangulwa bulijjo kabonero akalaga okufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda. Bwe tukozesa kino ku kulemererwa kwaffe mu bulamu obw’okusaba, era ekiva mu ekyo, ku kulemererwa kwaffe mu mulimu gwa Katonda, tutuuka okulaba nti byonna biva bivi ku kuba nti tetuyimiridde mu kussa kimu na Katonda okutangaavu era okujjuvu. Okubeera kwe okumpi naffe, okubeerawo kwe okw’amangu ago, si kye kibadde ekintu ekikulu kye tunoonya era kye twesiga. Teyasobola kukola mu ffe nga bwe yandyagadde. Okufiirwa omukisa n’amaanyi bulijjo kuva ku kufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda. 3. Okufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda bulijjo kuva ku kibi ekimu ekikwekebwa.—Nga obulumi bwe bwategekebwa mu butonde okulabula ku bulwadde obukwese mu mubiri, bwe kityo n’okuwangulwa ddoboozi lya Katonda eritugamba nti waliwo ekikyamu. Yeewaddeyo ddala eri abantu be, asanyuka nnyo okubeera nabo, era ayagala nnyo okubalagiramu okwagala kwe n’amaanyi ge, n’olwekyo tabeekutulako n’akatono okuggyako nga bamuwalirizza olw’ekibi. Mu Kkanisa yonna mulimu okwemulugunya ku kuwangulwa. Ekkanisa erina amaanyi matono nnyo ku bantu abangi, oba ku abo abaasoma. Okukyuka okw’amaanyi kutono nnyo bw’okugeraageranya. Obutono bw’Abakristaayo abatukuvu, abeewaddeyo, ab’omwoyo, abeemalidde ku kuweereza Katonda ne bantu bannaabwe, buwulirwa buli wamu. Amaanyi g’Ekkanisa ag’okubuulira enjiri eri amawanga agatamanyi Katonda gasannyaladde olw’obutono bwa ssente n’abantu; era byonna biva ku bubulwa bw’okusaba okw’amaanyi okuleeta Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu maanyi, okusooka ku basumba n’abakkiriza, oluvannyuma ku baminsani n’abatamanyi Katonda. Tuyinza okwegaana nti obubulwa bw’okusaba kye kibi ekiremesa okubeerawo kwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge okweyoleka mu ngeri esingawo mu ffe? 4. Katonda yennyini ye ajja okuzuula ekibi ekikwekebwa.—Tuyinza okulowooza nti tumanyi ekibi kye ki: Katonda yekka y’asobola okubikkula amakulu gaakyo amatuufu ag’omunda. Bwe yayogera ne Yoswa, nga tannaba kulanga kibi kya Akani, Katonda yasooka n’agamba nti, “…bavudde ku ndagaano gye nabakuutira…” Katonda yali alagidde (6:19) nti omunyago gwonna ogw’e Yeriko, zaabu ne ffeeza ne byonna ebyalimu, bibeere ebiwonge, bitukuvu eri Mukama era byakutereka mu ggwanika lya Mukama. Ne Isirayiri yali emenye obweyamo buno obw’okwewaayo: teyawa Katonda ekimusaanira; yanyaga Katonda. Kino kye twetaaga: Katonda atubikkulire engeri obubulwa bw’okusaba gye bulaga obutaba beesigwa eri obweyamo bwaffe obw’okwewaayo, nti Katonda alina okufuna omutima gwaffe gwonna n’obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Tulina okulaba nti okuziyiza okusaba kuno, wamu n’ebyekwaso bye tukuwolereza nabyo, kibi kinene okusinga bwe tubadde tulowooza; kubanga kitegeeza ki? Kitegeeza nti tetulina kwagala kunene na kuwoomerwa kussa kimu na Katonda; nti okukkiriza kwaffe kwesigama nnyo ku mirimu gyaffe n’okufuba kwaffe okusinga ku maanyi ga Katonda; nti tetutegeera nnyo omukisa ogw’omu ggulu Katonda gw’alindirira okutufukako; nti tetuli beetegefu kuwaayo kwewummuza n’obwesige bw’omubiri olw’okulindirira Katonda nga tugumiikiriza; nti obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, n’okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo, binafu nnyo ddala okutusobozesa okuwangula mu kusaba. Omulimu gwa Kristo omungi bwe tugukkiriza okuba ekyekwaso ky’obutafuna budde okunoonya n’okufuna okubeerawo kwe yennyini n’amaanyi ge mu mulimu ogwo, ng’ekyetaago kyaffe ekisinga obukulu, mazima ddala kikakasa nti tetutegeera bulungi nti twesigamye ddala ku Katonda; tetutegeera mu buziba mulimu gwa Katonda ogw’obwakatonda era ogusukkulumye ku butonde, mwe tuli ebikozesebwa bye byokka; tetuyingidde ddala mu kitegeeza obubaka bwaffe n’ebigendererwa byaffe nga bya mu ggulu, ebitali bya nsi eno n’akatono; tetwewaddeyo mu bujjuvu eri Kristo Yesu yennyini era tetumusanyukiramu. Singa tuwaayo eri Omwoyo wa Katonda atulage nti bino byonna ddala bye bitegeeza obugayaavu mu kusaba, n’okukkiriza kwaffe ebintu ebirala okukusindiikiriza ebweru, ebyekwaso byaffe byonna byandiggweerewo, ne tugwa wansi ne tukaaba nti, “Twonoonye! twonoonye!” Samwiri yagamba lumu nti, “Nze ku lwange, kikafuuwe, okwonoona eri Mukama ne ssibasabira.” Okulekera awo okusaba kwe kwonoona eri Katonda. Katonda atubikkulire kino. (Laba Ekyongerezo A.) 5. Katonda bw’azuula ekibi, kirina okwatulwa n’okugobwa.—Okuwangulwa e Ayi bwe kwajja, Yoswa ne Isirayiri tebaamanya nsonga yaakwo. Katonda yakolagana ne Isirayiri ng’eggwanga, ng’omubiri gumu, era ekibi ky’omu ku bo ne kibonerezebwa bonna. Isirayiri yonna yali tetegeera kibi ekyo, naye n’ebonaabona olw’ekyo. Ekkanisa eyinza obutamanya bunene bwa kibi kino eky’okuziyiza okusaba; abasumba oba abakkiriza kinnoomu bayinza obutakitwalangako ng’okusobya okwa ddala; naye ekyo tekikiremesa kuleeta kibonerezo kyakyo. Naye ekibi bwe kiba nga tekikyakwekeddwa, Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’atandika okukirumiriza abantu, olwo ne kituuka ekiseera eky’okwekebera mu mutima. Mu byafaayo byaffe okugatta obuvunaanyizibwa bwa buli muntu kinnoomu n’obw’awamu kya maanyi nnyo era kya kwegendereza. Obwa buli muntu: nga bwe tukisanga mu bigambo nti “muntu ku muntu”; buli muntu yawulira ng’ali mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’alina okusalirwa omusango. Era Akani bwe yamala okulondebwa, yalina okwatula. Obw’awamu: nga bwe tukiraba mu Isirayiri yonna okusooka okubonaabona n’okukolebwako Katonda, oluvannyuma n’okukwata Akani, n’ab’omu nju ye, n’ekintu ekiwonge, n’okubazikiriza okuva wakati mu bo. Bwe tuba n’ensonga okulowooza nti kino kye kibi ekiri mu lusiisira, ka tutandike n’okwatula kinnoomu n’okwatula awamu. Era oluvannyuma ka tujje mu maaso ga Katonda tuggyewo era tuzikirize ekibi. Wano ku mulyango gwennyini ogw’ebyafaayo bya Isirayiri mu Kanani wayimiridde entuumu y’amayinja mu kiwonvu kya Akoli, okutubuulira nti Katonda tasobola kugumiikiriza kibi, nti Katonda tajja kubeera wamu na kibi, era nti bwe tuba nga ddala twagala okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu maanyi, ekibi kirina okuggibwawo. Ka tutunuulire amazima gano ag’amaanyi nga bwe gali. Wayinza okubaawo ebibi ebirala, naye kino mazima ddala kye kimu ku ebyo ebireeta okufiirwa okubeerawo kwa Katonda—tetusaba nga Kristo n’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bituyigiriza. Ka tukireete mu maaso ga Katonda, tuwaayo ekibi kino kittibwe. Ka twewaayo eri Katonda okugondera eddoboozi lye. Waleme kubaawo kutya kwa kulemererwa okw’edda, waleme kubaawo kibinja kya bikemo ebitiisa, oba emirimu, oba ebyekwaso, ebituziyiza. Kino kibuuzo kyangu ekya buwulize. Tugenda kwewaayo eri Katonda n’Omwoyo we tubeere mu bulamu obw’okusaba, obumusanyusa? Mazima ddala, obanga ye Katonda abadde aziyiza okubeerawo kwe, abadde abikkula ekibi, ayita kizikirizibwe era tudde mu buwulize, mazima ddala tusobola okwesiga ekisa kye okutukkiriza n’okutuwa amaanyi olw’obulamu bw’atusaba. Si kibuuzo kya ki ky’osobola okukola; kibuuzo kya kuba nti kaakano, n’omutima gwo gwonna, okyuka okuwa Katonda ekimusaanira, n’owaayo ggwe kennyini okuleka okwagala kwe n’ekisa kye bikole mu ggwe. 6. Ekibi bwe kigobwa, okubeerawo kwa Katonda kuzzibwawo.—Okuva ku lunaku olwo n’okweyongerayo, mu kitabo kya Yoswa temuli kigambo na kimu ku kuwangulwa mu lutalo. Ebyafaayo bibalaga nga bava ku buwanguzi bagenda ku buwanguzi. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda bwe kukakasibwa, kuwa amaanyi okuwangula buli mulabe. Amazima gano ganyangu nnyo ne kiba nti obwangu bwe tugakkiriza nabwo bugaggyako amaanyi gaago. Ka tuyimirireko tulowooze kye gategeeza. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda bwe kuzzibwawo kitegeeza obuwanguzi obukakafu. Kale, ffe tuvunaanyizibwa olw’okuwangulwa. Kale, walina okubaawo ekibi wonna wonna ekikireeta. Kale, tusaanidde amangu ddala okuzuula n’okuggyawo ekibi. Tuyinza okusuubira n’obwesige okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu kaseera ekibi lwe kinaaba kiggiddwawo. Mazima ddala buli omu alina obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amaanyi okwekebera obulamu bwe alabe ekitundu ky’ayinza okuba nakyo mu bubi buno. fields.title: Ani Alindokola?
fields.body_html:
“Teri ddagala mu Gireyaadi? Teriiyo musawo? Lwaki ekiwundu ky’abantu bange tekiwonyezebwa?”—Yeremiya 8:22.

“Mukomeewo mmwe abantu abatali beesigwa, nnaabawonya ne mbafuula abeesigwa. … Weewaawo tujja kudda gy’oli, kubanga ggwe Mukama Katonda waffe.”—Yeremiya 3:22.

“Mponya, Ayi Mukama, nange nnaawona.”—Yeremiya 12:14.

“Nga ndi muntu munaku! Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa? Katonda yeebazibwe mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe. Etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.”—Abaruumi 7:24, 8:2.

Mu lumu ku nkuŋŋaana zaffe, omwami omu yajja gye ndi okunsaba amagezi n’obuyambi. Kyali kyeyoleka nti yali Mukristaayo anyiikivu era eyayigirizibwa obulungi. Yali amaze emyaka egiwerako ng’abeera mu mbeera enzibu ennyo, ng’agezaako okuwa obujulirwa ku Kristo. Ekyavaamu kwe kuwulira nti alemereddwa era nga talina ssanyu. Kye yemulugunyako kyali nti Ekigambo kya Katonda tekyali kimuwoomera, era nti newaakubadde nga yasabanga, kyali ng’omutima gwe tegwali mu kusaba okwo. Bwe yayogeranga n’abalala, oba bwe yawanga omuntu akatabo akabuulira Enjiri, yakikolanga lwa buvunaanyizibwa bwokka: okwagala n’essanyu tebyabangawo. Yayaayaananga okujjuzibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda, naye gye yakoma okumunoonya, gye yakoma okulaba ng’ali wala. Yali alina kulowooza ki ku mbeera ye, era waaliwo ekkubo lyonna ery’okugivaamu?

Kye nnamuddamu kyali nti ensonga yonna yandabikira nga nnyangu nnyo: yali abeera wansi w’amateeka so si wansi w’ekisa. Kasita yali ng’akyabeera bw’atyo, tewaali kyandikyuse. Yawuliriza n’obwegendereza, naye teyategeera bulungi kye nnali ntegeeza.

Ne mmujjukiza enjawulo, okukontana okw’enkukunala, wakati w’amateeka n’ekisa. Amateeka gasaba; ekisa kigaba. Amateeka galagira, naye tegawa maanyi ga kugondera; ekisa kisuubiza, era kituukiriza, kikola byonna bye twetaaga okukola. Amateeka gazitoowerera, gamegga era gasalira omusango; ekisa kibudaabuda, era kiwa amaanyi n’essanyu. Amateeka gakoowoola omuntu yennyini akole kyonna ky’asobola; ekisa kisonga ku Kristo okukola byonna. Amateeka gayita okufuba n’okwekaliriza, era gatusindika eri ekiruubirirwa kye tutayinza kutuuka; ekisa kikola mu ffe byonna Katonda by’ayagala ebirungi era ebiweesa omukisa. Ne mmulaga nti eddaala lye erisooka, mu kifo ky’okulwanyisa okulemererwa kuno kwonna, lyandibadde okukukkiriza ddala, n’okukkiriza essomo ery’obunafu bwe yennyini, nga Katonda bw’abadde agezaako okulimuyigiriza, era, ng’amaze okwatula ekyo, okugwa wansi mu maaso ga Katonda ng’alemereddwa ddala. Awo we yandiyize nti, ekisa bwe kitamuwa kununulibwa na maanyi, teyandisobodde kukola bulungi okusinga bwe yali akoze, era nti ekisa ddala kyandimukoledde byonna. Kyali kimugwanidde okuva wansi w’amateeka, wansi w’okwesigama ku ye yennyini n’okufuba kwe, n’atwala ekifo kye wansi w’ekisa, ng’aleka Katonda okukola byonna.

Mu mboozi ze twagenda tunyumya oluvannyuma, yaŋŋamba nti okulambika kw’obulwadde kwali kutuufu. Yakkiriza nti ekisa kye kirina okukola byonna. Naye era, endowooza nti tulina okubaako kye tukola, nti waakiri tulina okuleeta obwesigwa bwaffe okunyweza omulimu gw’ekisa, yali emusimbye amakanda nnyo, n’atya nti obulamu bwe tebwandyawuddeko nnyo; nti teyandisobodde kugumira buzito bwa bizibu ebipya bye yali agendamu. Mu kunyiikira kwe kwonna okw’amaanyi, mwalimu eddoboozi ery’ekyama ery’okuggwaamu essuubi; teyasobola kubeera mu bulamu nga bwe yamanya nti kimugwanidde. Nnayogedde dda mu ssuula esooka nti mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe ezimu nnakiraba nti eddoboozi lino ery’okuggwaamu essuubi lyali liwulikika. Era tewali musumba eyali akwataganye ennyo n’emyoyo egyagala okubeerera Katonda yekka mu bujjuvu, “okutambula nga basiimibwa Mukama era nga bamusanyusa mu buli byonna,” atamanyi nti kino kiremesa okukulaakulana okwa nnamaddala. Bwe twogera ku kubulwa okusaba mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, n’okwegomba okubeera n’obulamu bw’okusaba obujjuvu, ebizibu ebituyolekera nga bingi nnyo! Tusazeewo emirundi mingi okusaba ennyo era obulungi okusinga, ne tulemererwa. Tetulina maanyi ga kwagala ng’agalina abalala abamu, abasobola okusalawo omulundi gumu ne bakyuka ne bakyusa empisa zaabwe. Obuvunaanyizibwa bwe tulina bukyatunyiga nga bwe bwali bulijjo; kizibu nnyo okufuna obudde obw’okusaba ennyo; essanyu erya nnamaddala mu kusaba, eryandituyambye okugumiikiriza, si lye tuwulira; tetulina maanyi ga kwegayirira n’okukaabirira Katonda nga bwe kitugwanidde; okusaba kwaffe, mu kifo ky’okubeera essanyu n’amaanyi, kufuuse ensibuko y’okwesalira omusango n’okubuusabuusa okutakoma. Oluusi tukungubagidde, ne twatula, ne tusalawo; naye, okwogera amazima gennyini, tetusuubira nkyukakyuka yonna ennene, kubanga tetulaba kkubo lyonna erigituusaako.

Kyeyoleka bulungi nti kasita omwoyo guno gukyafuga, tewali ssuubi lingi lya kulongooka. Okuggwaamu amaanyi kuteekwa okuleeta okuwangulwa. Ekimu ku bintu omusawo by’asooka okufaako bulijjo kwe kuzuukusa essuubi; awatali lyo amanyi nti eddagala lye emirundi mingi terijja kuyamba nnyo. Tewali kuyigiriza kwonna okuva mu Kigambo kya Katonda ku buvunaanyizibwa, ku bwetaavu obw’amangu, ku nkizo ey’omukisa ey’okusaba ennyo, okusaba okulimu amaanyi, okujja okugasa, ng’akaama kano kakyawuubaala mu mutima nti: Tewali ssuubi. Ekyo kye tulina okusooka okufaako kwe kuzuula ensonga ekwekeddwa ereeta okulemererwa n’okuggwaamu essuubi, n’oluvannyuma okulaga nti okununulibwa okuva eri Katonda kukakafu ddala. Bwe tuba nga tetwagala kumatira na mbeera yaffe, tuteekwa okuwuliriza n’okwegatta ku kibuuzo kino: “Teri ddagala mu Gireyaadi? Teriiyo musawo? Lwaki ekiwundu ky’abantu bange tekiwonyezebwa?” Tuteekwa okuwuliriza, n’okuyingiza mu mutima gwaffe, ekisuubizo kya Katonda n’okuddamu kwe kwasisinkana: “Mukomeewo mmwe abantu abatali beesigwa, nnaabawonya ne mbafuula abeesigwa. … Weewaawo tujja kudda gy’oli, kubanga ggwe Mukama Katonda waffe.” Tuteekwa okujja buli omu n’okusaba kwe ye kennyini, n’okukkiriza nti ajja kuddibwamu ye kennyini. Kale tetusaanidde ne kaakano okutandika okukisaba ng’ekyaffe ku nsonga y’okubulwa okusaba, ne tukkiriza nti Katonda ajja kutuyamba: “Mponya, Ayi Mukama, nange nnaawona.”

Bulijjo kikulu okwawula wakati w’obubonero bw’obulwadde n’obulwadde bwennyini. Obunafu n’okulemererwa mu kusaba kabonero k’obunafu mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Omulwadde singa asaba omusawo amuwe ekintu ekizuukusa okukuba kw’omusuwa gwe okunafu, yandigambiddwa nti ekyo tekyandimuyambye nnyo. Okukuba kw’omusuwa kye kipimo ky’embeera y’omutima n’omubiri gwonna: omusawo afuba okuzzaawo obulamu. Buli muntu ayagala okusaba n’obwesigwa n’amaanyi okusinga, kino ky’alina okuyiga: nti obulamu bwe bwonna obw’omwoyo buli mu mbeera ya bulwadde, era bwetaaga okuzzibwa obuggya. Bw’alitandika okutunuulira, si bunafu bwe mu kusaba bwokka, wabula n’okubulwa okuli mu bulamu bw’okukkiriza, obunafu obwo kwe kabonero kaakwo, lw’alitegeera ddala obuzito bw’obulwadde buno. Olwo aliraba obwetaavu bw’enkyukakyuka ey’omusingi mu bulamu bwe bwonna n’entambula ye, obanga obulamu bwe obw’okusaba, obutali birala wabula okukuba kw’omusuwa kw’omubiri gw’omwoyo, bulina okulaga obulamu obulungi n’amaanyi. Katonda yatutonda bw’atyo nti okukozesa buli kitundu ekiramu kireeta essanyu. Okusaba kwategekebwa okubeera okwangu era okw’obutonde ng’okussa omukka oba okukola eri omuntu omulamu obulungi. Obutayagala bwe tuwulira, n’okulemererwa kwe twatula, lye ddoboozi lya Katonda yennyini ng’atuyita okukkiriza obulwadde bwaffe, n’okujja gy’ali okufuna okuwonyezebwa kw’asuubizza.

Kale bulwadde ki obwo okubulwa okusaba kwe kabonero kaabwo? Tetuyinza kufuna kuddamu kulungi okusinga okwo okulagibwa mu bigambo bino: “Temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda.”

Wano tulagiddwa nti wayinza okubaawo engeri bbiri ez’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Wayinza okubaawo obulamu obuli ekitundu wansi w’amateeka n’ekitundu wansi w’ekisa; oba obulamu obuli wansi w’ekisa ddala, mu ddembe lyonna okuva mu kwefubitiriza, era nga bulaba mu bujjuvu amaanyi ga Katonda ekisa ge kiyinza okuwa. Omukkiriza owa nnamaddala ayinza okuba ng’akyabeera ekitundu wansi w’amateeka, mu maanyi g’okwefubitiriza, ng’agezaako okukola ky’atayinza kutuukiriza. Okulemererwa okutakoma mu bulamu bwe obw’Ekikristaayo kw’ayatula kuva ku kintu kino kimu: yeesiga yekka, era agezaako okukola kyonna ky’asobola. Ddala asaba era atunuulira Katonda okumuyamba, naye era ye yennyini mu maanyi ge, ng’ayambibwako Katonda, y’alina okukola omulimu. Mu bbaluwa eri Abaruumi, n’Abakkolinso, n’Abaggalatiya, tumanyi nga Pawulo bw’abagamba nti tebaaweebwa nate mwoyo gwa buddu, nti ba ddembe okuva mu mateeka, nti tebakyali baddu wabula baana; nti tewali kintu kye basaanidde kwegendereza okusinga okusibwa nate mu kikoligo ky’obuddu. Buli wantu kye kukontana wakati w’amateeka n’ekisa, wakati w’omubiri, oguli wansi w’amateeka, n’Omwoyo, ye kirabo ky’ekisa, era mu ye ekisa mwe kikolera omulimu gwakyo gwonna. Mu nnaku zaffe, nga bwe kyali mu mirembe egyo egyasooka, akabi akasinga obunene kwe kubeera wansi w’amateeka, n’okuweereza Katonda mu maanyi g’omubiri. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi kirabika eyo ye mbeera mwe basigala obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Eyo ye nsonga lwaki obulamu obutukuvu obwa nnamaddala n’amaanyi mu kusaba bibulwa nnyo bwe bityo. Tebamanyi nti okulemererwa kwonna kuyinza okuba n’ensonga emu yokka: Abantu banoonya okukola bo bennyini ekyo ekisa kyokka kye kiyinza okukola mu bo, ekyo ekisa kye kijja okukola awatali kubuusabuusa.

Bangi tebajja kwetegekera kukkiriza nti buno bwe bulwadde bwabwe, nti tebabeera “wansi w’ekisa.” Tekiyinzika, bwe bagamba. “Okuva ku ntobo y’omutima gwange,” Omukristaayo bw’akaaba, “nzikiriza era mmanyi nti mu nze temuli kirungi, era nti byonna mbifuna lwa kisa kyokka.” “Obulamu bwange bwonna,” omusumba bw’agamba, “mbumazze nga mbuulira era ngulumiza enjigiriza z’ekisa eky’obwereere, era mu ekyo mwe nnafunira ekitiibwa kyange.” “Ate nze,” omuminsani bw’addamu, “nnandisobodde ntya n’okulowooza okulaba abatamanyi Katonda nga balokolebwa, singa obwesige bwange bwokka tebwali mu bubaka bwe nnaleeta, ne mu maanyi ge nnesiga, ag’ekisa kya Katonda ekisukkirivu?” Ddala toyinza kugamba nti okulemererwa kwaffe mu kusaba, kwe twatula n’ennaku, kuva ku butabeera kwaffe “wansi w’ekisa”? Buno tebuyinza kuba bulwadde bwaffe.

Tumanyi nga emirundi mingi omuntu bw’ayinza okuba ng’alwadde obulwadde nga tabumanyi. Ky’alowooza nti kirwadde kitono kikyuka ne kiba obulwadde obw’akabi. Tuleme kwekakasa nnyo nti tetukyabeera, mu kigero ekinene, “wansi w’amateeka,” nga bwe twerowooza nti tubeera ddala “wansi w’ekisa.” Emirundi mingi ensonga y’ensobi eno y’amakulu amatono agaweebwa ekigambo “ekisa.” Nga bwe tukomya Katonda yennyini, olw’ebirowoozo byaffe ebitono oba eby’obutakkiriza gy’ali, bwe tutyo bwe tukomya ekisa kye mu kiseera kyennyini kye tusanyukira ebigambo nga “obugagga bw’ekisa,” “ekisa ekingi ennyo.” Ekigambo kyennyini “ekisa ekisukkirivu,” okuva ku kitabo kya Bunyan n’okweyongerayo, tekikugiddwa ku mazima amanene ag’omukisa agamu gokka ag’okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku bwereere, wamu n’okusonyiyibwa okuzzibwa obuggya buli kiseera n’ekitiibwa eky’emirembe gyonna eri aboonoonyi abasingayo okuba ababi, so nga amazima amalala ag’omukisa ge gamu ag’“ekisa ekisukkirivu” mu kutukuzibwa tegamanyiddwa mu bujjuvu? Pawulo awandiika nti: “… abaliweebwa ekisa kya Katonda … tebalisinga nnyo okufugira mu bulamu olw’omuntu omu Yesu Kristo?” Okufugira okwo mu bulamu, ng’omuwanguzi w’ekibi, kuli wano ku nsi. “Ekibi bwe kyeyongera” mu mutima ne mu bulamu, “ekisa kya Katonda kyo ne kyeyongera nnyo okusingawo,” ekisa kiryoke kifugire mu butuukirivu mu bulamu bwonna ne mu buntu bwonna obw’omukkiriza. Ku kufuga kuno okw’ekisa mu mwoyo Pawulo kw’abuuza nti, “Kale tukole ekibi kubanga tetufugibwa mateeka wabula ekisa kya Katonda?” n’addamu nti, “Kikafuuwe.” Ekisa si kusonyiyibwa ebibi kwokka, wabula maanyi agawangula ekibi; ekisa kitwala ekifo ekibi kye kyalina mu bulamu, era kyeyama, nga ekibi bwe kyafuganga munda mu maanyi g’okufa, okufuga mu maanyi g’obulamu bwa Kristo. Ku kisa kino Kristo kwe yayogerako nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala,” Pawulo n’addamu nti, “… nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange … kubanga buli bwe mba omunafu, olwo nga ndi wa maanyi.” Ku kisa kino, ekijja okukola byonna mu ffe bwe twetegefu okwatula nti tetulina maanyi n’akatono era tetuyinza kwebeesaawo, Pawulo kw’ayigiriza awalala nti, “Katonda ayinza okwaza ekisa kyonna gye muli, bulijjo mubeerenga n’ebibamala byonna mu buli kintu nga musukkirira mu mulimu gwonna omulungi.”

Kitera okubaawo nti omuntu anoonya Katonda n’obulokozi asoma Bayibuli ye okumala ebbanga ddene, naye n’atalaba mazima ag’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza, ku bwereere, mu bujjuvu, era amangu ago. Amaaso ge bwe gaazibuka, n’agakkiriza, yewuunya okugasanga buli wamu. Bwe kityo n’abakkiriza bangi, abakwata enjigiriza z’ekisa eky’obwereere nga zikwata ku kusonyiyibwa, tebalabanga makulu gaakyo ag’ekitalo nga kyeyama okukola obulamu bwaffe bwonna mu ffe, era n’okutuwa ddala amaanyi buli kaseera olw’ekyo kyonna Kitaffe ky’ayagala tubeere era tukole. Ekitangaala kya Katonda bwe kyakira mu mutima gwaffe n’amazima gano ag’omukisa, tutegeera Pawulo ky’ategeeza bw’agamba nti, “… si nze nakola wabula ekisa kya Katonda …” Era wano olaba obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’engeri ebbiri. Obumu, mwe “Si nze”—siri kintu, siyinza kukola kintu—tekinnafuuka kya nnamaddala. Obulala, okuwaanyisiganya okw’ekitalo bwe kumala okubaawo, ekisa ne kitwala ekifo ky’okufuba kwaffe, ne tugamba era ne tumanya nti, “ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze.” Olwo kiyinza okufuuka kye tuyitamu obulamu bwaffe bwonna: “Mukama waffe yankwatirwa ekisa kingi n’ampa okukkiriza kungi, era n’okwagala kwe tufunira mu Kristo Yesu.”

Omwana wa Katonda omwagalwa! Olowooza otya, tekiyinzika nti kino kye kibadde kibulamu mu bulamu bwo, ensonga y’okulemererwa kwo mu kusaba? Tewamanya ekisa bwe kyandikusobozesezza okusaba, singa obulamu bwonna bwali bufugibwa amaanyi gaakyo. Wanoonya okuwangula obutayagala bwo oba obufu bwo mu kusaba ng’ofuba ennyo, naye n’olemererwa. Wagezaako okwesiikuula okusaba ng’okozesa buli nsonga ey’ensonyi oba ey’okwagala gye wasobola okulowoozaako, naye tekyakuyamba. Tekisaanidde kubuuza Mukama obanga obubaka bwe nkuleetedde nga omuweereza we tebuyinza kuba bwa mazima gy’oli okusinga bw’olowooza? Okubulwa okusaba kwo kuva ku mbeera y’obulamu erwadde, era obulwadde obwo si kirala wabula kino—tonnakkiriza, mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku ne mu buli buvunaanyizibwa, obulokozi obujjuvu ekigambo kino bwe kireeta: “Temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda.” Ebyo ekisa bye kitegese n’amaanyi kye kitusobozesa okufugira mu bulamu bibuna wonna era bigenda wala munda nga bye amateeka gasaba n’okufuga kw’ekibi, weewaawo bisukkirira nnyo okusingawo. (Laba Ekyongerezo B.)

Mu ssuula eddirira eyo Pawulo mwe yawandiikira nti, “Temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda,” atuwa ekifaananyi ky’obulamu bw’omukkiriza ali wansi w’amateeka, n’ebikaawa by’ayitamu ebikoma mu kukaaba nti: “Nga ndi muntu munaku! Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa?” Okuddamu kwe eri ekibuuzo ekyo, “Katonda yeebazibwe mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.” kulaga nti waliwo okununulibwa okuva mu bulamu obusibiddwa mu busibe bw’empisa embi ze tulwanyisizza obwereere. Okununulibwa okwo kuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, atuwa okulaba mu bujjuvu obulamu bwa Kristo kye buyinza okukola mu ffe: “Etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.” Etteeka lya Katonda lyali lisobola kututeeka mu buyinza bw’etteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa kyokka. Ekisa kya Katonda kisobola okutuyingiza, n’okutukuuma, mu ddembe ly’Omwoyo. Tusobola okufuulibwa ab’eddembe okuva mu bulamu obw’ennaku obwali wansi w’obuyinza obwatutwala mu busibe, ne tutakola kye twagala. Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo asobola okutununula okuva mu kulemererwa kwaffe okutakoma mu kusaba, n’atusobozesa ne mu kino okutambula nga tusiimibwa Mukama era nga tumusanyusa mu buli byonna.

Ayi! toggwaamu ssuubi, toggwaamu maanyi; waliwo eddagala mu Gireyaadi; waliyo Omusawo; waliwo okuwonyezebwa olw’obulwadde bwaffe. Ebitayinzika eri abantu, biyinzika eri Katonda. Ky’otalabamu ngeri yonna ey’okukikola, ekisa kijja kukikola. Yatula obulwadde; wesige Omusawo; saba okuwonyezebwa nga kwe kwo; saba okusaba okw’okukkiriza nti, “Mponya, nange nnaawona.” Naawe osobola okufuuka omuntu ow’okusaba, n’osaba okusaba okw’amaanyi okubeera n’obuyinza bungi.

Mu kunyiikira kwe kwonna okw’amaanyi, mwalimu eddoboozi ery’ekyama ery’okuggwaamu essuubi; teyasobola kubeera mu bulamu nga bwe yamanya nti kimugwanidde. Nnayogedde dda mu ssuula esooka nti mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe ezimu nnakiraba nti eddoboozi lino ery’okuggwaamu essuubi lyali liwulikika. Era tewali musumba eyali akwataganye ennyo n’emyoyo egyagala okubeerera Katonda yekka mu bujjuvu, “okutambula nga basiimibwa Mukama era nga bamusanyusa mu buli byonna,” atamanyi nti kino kiremesa okukulaakulana okwa nnamaddala. Bwe twogera ku kubulwa okusaba mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, n’okwegomba okubeera n’obulamu bw’okusaba obujjuvu, ebizibu ebituyolekera nga bingi nnyo! Tusazeewo emirundi mingi okusaba ennyo era obulungi okusinga, ne tulemererwa. Tetulina maanyi ga kwagala ng’agalina abalala abamu, abasobola okusalawo omulundi gumu ne bakyuka ne bakyusa empisa zaabwe. Obuvunaanyizibwa bwe tulina bukyatunyiga nga bwe bwali bulijjo; kizibu nnyo okufuna obudde obw’okusaba ennyo; essanyu erya nnamaddala mu kusaba, eryandituyambye okugumiikiriza, si lye tuwulira; tetulina maanyi ga kwegayirira n’okukaabirira Katonda nga bwe kitugwanidde; okusaba kwaffe, mu kifo ky’okubeera essanyu n’amaanyi, kufuuse ensibuko y’okwesalira omusango n’okubuusabuusa okutakoma. Oluusi tukungubagidde, ne twatula, ne tusalawo; naye, okwogera amazima gennyini, tetusuubira nkyukakyuka yonna ennene, kubanga tetulaba kkubo lyonna erigituusaako. Kyeyoleka bulungi nti kasita omwoyo guno gukyafuga, tewali ssuubi lingi lya kulongooka. Okuggwaamu amaanyi kuteekwa okuleeta okuwangulwa. Ekimu ku bintu omusawo by’asooka okufaako bulijjo kwe kuzuukusa essuubi; awatali lyo amanyi nti eddagala lye emirundi mingi terijja kuyamba nnyo. Tewali kuyigiriza kwonna okuva mu Kigambo kya Katonda ku buvunaanyizibwa, ku bwetaavu obw’amangu, ku nkizo ey’omukisa ey’okusaba ennyo, okusaba okulimu amaanyi, okujja okugasa, ng’akaama kano kakyawuubaala mu mutima nti: Tewali ssuubi. Ekyo kye tulina okusooka okufaako kwe kuzuula ensonga ekwekeddwa ereeta okulemererwa n’okuggwaamu essuubi, n’oluvannyuma okulaga nti okununulibwa okuva eri Katonda kukakafu ddala. Bwe tuba nga tetwagala kumatira na mbeera yaffe, tuteekwa okuwuliriza n’okwegatta ku kibuuzo kino: “Teri ddagala mu Gireyaadi? Teriiyo musawo? Lwaki ekiwundu ky’abantu bange tekiwonyezebwa?” Tuteekwa okuwuliriza, n’okuyingiza mu mutima gwaffe, ekisuubizo kya Katonda n’okuddamu kwe kwasisinkana: “Mukomeewo mmwe abantu abatali beesigwa, nnaabawonya ne mbafuula abeesigwa. … Weewaawo tujja kudda gy’oli, kubanga ggwe Mukama Katonda waffe.” Tuteekwa okujja buli omu n’okusaba kwe ye kennyini, n’okukkiriza nti ajja kuddibwamu ye kennyini. Kale tetusaanidde ne kaakano okutandika okukisaba ng’ekyaffe ku nsonga y’okubulwa okusaba, ne tukkiriza nti Katonda ajja kutuyamba: “Mponya, Ayi Mukama, nange nnaawona.” Bulijjo kikulu okwawula wakati w’obubonero bw’obulwadde n’obulwadde bwennyini. Obunafu n’okulemererwa mu kusaba kabonero k’obunafu mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Omulwadde singa asaba omusawo amuwe ekintu ekizuukusa okukuba kw’omusuwa gwe okunafu, yandigambiddwa nti ekyo tekyandimuyambye nnyo. Okukuba kw’omusuwa kye kipimo ky’embeera y’omutima n’omubiri gwonna: omusawo afuba okuzzaawo obulamu. Buli muntu ayagala okusaba n’obwesigwa n’amaanyi okusinga, kino ky’alina okuyiga: nti obulamu bwe bwonna obw’omwoyo buli mu mbeera ya bulwadde, era bwetaaga okuzzibwa obuggya. Bw’alitandika okutunuulira, si bunafu bwe mu kusaba bwokka, wabula n’okubulwa okuli mu bulamu bw’okukkiriza, obunafu obwo kwe kabonero kaakwo, lw’alitegeera ddala obuzito bw’obulwadde buno. Olwo aliraba obwetaavu bw’enkyukakyuka ey’omusingi mu bulamu bwe bwonna n’entambula ye, obanga obulamu bwe obw’okusaba, obutali birala wabula okukuba kw’omusuwa kw’omubiri gw’omwoyo, bulina okulaga obulamu obulungi n’amaanyi. Katonda yatutonda bw’atyo nti okukozesa buli kitundu ekiramu kireeta essanyu. Okusaba kwategekebwa okubeera okwangu era okw’obutonde ng’okussa omukka oba okukola eri omuntu omulamu obulungi. Obutayagala bwe tuwulira, n’okulemererwa kwe twatula, lye ddoboozi lya Katonda yennyini ng’atuyita okukkiriza obulwadde bwaffe, n’okujja gy’ali okufuna okuwonyezebwa kw’asuubizza. Kale bulwadde ki obwo okubulwa okusaba kwe kabonero kaabwo? Tetuyinza kufuna kuddamu kulungi okusinga okwo okulagibwa mu bigambo bino: “Temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda.” Wano tulagiddwa nti wayinza okubaawo engeri bbiri ez’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Wayinza okubaawo obulamu obuli ekitundu wansi w’amateeka n’ekitundu wansi w’ekisa; oba obulamu obuli wansi w’ekisa ddala, mu ddembe lyonna okuva mu kwefubitiriza, era nga bulaba mu bujjuvu amaanyi ga Katonda ekisa ge kiyinza okuwa. Omukkiriza owa nnamaddala ayinza okuba ng’akyabeera ekitundu wansi w’amateeka, mu maanyi g’okwefubitiriza, ng’agezaako okukola ky’atayinza kutuukiriza. Okulemererwa okutakoma mu bulamu bwe obw’Ekikristaayo kw’ayatula kuva ku kintu kino kimu: yeesiga yekka, era agezaako okukola kyonna ky’asobola. Ddala asaba era atunuulira Katonda okumuyamba, naye era ye yennyini mu maanyi ge, ng’ayambibwako Katonda, y’alina okukola omulimu. Mu bbaluwa eri Abaruumi, n’Abakkolinso, n’Abaggalatiya, tumanyi nga Pawulo bw’abagamba nti tebaaweebwa nate mwoyo gwa buddu, nti ba ddembe okuva mu mateeka, nti tebakyali baddu wabula baana; nti tewali kintu kye basaanidde kwegendereza okusinga okusibwa nate mu kikoligo ky’obuddu. Buli wantu kye kukontana wakati w’amateeka n’ekisa, wakati w’omubiri, oguli wansi w’amateeka, n’Omwoyo, ye kirabo ky’ekisa, era mu ye ekisa mwe kikolera omulimu gwakyo gwonna. Mu nnaku zaffe, nga bwe kyali mu mirembe egyo egyasooka, akabi akasinga obunene kwe kubeera wansi w’amateeka, n’okuweereza Katonda mu maanyi g’omubiri. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi kirabika eyo ye mbeera mwe basigala obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Eyo ye nsonga lwaki obulamu obutukuvu obwa nnamaddala n’amaanyi mu kusaba bibulwa nnyo bwe bityo. Tebamanyi nti okulemererwa kwonna kuyinza okuba n’ensonga emu yokka: Abantu banoonya okukola bo bennyini ekyo ekisa kyokka kye kiyinza okukola mu bo, ekyo ekisa kye kijja okukola awatali kubuusabuusa. Bangi tebajja kwetegekera kukkiriza nti buno bwe bulwadde bwabwe, nti tebabeera “wansi w’ekisa.” Tekiyinzika, bwe bagamba. “Okuva ku ntobo y’omutima gwange,” Omukristaayo bw’akaaba, “nzikiriza era mmanyi nti mu nze temuli kirungi, era nti byonna mbifuna lwa kisa kyokka.” “Obulamu bwange bwonna,” omusumba bw’agamba, “mbumazze nga mbuulira era ngulumiza enjigiriza z’ekisa eky’obwereere, era mu ekyo mwe nnafunira ekitiibwa kyange.” “Ate nze,” omuminsani bw’addamu, “nnandisobodde ntya n’okulowooza okulaba abatamanyi Katonda nga balokolebwa, singa obwesige bwange bwokka tebwali mu bubaka bwe nnaleeta, ne mu maanyi ge nnesiga, ag’ekisa kya Katonda ekisukkirivu?” Ddala toyinza kugamba nti okulemererwa kwaffe mu kusaba, kwe twatula n’ennaku, kuva ku butabeera kwaffe “wansi w’ekisa”? Buno tebuyinza kuba bulwadde bwaffe. Tumanyi nga emirundi mingi omuntu bw’ayinza okuba ng’alwadde obulwadde nga tabumanyi. Ky’alowooza nti kirwadde kitono kikyuka ne kiba obulwadde obw’akabi. Tuleme kwekakasa nnyo nti tetukyabeera, mu kigero ekinene, “wansi w’amateeka,” nga bwe twerowooza nti tubeera ddala “wansi w’ekisa.” Emirundi mingi ensonga y’ensobi eno y’amakulu amatono agaweebwa ekigambo “ekisa.” Nga bwe tukomya Katonda yennyini, olw’ebirowoozo byaffe ebitono oba eby’obutakkiriza gy’ali, bwe tutyo bwe tukomya ekisa kye mu kiseera kyennyini kye tusanyukira ebigambo nga “obugagga bw’ekisa,” “ekisa ekingi ennyo.” Ekigambo kyennyini “ekisa ekisukkirivu,” okuva ku kitabo kya Bunyan n’okweyongerayo, tekikugiddwa ku mazima amanene ag’omukisa agamu gokka ag’okuweebwa obutuukirivu ku bwereere, wamu n’okusonyiyibwa okuzzibwa obuggya buli kiseera n’ekitiibwa eky’emirembe gyonna eri aboonoonyi abasingayo okuba ababi, so nga amazima amalala ag’omukisa ge gamu ag’“ekisa ekisukkirivu” mu kutukuzibwa tegamanyiddwa mu bujjuvu? Pawulo awandiika nti: “… abaliweebwa ekisa kya Katonda … tebalisinga nnyo okufugira mu bulamu olw’omuntu omu Yesu Kristo?” Okufugira okwo mu bulamu, ng’omuwanguzi w’ekibi, kuli wano ku nsi. “Ekibi bwe kyeyongera” mu mutima ne mu bulamu, “ekisa kya Katonda kyo ne kyeyongera nnyo okusingawo,” ekisa kiryoke kifugire mu butuukirivu mu bulamu bwonna ne mu buntu bwonna obw’omukkiriza. Ku kufuga kuno okw’ekisa mu mwoyo Pawulo kw’abuuza nti, “Kale tukole ekibi kubanga tetufugibwa mateeka wabula ekisa kya Katonda?” n’addamu nti, “Kikafuuwe.” Ekisa si kusonyiyibwa ebibi kwokka, wabula maanyi agawangula ekibi; ekisa kitwala ekifo ekibi kye kyalina mu bulamu, era kyeyama, nga ekibi bwe kyafuganga munda mu maanyi g’okufa, okufuga mu maanyi g’obulamu bwa Kristo. Ku kisa kino Kristo kwe yayogerako nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala,” Pawulo n’addamu nti, “… nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange … kubanga buli bwe mba omunafu, olwo nga ndi wa maanyi.” Ku kisa kino, ekijja okukola byonna mu ffe bwe twetegefu okwatula nti tetulina maanyi n’akatono era tetuyinza kwebeesaawo, Pawulo kw’ayigiriza awalala nti, “Katonda ayinza okwaza ekisa kyonna gye muli, bulijjo mubeerenga n’ebibamala byonna mu buli kintu nga musukkirira mu mulimu gwonna omulungi.” Kitera okubaawo nti omuntu anoonya Katonda n’obulokozi asoma Bayibuli ye okumala ebbanga ddene, naye n’atalaba mazima ag’okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza, ku bwereere, mu bujjuvu, era amangu ago. Amaaso ge bwe gaazibuka, n’agakkiriza, yewuunya okugasanga buli wamu. Bwe kityo n’abakkiriza bangi, abakwata enjigiriza z’ekisa eky’obwereere nga zikwata ku kusonyiyibwa, tebalabanga makulu gaakyo ag’ekitalo nga kyeyama okukola obulamu bwaffe bwonna mu ffe, era n’okutuwa ddala amaanyi buli kaseera olw’ekyo kyonna Kitaffe ky’ayagala tubeere era tukole. Ekitangaala kya Katonda bwe kyakira mu mutima gwaffe n’amazima gano ag’omukisa, tutegeera Pawulo ky’ategeeza bw’agamba nti, “… si nze nakola wabula ekisa kya Katonda …” Era wano olaba obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’engeri ebbiri. Obumu, mwe “Si nze”—siri kintu, siyinza kukola kintu—tekinnafuuka kya nnamaddala. Obulala, okuwaanyisiganya okw’ekitalo bwe kumala okubaawo, ekisa ne kitwala ekifo ky’okufuba kwaffe, ne tugamba era ne tumanya nti, “ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze.” Olwo kiyinza okufuuka kye tuyitamu obulamu bwaffe bwonna: “Mukama waffe yankwatirwa ekisa kingi n’ampa okukkiriza kungi, era n’okwagala kwe tufunira mu Kristo Yesu.” Omwana wa Katonda omwagalwa! Olowooza otya, tekiyinzika nti kino kye kibadde kibulamu mu bulamu bwo, ensonga y’okulemererwa kwo mu kusaba? Tewamanya ekisa bwe kyandikusobozesezza okusaba, singa obulamu bwonna bwali bufugibwa amaanyi gaakyo. Wanoonya okuwangula obutayagala bwo oba obufu bwo mu kusaba ng’ofuba ennyo, naye n’olemererwa. Wagezaako okwesiikuula okusaba ng’okozesa buli nsonga ey’ensonyi oba ey’okwagala gye wasobola okulowoozaako, naye tekyakuyamba. Tekisaanidde kubuuza Mukama obanga obubaka bwe nkuleetedde nga omuweereza we tebuyinza kuba bwa mazima gy’oli okusinga bw’olowooza? Okubulwa okusaba kwo kuva ku mbeera y’obulamu erwadde, era obulwadde obwo si kirala wabula kino—tonnakkiriza, mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku ne mu buli buvunaanyizibwa, obulokozi obujjuvu ekigambo kino bwe kireeta: “Temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda.” Ebyo ekisa bye kitegese n’amaanyi kye kitusobozesa okufugira mu bulamu bibuna wonna era bigenda wala munda nga bye amateeka gasaba n’okufuga kw’ekibi, weewaawo bisukkirira nnyo okusingawo. (Laba Ekyongerezo B.) Mu ssuula eddirira eyo Pawulo mwe yawandiikira nti, “Temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda,” atuwa ekifaananyi ky’obulamu bw’omukkiriza ali wansi w’amateeka, n’ebikaawa by’ayitamu ebikoma mu kukaaba nti: “Nga ndi muntu munaku! Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa?” Okuddamu kwe eri ekibuuzo ekyo, “Katonda yeebazibwe mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.” kulaga nti waliwo okununulibwa okuva mu bulamu obusibiddwa mu busibe bw’empisa embi ze tulwanyisizza obwereere. Okununulibwa okwo kuyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, atuwa okulaba mu bujjuvu obulamu bwa Kristo kye buyinza okukola mu ffe: “Etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu, lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.” Etteeka lya Katonda lyali lisobola kututeeka mu buyinza bw’etteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa kyokka. Ekisa kya Katonda kisobola okutuyingiza, n’okutukuuma, mu ddembe ly’Omwoyo. Tusobola okufuulibwa ab’eddembe okuva mu bulamu obw’ennaku obwali wansi w’obuyinza obwatutwala mu busibe, ne tutakola kye twagala. Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo asobola okutununula okuva mu kulemererwa kwaffe okutakoma mu kusaba, n’atusobozesa ne mu kino okutambula nga tusiimibwa Mukama era nga tumusanyusa mu buli byonna. Ayi! toggwaamu ssuubi, toggwaamu maanyi; waliwo eddagala mu Gireyaadi; waliyo Omusawo; waliwo okuwonyezebwa olw’obulwadde bwaffe. Ebitayinzika eri abantu, biyinzika eri Katonda. Ky’otalabamu ngeri yonna ey’okukikola, ekisa kijja kukikola. Yatula obulwadde; wesige Omusawo; saba okuwonyezebwa nga kwe kwo; saba okusaba okw’okukkiriza nti, “Mponya, nange nnaawona.” Naawe osobola okufuuka omuntu ow’okusaba, n’osaba okusaba okw’amaanyi okubeera n’obuyinza bungi.

fields.title: Oyagala Okuwonyezebwa?
fields.body_html:
“Yesu … n’amubuuza nti, Oyagala okuwonyezebwa? Omusajja omulwadde n’amuddamu nti, Ssebo sirina muntu ayinza kunnyamba okunsuula mu kidiba … Yesu n’amugamba nti, Situka ozingeko omukeeka gwo otambule. Amangwago omusajja n’awonyezebwa. N’azingako omukeeka gwe ne yeetambulira.”—Yokaana 5:6–9.

“Peetero n’agamba nti, Mu linnya lya Yesu Omunnazaaleesi Golokoka, otambule!… Okukkiriza mu ye kwe kuwadde omusajja ono obulamu obutuukiridde nga mwenna bwe mulaba.”—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 3:6, 16.

“Peetero n’amugamba nti, Ayineya! Yesu Kristo akuwonya. Golokoka weeyalire! Amangwago n’awonyezebwa.”—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:34.

Obunafu mu kusaba kabonero ka bulwadde. Obutasobola kutambula, mu Mukristaayo nga bwe kiri ne mu bulamu obw’omubiri, bukakafu obw’entiisa nti mu mubiri mulimu ekintu ekibi ekyetaaga omusawo. Okubulwa amaanyi okutambula n’essanyu mu kkubo eriggya era eddamu eridda eri Kitaffe n’eri entebe ey’ekisa kya nnaku nnyo. Kristo ye Musawo omukulu, ajja ku buli Besusayida awakuŋŋaanidde abalwadde abatasobola kutambula, n’abuuza ekibuuzo kye eky’okwagala era ekinoonyereza omutima: Oyagala okuwonyezebwa? Eri bonna abakyanywerera ku ssuubi lyabwe mu kidiba, oba abanoonya omuntu yenna okubasuulamu, abasuubira nti oluvannyuma lw’ebbanga, mu ngeri emu oba endala, bajja kuyambibwa olw’okweyongera obweyongezi okukozesa engeri eza bulijjo ez’okufunamu ekisa, ekibuuzo kye kibalaga ekkubo erisingako. Abawa okuwonyezebwa mu ngeri ey’amaanyi gye batategeerangako. Era eri bonna abeetegefu okwatula, si bunafu bwabwe bwokka, naye n’okulemererwa kwabwe okufuna omuntu yenna okubayamba, ekibuuzo kye kibaleetera essuubi ekkakafu era ery’amazima ery’okununulibwa okuli okumpi. Tulabye nti obunafu bwaffe mu kusaba kitundu ku bulamu obukubiddwa obulwadde bw’omwoyo obw’obutasobola. Kale tuwulirize Mukama waffe ng’atuwa okutuzzaamu amaanyi gaffe ag’omwoyo, okututeekateeka okutambula ng’abasajja abalamu era ab’amaanyi mu makubo gonna aga Mukama, bwe tutyo tusobole okutuukiriza obulungi ekifo kyaffe mu mulimu omunene ogw’okwegayiririra abalala. Bwe tunaalaba okuwona kw’atuwa bwe kuli, engeri gy’akutuwaamu, ne ky’atusaba, tujja kuba twetegese okuddamu ekibuuzo kye n’omutima ogwagala.

Okuwona Yesu kw’Atuwa Kye Kuli.

Nnyinza okwogera ku bubonero bungi obw’obulamu obulungi obw’omwoyo. Ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kitukulembera okukwata akamu,—okutambula. Yesu yagamba omulwadde nti, Situka otambule, era n’ekigambo ekyo n’amuzza mu kifo kye mu bantu ng’alina obulamu obulungi obujjuvu n’amaanyi, ng’asobola okukola omugabo gwe mu mirimu gyonna egy’obulamu. Kifaananyi kya kitalo ekiraga okuzzibwamu obulamu obulungi obw’omwoyo. Eri omulamu, okutambula kya ssanyu; eri omulwadde, mugugu, oba n’okusingawo, kye kitasoboka. Abakristaayo bameka abaliwo, abali ng’abagongobavu, abawenyera, abalema n’abatasobola kutambula, okutambula n’okweyongerayo mu kkubo lya Katonda gye kiri okufuba okw’amaanyi n’okukoowa! Kristo ajja okugamba, era wamu n’ekigambo kye awaayo n’amaanyi: Situka otambule.

Lowooza ku kutambula kuno kw’atuzzaamu era kw’atuwa amaanyi. Bwe bulamu ng’obwa Enoka ne Nuuwa, buli omu ku bo “yatambula ne Katonda.” Bwe bulamu ng’obwa Ibulayimu, Katonda gwe yagamba nti, “tambulira mu maaso gange,” era ye yennyini n’ayogera nti, “Mukama oyo gwe ntambulira mu maaso ge.” Bwe bulamu Dawudi bw’ayimbako nti, “Ayi Mukama, banaatambuliranga” mu musana gw’amaaso go, era Isaaya bwe yalagulako nti, “abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, … balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika.” Nga Katonda Omutonzi bw’atazirika so takoowa, n’abo abatambula naye, nga bamulindirira, tebaliggwaamu maanyi n’akatono, wadde okunafuwa. Bwe bulamu obwayogerwako ku batukuvu ab’enkomerero ab’Endagaano Enkadde, Zaakaliya ne Erisabesi, nti “bombi baali batuukirivu mu maaso ga Katonda, era nga batambulira mu mateeka ga Katonda gonna, ne mu biragiro bya Mukama, nga tebaliiko kya kunenyezebwa.” Kuno kwe kutambula Yesu kwe yajja okufuula okusoboka era okw’amazima eri abantu be, mu maanyi agasinga ku ga bulijjo.

Wulira Endagaano Empya ky’ekwogerako: “Nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa okuva mu bafu olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe, naffe … tutambulirenga mu bulamu obwo obuggya.” Oyo Eyazuukira y’atugamba nti, Situka otambule: atuwa amaanyi g’obulamu obw’okuzuukira. Kwe kutambula mu Kristo. “Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye.” Kwe kutambula nga Kristo. “Oyo agamba nti ali mu ye, asaana okutambula nga Mukama waffe yennyini bwe yatambula.” Kwe kutambula mu Mwoyo era okugoberera Omwoyo. “Mutambulirenga mu Mwoyo, mu ngeri yonna, mulemenga kutuukiriza kwegomba kwa mubiri.” “Abatatambulira mu mubiri naye abatambulira mu Mwoyo.” Kwe kutambula okusaanira Katonda era okumusanyusa. “Mutambulenga nga musiimibwa Mukama era nga mumusanyusa mu buli byonna bye mukola, era nga mubala ebibala mu buli mulimu omulungi.” “Tubeegayirira … nti nga bwe twababuulirira bwe kibagwanira okutambula n’okusanyusa Katonda, era nga bwe mukola bwe mutyo, mugende mu maaso okukolanga bwe mutyo n’okusingawo.” Kwe kutambula mu kwagala okw’omu ggulu. Mutambulirenga mu kwagala, “nga Kristo bwe yatwagala.” Kwe kutambula “mu musana nga ye bw’ali omusana.” Kwe kutambula kw’okukkiriza, amaanyi gaakwo gonna nga gava butereevu eri Katonda ne Kristo n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, eri emmeeme ekyusizza amaaso gaayo okuva ku nsi. “Tutambula lwa kukkiriza so si lw’amaaso gaffe bye galaba.”

Abakkiriza bameka abatunuulira okutambula ng’okwo ng’ekintu ekitasoboka—ekitasoboka ennyo ne kiba nti tebawulira nga kibi okuba nga “batambula mu ngeri endala”; bwe batyo tebeegomba kutambula kuno mu bulamu obuggya. Bamanyidde nnyo obulamu obw’obunafu, ne kiba nti obulamu n’okutambula mu maanyi ga Katonda tebibasikiriza nnyo. Naye waliwo abamu abatali bwe batyo. Beebuuza ddala obanga ebigambo bino bitegeeza ddala kye byogera, era obanga obulamu obw’ekitalo buli kimu ku byo kye kyogerako kirooto bulooto ekitatuukibwako, oba nti kyategekebwa okutuukirira mu bantu ab’omubiri n’omusaayi. Gye bakoma okubyetegereza, gye bakoma okuwulira nti byayogerwa ng’eby’obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Naye era birabika nga biri waggulu nnyo. Singa nno bakkiriza nti Katonda yatuma Omwana we Ayinzabyonna, n’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, ddala okututuusa n’okututeekateeka mu bulamu n’okutambula okuva mu ggulu, okusinga byonna omuntu by’ayinza okwetantala okulowooza oba okusuubira.

Engeri Yesu gy’Atuwonyaamu.

Omusawo bw’awonya omulwadde, amukolako ng’ayima bweru, era akola ekintu ekigendererwa, bwe kiba kisoboka, okumufuula oluvannyuma atakyetaaga buyambi bwe. Amuzzaamu obulamu obulungi obutuukiridde, n’amuleka. Omulimu gwa Mukama waffe Yesu gukontana ddala nagwo mu nsonga zombi. Yesu takola ng’ayima bweru, wabula ng’ayima munda, ng’ayingira Ye yennyini mu maanyi g’Omwoyo we mu bulamu bwaffe ddala. Era mu kifo ky’okufuulibwa, nga bwe kiri mu kuwonya omubiri, abatakyetaaga musawo mu biseera eby’omu maaso, ekigendererwa kya Kristo ekimu mu kuwonya kikontana ddala n’ekyo, nga bwe twayogedde. Ekisaanyizo kye ekimu eky’okutuuka ku buwanguzi kwe kutuleeta mu kwesigama ku Ye ennyo ne kiba nti tetusobola kumala kaseera na kamu nga tetumulina. Kristo Yesu yennyini bwe bulamu bwaffe, mu ngeri Abakristaayo bangi gye batategeerangako n’akamu. Obulamu obunafu era obulwalirivu obusangibwa mu bangi buva ddala ku butategeera mazima gano aga Katonda: nti kasita tusuubira Kristo okutukoleranga ekintu okuva mu ggulu, mu bikolwa by’ekisa ebimu ebimu buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera, era buli mulundi ne tumwesiga okutuwa ekyo ekinaamala akaseera katono, tetuyinza kuzzibwamu bulamu obulungi obutuukiridde. Naye bwe tumala okulaba nga tewaliba kintu kyaffe ku bwaffe wadde akaseera akamu, era nga kiriba Kristo yekka buli kaseera, ne tuyiga okukikkiriza okuva gy’ali n’okumwesiga olw’ekyo, obulamu bwa Kristo bufuuka obulamu obulungi obw’emmeeme yaffe. Obulamu obulungi si kirala wabula obulamu nga bukola mu ngeri yaabwo eya bulijjo, nga tebutaataaganyizibwa. Kristo atuwa obulamu obulungi ng’atuwa Ye yennyini okuba obulamu bwaffe; bw’atyo afuuka amaanyi gaffe ag’okutambula. Ebigambo bya Isaaya bituukirira mu Ndagaano Empya: Abo abalindirira Mukama balitambula ne batazirika, kubanga kaakano Kristo ge maanyi ag’obulamu bwabwe.

Kyewuunyisa engeri abakkiriza gye batera okulowooza nti obulamu buno obw’okwesigama mugugu ogusukkiridde, era nti kufiirwa eddembe lyaffe ery’obuntu. Bakkiriza nti kyetaagisa okwesigama, okwesigama ennyo, naye nga wasigaddewo ebbanga ly’okwagala kwaffe n’amaanyi gaffe. Tebalaba nti n’okwesigama okw’ekitundu kutufuula abali mu bbanja, ne kututalekera kintu kya kwenyumiririzaamu. Beerabira nti enkolagana yaffe ne Katonda, n’okukolera awamu naye, si nti Ye akola ekitundu ekisinga obunene ate ffe ne tukola ekitono, wabula nti Katonda akola byonna era ffe tukola byonna—Katonda byonna mu ffe, ffe byonna nga tuyita mu Katonda. Okwesigama kuno ku Katonda kwe kutuwa eddembe lyaffe ery’amazima; okwagala kwaffe bwe kutanoonya kirala kyonna wabula Katonda by’ayagala, tutuuka ku kitiibwa eky’obwakatonda, eddembe ery’amazima eritesigama ku kintu kyonna ekyatondebwa. Oyo atannalaba kino ateekwa okusigala Omukristaayo omulwalirivu, ng’aleka ye yennyini okukola ekitundu ne Kristo ekitundu. Oyo akkiriza obulamu obw’okwesigama ku Kristo obutakoma, ng’obulamu, obulamu obulungi era amaanyi, awonyezebwa. Nga Katonda, Kristo asobola okuyingira n’afuuka obulamu bw’ekitonde kye. Ng’Oyo Agulumiziddwa eyaweebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okuva eri Kitaffe okumugaba, asobola okuzza obuggya omutima gw’ekitonde ekyonoonyi n’agufuula amaka ge, era olw’okubeerawo kwe n’agukuuma mu bulamu obulungi obujjuvu n’amaanyi.

Mmwe mwenna abandyagadde okutambula n’okusanyusa Katonda, era mu bulamu bwammwe obw’okusaba omutima gwammwe guleme kubasalira musango, muwulirize ebigambo bya Kristo: “Oyagala okuwonyezebwa?” Asobola okuwa emmeeme obulamu obulungi. Asobola okuwa obulamu obusobola okusaba, ne bumanya nti busanyusa Kitaffe. Bw’oba oyagala kino, jjangu owulire engeri gy’oyinza okukifunamu.

Kristo Ky’Atusaba.

Emboozi eno etuyita okwetegereza ennyo ebintu bisatu. Ekibuuzo kya Kristo kisooka kwogera eri okwagala kw’omuntu, ne kisaba akakase nti akkiriza. Oluvannyuma awuliriza omuntu ng’ayatula obutasobola bwe bwonna. Ate oluvannyuma ne wajja obuwulize obw’amangu eri ekiragiro kya Kristo, obusituka ne butambula.

1. Oyagala okuwonyezebwa? Ku ky’omusajja omulwadde kye yandizzeemu tewaali kubuusabuusa. Ani atandyagadde bulwadde bwe kumuggibwako? Naye kitalo, mu bulamu obw’omwoyo nga kyetaagisa nnyo okukaatiriza ekibuuzo kino! Abamu tebakkiriza nti balwadde nnyo bwe batyo. Abalala tebakkiriza nti Kristo asobola okuwonya omuntu ddala. N’abalala bakikkiriza ku lw’abalala, naye bakakasa nti si kya bo. Ku kikolo kya byonna kuliko okutya okwefiiriza n’okuwaayo ssaddaaka ebinaabeetaagisa. Tebaagala kuleka ddala kutambula ng’emirembe egy’ensi bwe giri, okulekayo byonna eby’okwagala kwabwe, n’okwesiga kwabwe ku bwabwe, n’okwesanyusa. Okutambula mu Kristo era nga Kristo kufunda nnyo era kuzibu: tebakwagala, tebaagala kuwonyezebwa. Muganda wange, bw’oba ng’oyagala, kyogere: “Mukama! ka kibe kya muwendo ki, njagala!” Ku ludda lwa Kristo, kikolwa kya kwagala: “Njagala, longooka.” Ne ku ludda lwo bwe kityo: “Kikukolerwe nga bw’oyagala.” Bw’oba oyagala okununulibwa mu butasobola bwo—oh, totya kugamba nti, “Njagala, njagala!”

Oluvannyuma ne wajja eddaala ery’okubiri. Kristo ayagala tumutunuulire nga Omuyambi waffe yekka. “Sirina muntu ayinza kunnyamba okunsuula mu kidiba,” kye kiteekwa okuba okukaaba kwaffe. Wano ku nsi tewali buyambi gye ndi. Obunafu buyinza okukula ne bufuuka amaanyi mu kukozesa engeri eza bulijjo, singa ebitundu byonna eby’omubiri n’emirimu gyabyo biri bulungi. Obulwadde bwetaaga eddagala ery’enjawulo. Emmeeme yo ndwadde; obutasobola bwo okutambula n’essanyu okutambula okw’Ekikristaayo mu kkubo lya Katonda kabonero ka bulwadde; totya kukyatula, n’okukkiriza nti tewali ssuubi lya kuwona okuggyako nga Kristo akuwonyezza olw’okusaasira kwe. Leka ekirowoozo eky’okukula okuva mu mbeera ey’obulwadde okutuuka mu bulamu obulungi, okukula okuva wansi w’amateeka okutuuka mu bulamu obufugibwa ekisa. Ennaku ntono emabega nawulira omuyizi ng’awolereza ensonga y’Endagaano y’Abeewaayo (Volunteer Pledge). “Endagaano eno,” bw’atyo bwe yagamba, “ebayita okusalawo. Temulowooza kukula mpolampola okufuuka omuminsani: okuggyako nga Katonda abagaanye, mutwale eddaala eryo; okusalawo kujja kubaleetera essanyu n’amaanyi, kujja kubasumulula okukula mu buli kyetaagisa omuminsani, era kujja kuyamba n’abalala.” Ne mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo bwe kiri. Okulwisaawo n’okufuba byombi bijja kukulemesa; yatula nti tosobola kwereetera kusaba nga bw’oyagala, kubanga tosobola kwewa bulamu obulungi obw’omu ggulu obwagala okusaba, era obumanyi okwesiga Omwoyo wa Katonda okusaba mu ffe. Jjangu eri Kristo akuwonye. Mu kaseera kamu asobola okukuwonya. Si mu ngeri ya kukyusa mangu by’owulira, oba ky’oli ggwe wennyini, wabula mu mazima ag’omu ggulu ag’okuyingira kwe—ng’addamu okwewaayo kwo n’okukkiriza kwo—n’afuga obulamu bwo obw’omunda, n’abujjuza Ye yennyini n’Omwoyo we.

Ekintu eky’okusatu Kristo ky’asaba kye kino: okwewaayo okw’okukkiriza. Bwe yayogera n’omusajja omulwadde, ekigambo kye eky’ekiragiro kyali kiteekwa okugonderwa. Omusajja yakkiriza nti mu kigambo kya Kristo mwalimu amazima n’amaanyi; mu kukkiriza okwo n’asituka n’atambula. Olw’okukkiriza n’agonda. Era Kristo kye yagamba abalala kyali kikwata ne ku ye—“Ggenda, okukkiriza kwo kukuwonyezza.” Naffe Kristo atusaba okukkiriza kuno, nti ekigambo kye kikyusa obutasobola bwaffe ne bufuuka amaanyi, era kututeekateeka okutambula mu bulamu obuggya bwe twafuulibwa abalamu mu ye. Bwe tutakkiriza kino, bwe tutaagala kuguma ne twogera ne Pawulo nti, “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” tetuyinza kugonda. Naye bwe tunaawuliriza ekigambo ekitubuulira ku kutambula okutali nti kusoboka kyokka, wabula okwakakasibwa era ne kulabibwa mu batukuvu ba Katonda okuva edda, bwe tunaatunuulira Kristo ow’amaanyi, omulamu, ow’okwagala, ayogera n’obuyinza nti, “Situka otambule,” tujja kuguma tugonde. Tujja kusituka tutandike okutambula mu ye ne mu maanyi ge. Mu kukkiriza, nga tetwesigamye ku nneewulira era nga tugisukkulumye, tujja kukkiriza era twesige Kristo atalabika nga ge maanyi gaffe, era tugende mu maaso mu maanyi ga Mukama Katonda. Tujja kumanya Kristo nga ge maanyi ag’obulamu bwaffe. Tujja kumanya, tubuulire, era tukakase nti Yesu Kristo atuwonyezza.

Kino ddala kiyinza okubaawo? Yee, kiyinza. Akikoledde bangi: ajja kukikola ne ku lulwo. Weegendereze obutakola birowoozo bikyamu ku ekyo ekiteekwa okubaawo. Omusajja omulwadde bwe yawonyezebwa, yali akyalina okuyiga byonna ku ngeri y’okukozesaamu amaanyi ge amapya ge yali yaakafuna. Bwe yandyagadde okulima, oba okuzimba, oba okuyiga omulimu ogw’emikono, yalina okutandikira ku ntandikwa. Tosuubira mangu ago kuba mukugu mu kusaba oba mu kitundu kyonna eky’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Nedda; naye suubira era beera mukakafu ku kintu kino kimu: nti nga bw’omaze okwewaayo eri Kristo okuba obulamu bwo obulungi n’amaanyi go, ajja kukukulembera era akuyigirize. Tandika okusaba ng’oli mukkakkamu ng’omanyi obutamanya bwo n’obunafu bwo, naye ng’olina obukakafu obw’essanyu nti ajja kukola mu ggwe ekyo ky’oyetaaga. Situka otambule buli lunaku ng’olina obwesige obutukuvu nti ali naawe era ali mu ggwe. Kkiriza bukkiriza Yesu Kristo, Omulamu, era omwesige akole omulimu gwe.

Onookikola? Okikoze? Ne kaakano Yesu ayogera nti, “Situka otambule.” “Amiina, Mukama! Olw’ekigambo kyo nzija. Nsituka okutambula naawe, ne mu ggwe, era nga ggwe.”
