Obanga Katonda Kwagala okutakoma, era asanyuka okugaba okusinga ffe bwe tusanyuka okufuna, lwaki twetaaga okwegayirira n’okumeggana, okukoowoola n’amaanyi, n’okulwawo okw’ebbanga eddene, Ebyawandiikibwa n’ebyo bye tuyitamu bye byogerako? Okuva mu kino wavaamu ekibuuzo ekirala—eky’okusaba okungi ennyo okulabika ng’okw’obwereere era okutaddibwamu. Bameka abegayiridde ku lw’abaagalwa baabwe, ne bafa nga tebalokose. Bameka abakaabira emyaka n’emyaka olw’omukisa ogw’omwoyo, ne watabaawo kuddibwamu. Okulowooza ku bino byonna kugezesa okukkiriza kwaffe, era kutuleetera okubuusabuusa bwe tugamba nti, “Katonda wange anampulira.” Abaagalwa! Okusaba, mu maanyi gaakwo eri Katonda, n’obwesigwa bwe eri ekisuubizo kye eky’okukuwulira, kyama kya mwoyo eky’ebuziba. Ku bibuuzo ebyogeddwako waggulu wayinza okuweebwa eby’okuddamu ebiggyawo ekitundu ku buzibu. Naye, ku nkomerero, ekisooka era ekisembayo ekiteekwa okwogerwa kye kino: Nga bwe tutayinza kutegeera Katonda, bwe tutyo tetuyinza kutegeera kino, ekimu ku bisinga okuba eby’omukisa mu ngeri ze, nti awulira okusaba. Kyama kya mwoyo—tekiri wansi wa kyama ky’Obusatu Obutukuvu. Katonda awulira kubanga tusaba mu Mwana we, kubanga Omwoyo Omutukuvu asaba mu ffe. Obanga tukkirizza era twegwanyizza obulamu bwa Kristo ng’obulamu bwaffe obulungi, n’obujjuvu bw’Omwoyo ng’amaanyi gaffe, tuleme kubuusabuusa kukkiriza ne mu maanyi g’okusaba kwaffe. Omwoyo Omutukuvu asobola okutusobozesa okukikkiriza n’okukisanyukira, ne bwe kiba nga si buli kibuuzo nti kiddiddwamu. Ajja kukikola bwe tunaatwalanga ebibuuzo byaffe ne tubiteeka mu kifuba kya Katonda, ne twesiga obwesigwa bwe, ne twewaayo mu bwetoowaze okugondera ekiragiro kye eky’okusabanga obutayosa. Buli mulimu gw’obukugu gubikkula ebyama byagwo n’obulungi bwagwo eri oyo yekka agukola. Eri omwoyo omwetoowaze asaba mu buwulize obw’okukkiriza, akola omulimu gw’okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala n’obunyiikivu kubanga Katonda akisaba, ekyama kya Mukama kijja kumubikkulirwa, era okulowooza ku kyama ky’okusaba eky’ebuziba, mu kifo ky’okuba ekizibu ekikooya, kijja kufuuka ensibuko y’essanyu, okusinza, n’okukkiriza, mwe muwulirwa buli kiseera oluyimba olutakoma: “Katonda wange anampulira!” 4. “Katonda wange anampulira.” Obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amaanyi!—Emirundi emeka gye twemulugunya olw’ekizikiza, olw’obunafu, olw’okulemererwa, ng’abatalina buyambi! Ate nga Katonda yasuubiza, ng’addamu okusaba kwaffe, okutuwa buli kye twetaaga, n’okutuwa omusana gwe, amaanyi ge, n’emirembe gye. Singa twategeera obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okuba ne Katonda ali bw’atyo, n’ebisuubizo ebiri bwe bityo, wamu n’ekibi n’ensonyi ez’obutabikozesa mu bujjuvu bwabyo bwonna! Nga twandibadde bakakafu nti ekisa, kye twakkiriza era kye twesiga okutusobozesa okusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, kijja kutuweebwa! Waliwo n’ekisingawo. Ekkubo lino okutuuka eri Katonda awulira okusaba ligendereddwamu ddala okutufuula abegayirizi ku lw’abantu bannaffe. Nga Kristo bwe yafuna eddembe lye ery’okwegayiririra okuwangula ng’awaayo obulamu bwe nga ssaddaaka eri Katonda ku lw’abantu, era ku bw’ekyo n’afuna emikisa gy’agaba, bwe tutyo, bwe tuba nga ddala twewaddeyo wamu ne Kristo eri Katonda ku lw’abantu, tugabana naye eddembe lye ery’okwegayiririra abalala, era tusobola okubafunira n’amaanyi ag’ensi ey’omu ggulu. Obuyinza bw’obulamu n’okufa buli mu mikono gyaffe (1 Yokaana 5:16). Mu kuddamu okusaba, Omwoyo ayinza okufukibwa, emyoyo giyinza okukyuka, abakkiriza bayinza okunywezebwa. Mu kusaba, obwakabaka bw’ekizikiza buyinza okuwangulwa, emyoyo ne giggibwa mu kkomera ne gituusibwa mu ddembe lya Kristo, n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda ne kibikkulwa. Ku bw’okusaba, ekitala eky’Omwoyo, kye kigambo kya Katonda, kiyinza okukozesebwa n’amaanyi, era, mu kubuulira mu lujjudde nga ne mu kwogera n’omuntu kinnoomu, abajeemu abasingayo ne baleetebwa okuvunnama ku bigere bya Yesu. Obuvunaanyizibwa nga bunene ku Kkanisa okwewaayo eri omulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala! Obuvunaanyizibwa nga bunene ku buli musumba, omuminsani, omukozi, eyayawulibwa olw’okulokola emyoyo, okwewaayo ddala okutuukiriza n’okukakasa okukkiriza kwe: “Katonda wange anampulira!” Era nga kino kuyita kwa maanyi eri buli mukkiriza, mu kifo ky’okuziika n’okubuza ttalanta eno, okufuba ennyo ddala okugikozesa mu kusaba n’okwegayirira ku lw’abatukuvu bonna ne ku lw’abantu bonna. Katonda wange anampulira: Gye tukoma okuyingira ennyo mu mazima g’obuyinza buno obw’ekitalo Katonda bwe yawa abantu, gye tukoma okwewaayo n’omutima gwaffe gwonna eri omulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala. 5. “Katonda wange anampulira.” Essuubi ery’omukisa!—Kaakano ndaba—okulemererwa kwange kwonna mu bulamu bwange obwayita kwava ku kubulwa okukkiriza kuno. Okulemererwa kwange, naddala mu mulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala, kubadde n’ekikolo kyako ekisinga obuziba mu kino—saabeeranga mu kukkiriza okujjuvu okw’obukakafu obw’omukisa nti, “Katonda wange anampulira!” Katonda yeebazibwe! Ntandise okukiraba—nkikkiriza. Byonna biyinza okuba eby’enjawulo. Oba, okusingawo, ndaba Ye, mmukkiriza. “Katonda wange anampulira!” Weewaawo, nze, nze ddala! Wadde nga ndi wa bulijjo era omutono, nga nkutte ekifo kitono nnyo, nga ne bwe ndigenda kumpi tewali alikiraba—ne nze nnina ekkubo okutuuka eri Katonda ono Atakoma, n’obwesige nti ampulira. Nga ndi omu ne Kristo, nga nkulemberwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, nfuna obuvumu okugamba nti: “Nja kusabira abalala, kubanga nkakasa nti Katonda wange ajja kumpuliriza: ‘Katonda wange anampulira.’” Essuubi ery’omukisa nga liri mu maaso gange—buli kweraliikirira okw’oku nsi n’okw’omwoyo nga kuwaanyisiddwamu emirembe gya Katonda, alabirira bonna era awulira okusaba. Essuubi ery’omukisa mu mulimu gwange—okumanya nti ne bwe kuddibwamu kulwawo nnyo, era nga kyetaagisa okusaba okungi okw’obugumiikiriza n’obunyiikivu, amazima gasigala nga makakafu agatayinza kulemererwa—“Katonda wange anampulira!” Era nga lyandibadde ssuubi lya mukisa eri Ekkanisa ya Kristo singa ffenna twali tusobola okuwa okusaba ekifo kyakwo, okuwa okukkiriza mu Katonda ekifo kyakwo, oba, okusingawo, okuwa Katonda awulira okusaba ekifo kye! Kino si kye kintu ekimu ekikulu, abo abatandise mu kigero ekitono okulaba obwetaavu obw’amaanyi obw’okusaba, kye basaanidde okusooka okusabira? Katonda bwe yasooka, emirundi n’emirundi, okufuka Omwoyo ku bantu be abaali basaba, yateekawo etteeka ery’ebiseera byonna: gye bukoma obungi bw’okusaba, gye bukoma obungi bw’Omwoyo. Buli ayinza okugamba nti, “Katonda wange anampulira,” yeegatte mu kwegayirira okw’amaanyi, amazima ago gaddizibwe mu kifo kyago ekituufu mu Kkanisa yonna, era essuubi ery’omukisa lijja kutuukirira: Ekkanisa esaba, eyambaziddwa amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. 6. “Katonda wange anampulira.” Obwetaavu bw’okuyigirizibwa Katonda!—Kino tukyetaaga, okutusobozesa okukwata ekigambo kino mu kukkiriza okulamu, n’okukikozesa mu bujjuvu mu kwegayiririra abalala. Kyogeddwa, era tekiyinza kwogerwa nnyo oba n’obunyiikivu obusukkiridde, nti ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa Ekkanisa mu biseera byaffe ge maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Olw’okuba kino bwe kiri bwe kityo ku ludda lwa Katonda, kyetuva tuyinza n’okugamba mu mazima nti, ku ludda lw’omuntu, ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa kwe kusaba okusingawo, okusaba okw’okukkiriza n’obunyiikivu okusingawo. Mu kwogera ku kubulwa amaanyi g’Omwoyo, n’ekyetaagisa okugafuna, omuntu omu yakozesa ebigambo bino—ekiziyiza tekiri ku layini eyimiridde, wabula ku layini egalamidde. Kyandiba nti kiri ku zombi. Waliwo bingi mu ffe ebiteekwa okwatulwa n’okuggibwawo Omwoyo bw’aba ow’okukola mu ddembe. Naye ekiziyiza kisinga kuba ku layini eyimiridde—okutunula waggulu, n’okwesigama ennyo ku Katonda, n’okumukaabirira n’amaanyi, n’okusaba okw’okukkiriza okuvaamu ebibala—bino byonna bibulwa nnyo, era kino kinakuwaza. Era kino kyennyini kye kintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa. Tetuyinza ffenna kwemalirira kuyiga ssomo erinaasobozesa okusaba okuwangula—essomo ly’okukkiriza okuyimba buli kiseera nti, “Katonda wange anampulira”? Wadde nga lyangu era lya ntandikwa, lyetaaga okwegezaamu n’obugumiikiriza, lyetaaga ebiseera n’okuyigirizibwa okw’omu ggulu, okuliyiga obulungi. Nga tukwatiddwako ekirowoozo ekimasamasa, oba ekintu eky’omukisa kye tuyiseemu, kiyinza okulabika nga tumanyi essomo lino bulungi ddala. Naye bulijjo obwetaavu bujja kuddamu okujja obw’okufuula kino okusaba kwaffe okusooka—nti Katonda awulira okusaba atuyigirize okukikkiriza, era bwe tutyo tusabe nga bwe kitugwanira. Bwe tukyagala tusobola okumwesiga. Oyo asanyuka okuwulira okusaba n’okukuddamu, Oyo eyawaayo Omwana we alyoke atusabire bulijjo era asabe wamu naffe, n’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu okusabira mu ffe, tuyinza okuba abakakafu nti tewali kusaba kw’ajja kuwulira mu bukakafu okusinga kuno: nti yeebikkule bw’atyo nga Katonda awulira okusaba, obulamu bwaffe bwonna buddemu nti, “Katonda wange anampulira.”

fields.title: Pawulo, Ekyokulabirako mu Kusaba
fields.body_html:
“Genda … omubuuze Sawulo ow’e Taluso. Ali eyo kaakano ng’asaba.”—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:11.

“Katonda kyeyava ansaasira, Kristo Yesu alyoke ayoleseze mu nze, omwonoonyi asingira ddala okugumiikiriza kwe okutakoma, era mbeere ekyokulabirako eri abo abalimukkiriza ne bafuna obulamu obutaggwaawo.”—1 Timoseewo 1:16.

Katonda yatwala Omwana we yennyini n’amufuula ekyokulabirako kyaffe era ekifaananyi kye tulina okugoberera. Oluusi kiba ng’amaanyi g’ekyokulabirako kya Kristo gabula, kubanga tulowooza nti ye, atalina kibi, si muntu nga ffe. Mukama waffe yatwala Pawulo, omuntu ddala nga ffe, n’amufuula ekyokulabirako ky’ekyo ky’asobola okukolera omuntu eyali omwonoonyi asookera ddala. Era Pawulo, omuntu eyalekawo akabonero ku Kkanisa okusinga omulala yenna, bulijjo abadde ajjulizibwa ng’omuntu ow’okulabirako. Mu kutegeera kwe okw’amazima ga Katonda n’engeri gye yagayigirizangamu; mu kwewaayo kwe eri Mukama we, n’obunyiikivu bwe obwamwokya ng’amuweereza; mu kumanya kwe okw’omunda amaanyi ga Kristo abeera mu ye, n’okussa ekimu mu musaalaba gwe; mu bwetoowaze bwe obutaliimu bukuusa, n’okukkiriza kwe okwangu era okw’obuvumu; mu bunyiikivu bwe n’okugumiikiriza kwe ng’omuminsani—mu bino byonna, n’ebirala bingi, “ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu kyamujjulamu nnyo okusukkirira.” Kristo yamuwaayo, n’Ekkanisa n’emukkiriza, ng’ekyokulabirako ky’ekyo Kristo ky’ayagala, n’ekyo Kristo ky’ayinza okukola. Emirundi musanvu Pawulo ayogera ku bakkiriza okumugoberera: (1 Abakkolinso 4:16), “Noolwekyo mbongeramu amaanyi mulabire ku nze”; (11:1), “Mundabireko nga nange bwe ndabira ku Kristo”; Abafiripi 3:17, 4:9; 1 Basessaloniika 1:6; 2 Basessaloniika 3:7–9.

Pawulo bw’aba nga, ng’ekyokulabirako mu kusaba, tasomebwa nnyo era tajjulizibwa nnyo nga bw’ali mu bintu ebirala, si lwa kuba nti ne mu kino si bukakafu bwa kitalo obw’ekyo ekisa kye kiyinza okukola, wadde nti ne mu nsonga eno tetwetaaga nnyo buyambi bwa kyokulabirako kye. Okwekenneenya Pawulo ng’ekyokulabirako mu kusaba kujja kuleeta empeera ennene ey’okuyigirizibwa n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi. Ebigambo Mukama waffe bye yamwogerako ku kukyuka kwe, “Ali eyo kaakano ng’asaba,” biyinza okutwalibwa ng’omusingi gw’obulamu bwe bwonna. Okwolesebwa okw’omu ggulu okwamufukaamiza, okuva olwo kwafuga obulamu bwe. Kristo ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, mu ye mwe twaweerwa buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo, ye yali buli kimu gy’ali; okusaba n’okusuubira amaanyi ag’omu ggulu mu mulimu gwe era ku mulimu gwe, nga gava butereevu mu ggulu olw’okusaba, kyali kibala kyangu eky’okukkiriza kwe mu Oyo Agulumiziddwa. Ne mu kino Kristo yayagala abeere ekyokulabirako, tulyoke tuyige nti obw’omu ggulu bwa Kristo n’ebirabo bye, n’amaanyi agakolera obulokozi agatali ga nsi muno, gye bikoma okumanyibwa n’okukkirizibwa, n’okusaba gye kukoma okufuuka okusituka kw’omutima okw’obwakyo eri ensibuko yokka ey’obulamu bwagwo. Ka tulabe kye tumanyi ku Pawulo.

Empisa za Pawulo mu Kusaba.

Zino zeeraga mu bigambo bye kumpi nga tagenderedde. Awandiika (Abaruumi 1:9), “Katonda … ye mujulirwa wange, nga bwe mbasabira bulijjo, nga mbegayiririra bulijjo mu kusaba kwange … Kubanga neesunga nnyo okubalaba, ndyoke mbawe ku kirabo eky’omwoyo, mulyoke munywezebwe.” Abaruumi 10:1, 9:2, 3: “Kye njagala mu mutima gwange era kye nsabira Abayisirayiri eri Katonda, kwe kulokolebwa”; “nga ndimunakuwavu nnyo era nga nnumwa mu mutima. Nnali njagala nze mwene nkolimirwe Katonda era njawukanyizibwe ku Kristo olwa baganda bange.” 1 Abakkolinso 1:4: “Nneebaza Katonda wange bulijjo ku lwammwe, olw’ekisa kya Katonda ekyabaweebwa mu Kristo Yesu.” 2 Abakkolinso 6:4, 6: “Tweyoleka nga tuli baweereza ba Katonda, … ne mu kutunula, ne mu kusiiba.” Abaggalatiya 4:19: “Baana bange be nnumirwa nate ng’alumwa okuzaala, okutuusa Kristo lw’alibumbibwa mu mmwe.” Abaefeso 1:16: “Sirekangayo kwebaza Katonda ku lwammwe. Mbajjukira ne mbasabira.” Abaefeso 3:14: “Nfukaamirira Kitaffe, … agumyenga era anywezenga omuntu wammwe ow’omunda, olw’Omwoyo we.” Abafiripi 1:3, 4, 8, 9: “Nneebaza Katonda wange buli lwe mbajjukira, era buli lwe mbasabira mwenna nsaba nga nzijudde essanyu. … Katonda ye mujulirwa wange nga mwenna bwe mbaagala n’okwagala okuva eri Kristo Yesu. Mbasabira”—Abakkolosaayi 1:3, 9: “Buli bwe tubasabira, twebaza Katonda. … Noolwekyo, okuviira ddala ku lunaku lwe twawulira ebibafaako, tetulekangayo kubasabira na kubeegayiririra”—Abakkolosaayi 2:1: “Njagala mumanye nga bwe nfuba ennyo okubasabira mmwe … era n’abo abatandabangako mu mubiri.” 1 Basessaloniika 1:2: “Bulijjo twebaza Katonda ku lwammwe mwenna era tubasabira obutayosa.” 3:9: “… essanyu lye tulina ku lwammwe mu maaso ga Katonda waffe … Katonda tumwegayirira nnyo nnyini emisana n’ekiro, atukkirize okubalabako tujjuulirize ebyo ebikyabulako mu kukkiriza kwammwe.” 2 Basessaloniika 1:3: “Kitugwanidde okwebazanga Katonda bulijjo ku lwammwe. … Kyetuva tubasabira bulijjo.” 2 Timoseewo 1:3: “Neebaza Katonda … nga nkujjukira obutayosa mu kusaba kwange emisana n’ekiro.” Firemooni 4: “Bulijjo bwe mba nga nkusabira neebaza Katonda.”

Ebyawandiikibwa bino bwe bitwalibwa awamu bituwa ekifaananyi ky’omuntu ebigambo bye, “Musabenga obutayosa,” bye byali bulambulukufu obw’obulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku. Yali ategeera nnyo nti okukyuka kwokka tekumala; nti ekisa n’amaanyi ag’omu ggulu byetaaga okuleetebwa wansi olw’okusaba ku lw’abo abaakakyuka; nti kyetaagisa okusaba okungi era okutakoma, emisana n’ekiro, okubireeta wansi; era yali mukakafu nti okusaba kujja kubireeta—n’olwekyo obulamu bwe bwali kusaba okutakoma era okw’ensonga entegeerekeka ennyo. Yali ategeera nnyo nti buli kintu kiteekwa okuva waggulu, era yalina okukkiriza okw’amaanyi nti kijja kujja ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba, ne kiba nti okusaba tekwali mulimu gwa buvunaanyizibwa wadde omugugu, wabula okukyuka okw’obwakyo okw’omutima eri ekifo kyokka mwe guyinza okufunira bye gunoonyeza abalala.

Ebyo Pawulo bye Yasabanga.

Kikulu nnyo okumanya kiki Pawulo kye yasabanga, nga bwe kiri okumanya emirundi gye yasabanga n’obunyiikivu bwe yasabiranga. Okwegayiririra abalala mulimu gwa mwoyo. Obwesige bwaffe mu gwo bujja kwesigama nnyo ku kumanya nti tusaba nga Katonda bw’ayagala. Gye tukoma okusaba mu bulambulukufu ebintu eby’omu ggulu, bye tutegeerera amangu ago nti Katonda yekka y’ayinza okubiwa, era bye tukakasa nti alibiwa, gye tujja okukoma okwolekera Katonda yekka butereevu era n’obwagazi obungi. Ebintu bye tunoonya gye bikoma okuba ebitayinzika, gye tujja okukoma okuva ku mirimu gyonna egy’abantu ne tudda eri okusaba n’eri Katonda yekka.

Mu bbaluwa ze, ng’oggyeeko ebigambo mw’ayogerera ku kusaba kwe, tulinamu essaala nnyingi ez’enjawulo Pawulo mw’ayogerera kye yeegomba mu mutima gwe ku lw’abo b’awandiikira. Mu zo tulaba nti kye yasooka okwegomba bulijjo kwe kuba nti “banywezebwe” mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Newaakubadde nga yatenderezanga nnyo Katonda bwe yawuliranga nti abantu bakyuse, yali amanyi obunafu bw’abo abaakakyuka, era nti okunywezebwa kwabwe tekuyinza kutuukirira awatali kisa kya Mwoyo ekireetebwa wansi olw’okusaba. Bwe tunaatunuulira ezimu ku ssaala ze enkulu, tujja kulaba bye yasaba n’ebyo bye yafuna.

Twala essaala ebbiri eziri mu bbaluwa eri Abaefeso—emu esabira ekitangaala, endala esabira amaanyi. Mu esooka (1:15), asaba Omwoyo ow’amagezi abamulise bamanye okuyitibwa kwabwe kye kuli, obusika bwabwe kye buli, n’amaanyi amangi ga Katonda agakolera mu bo kye gali. Okumulisibwa mu mwoyo n’okumanya bye byali ebyetaago byabwe ebikulu, era nga bifunibwa ku lwabwe olw’okusaba. Mu ey’okubiri (3:15) asaba amaanyi ge baali balagiddwa mu Kristo gakolere mu bo, era banywezebwe n’amaanyi ga Katonda, Kristo alyoke abeere mu bo, n’okwagala okusukkiridde okutegeera kwonna, n’okujjula kwa Katonda, bijje ku bo ddala. Bino byali bintu ebiyinza okuva mu ggulu butereevu byokka; bino bye yasaba era bye yasuubira. Bwe tuba twagala okuyiga obukugu bwa Pawulo mu kwegayiririra abalala, tetulina kusabira bakkiriza ab’omu biseera byaffe kintu kitono ku kino.

Tunuulira essaala eri mu bbaluwa eri Abafiripi (1:9–11). Era nayo esooka kusabira kumanya okw’omwoyo; oluvannyuma ne kuddako obulamu obutaliiko kya kunenyezebwa, n’oluvannyuma obulamu obubala ebibala olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Bwe kityo ne mu ssaala ennungi eri mu bbaluwa eri Abakkolosaayi (1:9–11). Okusooka, okumanya okw’omwoyo n’okutegeera Katonda by’ayagala, oluvannyuma okunywezebwa n’amaanyi gonna olw’okugumiikiriza kwonna n’essanyu.

Oba twala essaala ebbiri eziri mu 1 Basessaloniika (3:12, 13, ne 5:23). Emu: “Mukama waffe aboongereko okwagala kwammwe, mwagalanenga mwekka na mwekka … alyoke anyweze emitima gyammwe nga temuliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu butukuvu.” Endala: “Katonda ow’emirembe abatukulize ddala, … bikuumibwenga nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa.” Ebigambo byennyini bya waggulu nnyo ne kiba nti tetubitegeera bulungi, n’okusingawo tetubikkiriza, n’okusingawo tetulaba mu bulamu bwaffe bye bitegeeza. Pawulo yabeeranga nnyo mu nsi ey’omu ggulu, yali ng’ali ewuwe mu butukuvu ne mu buyinza bwa Katonda obutakoma ne mu kwagala kwe, ne kiba nti essaala ng’ezo zaali bulambulukufu obw’obwakyo obw’ekyo kye yali amanyi nti Katonda ayinza era ajja kukikola. Katonda “anyweze emitima gyammwe nga temuliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu butukuvu,” Katonda “abatukulize ddala”—omuntu akkiriza ebintu bino era abyegomba ajja kubisabira abalala. Essaala zino zonna bukakafu nti abanoonyeza obulamu bwennyini obw’omu ggulu nga bali ku nsi. Tekyewuunyisa nti tagezesebwa kwesiga makubo gonna ag’abantu, wabula akinoonya mu ggulu mwokka. Nziramu nti, gye tukoma okutwala essaala za Pawulo ng’ekyokulabirako kyaffe, ne tufuula bye yeegomba okuba ebyaffe ku lw’abakkiriza be tusabira, gye kujja okukoma okusaba eri Katonda ow’omu ggulu okufuuka ng’omukka gwe tussa buli lunaku.

Pawulo bwe Yasabanga Abalala Okumusabira.

Ebyo tebiyigiriza kitono okusinga essaala ze yennyini ze yasabiranga abatukuvu. Bikakasa nti okusaba takutwala ng’enkizo ey’enjawulo ey’omutume yekka; ayita omukkiriza asinga obuwombeefu n’obwangu okukozesa eddembe lye. Bikakasa nti talowooza nti abaakakyuka bokka oba Abakristaayo abanafu be beetaaga okusabirwa; ye yennyini, ng’ekitundu ky’omubiri, yeesigama ku booluganda ne ku ssaala zaabwe. Bwe yamala okubuulira Enjiri okumala emyaka abiri, yali akyasaba abalala okumusabira alyoke ayogere nga bw’asaanidde okwogera. Si mulundi gumu gwokka, si kiseera kitono, wabula buli lunaku, era obutayosa, ekisa kiteekwa okunoonyezebwa n’okuleetebwa wansi okuva mu ggulu ku lw’omulimu gwe. Okulindirira Katonda awamu era obutakoma, eri Pawulo, lye ssuubi lyokka ery’Ekkanisa. Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yajja, obulamu obw’omu ggulu, obulamu bwa Mukama ali mu ggulu, bwayingira mu nsi; tewali kirala kiyinza kubukuuma okuggyako okussa ekimu n’eggulu obutasalako.

Wuliriza engeri gy’asabamu abalala okumusabira, n’obunyiikivu bw’akikozesa—Abaruumi 15:30: “Kaakano mbakuutira abooluganda, mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ne mu kwagala kw’Omwoyo, okufubiranga awamu nange, nga munsabira eri Katonda, mpone abo abajeemu mu Buyudaaya, … ndyoke nsobole okujja gye muli olw’okwagala kwa Katonda, … nga ndi musanyufu.” Essaala zombi nga zaddibwamu mu ngeri ey’ekitalo: Abaruumi 15:5, 6, 13. Ekyewuunyo nti obuyinza bw’ensi obw’Abaruumi, obwali bulaze obulabe bwabwo eri obwakabaka bwa Katonda mu Piraato ku Kristo, mu Kerode ku Peetero, n’e Firipi, amangu ago ne bufuuka omukuumi wa Pawulo, ne bumuwa abamuwerekera okumutuusa e Ruumi nga talina kabi, kiyinza kunnyonnyolwa na ssaala zino zokka.

2 Abakkolinso 1:10, 11: “Gwe tulinamu essuubi ery’okutuwonyanga. Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira.” Abaefeso 6:18, 19: “Nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera … nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu, be bantu bonna aba Katonda. Era nange munsabirenga bwe nnaabanga njogera mpeebwe eby’okwogera, era mbyogerenga n’obuvumu nga ntegeeza abantu ekyama ky’Enjiri.” Abafiripi 1:19: “Kubanga mmanyi nti olw’okunsabira n’olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo, ndifuna okulokolebwa kwange.” Abakkolosaayi 4:2, 3, 4: “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, … nga mwenna awamu mutusabira Katonda atuggulirewo oluggi okubuulira Enjiri, n’okutegeeza ekyama kya Kristo, … Ndyoke njolesenga ekyama ekyo nga bwe kiŋŋwanidde okukyogerako.” 1 Basessaloniika 5:25: “Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Firemooni 22: “Nnina essuubi, nga Katonda okusaba kwammwe ajja kukuddamu anzikirize nkomewo gye muli.”

Twalaba engeri Kristo gye yasabangamu, n’engeri gye yayigiriza abayigirizwa be okusaba. Tulaba engeri Pawulo gye yasabangamu, n’engeri gye yayigiriza ekkanisa okusaba. Ng’Omusomesa bwe yakola, n’omuweereza we bw’atyo atuyita okukkiriza n’okukakasa nti okusaba ge maanyi ag’obuweereza n’ag’Ekkanisa mu ngeri y’emu. Okukkiriza kwe tukulabira mu bufunze mu bigambo bino eby’ekitalo bye yayogera ku kintu ekyali kimunakuwaza: “… olw’okunsabira n’olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo, ndifuna okulokolebwa kwange.” Nga bwe yatunuuliranga Mukama we ali mu ggulu, bw’atyo bwe yatunuuliranga ne baganda be ku nsi, okumufunira amaanyi g’Omwoyo oyo. Omwoyo ava mu ggulu n’okusaba ku nsi, gy’ali, nga bwe kyali eri ekkumi n’ababiri oluvannyuma lwa Pentekooti, byali bigattiddwa wamu nga tebiyinza kwawulwa. Tutera okwogera ku bunyiikivu, n’okwewaayo, n’amaanyi eby’abatume—Katonda atuwe okuzuukuka kw’okusaba okw’abatume.

Ka nzireemu okubuuza ekibuuzo kino: Omulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala gulina mu Kkanisa ekifo kye gusaanidde okubeera nakyo? Kye kintu ekitegeerwa abangi mu mulimu gwa Mukama, nti buli kimu kyesigama ku kufuna okuva eri Katonda “amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Kristo” ku lwaffe ne mu ffe, agayinza okuwa omulimu gwaffe amaanyi gaagwo amatuufu ag’okuleeta omukisa? Eno ye nteekateeka ya Kristo ey’obwakatonda ku mirimu gyonna, egigye n’egy’abaweereza be; eno ye nteekateeka Pawulo gye yagoberera: sooka ojje buli lunaku, ng’atalina kintu, ofune okuva eri Katonda “amaanyi g’Omwoyo” mu kwegayiririra abalala—olwo ogende ogabire abalala ekyo ekikujjiddeko okuva mu ggulu.

Mu kuyigiriza kwe kwonna, Mukama waffe Yesu yayogeranga n’abayigirizwa be ku kusaba kwabwe emirundi mingi nnyo okusinga ku kubuulira kwabwe. Mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula, yayogera kitono ku kubuulira, naye n’ayogera nnyo ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ne ku kusaba kwabwe kyonna kye baagala mu linnya lye. Bwe tuba ab’okudda mu bulamu buno obw’abatume abaasooka n’obwa Pawulo, ne tukkiriza ddala amazima buli lunaku—omulimu gwange ogusooka, n’amaanyi gange gokka, kwe kwegayiririra abalala, okufuna amaanyi ga Katonda ku myoyo egyankwasibwa—tuteekwa okuba n’obuvumu okwatula ekibi ekyayita, n’okukkiriza nti waliwo okununulibwa. Okumenya empisa enkadde, okulwanyisa okuleekaana kw’emirimu egy’amangu egibadde gifuna bulijjo bye gyagala, okufuula buli kirala kye tuyitibwa okukola okuba wansi w’eno, abalala ka basiime oba bagaane, tekijja kuba kyangu ku ntandikwa. Naye abasajja oba abakazi abeesigwa tebajja kufuna mpeera bokka kyokka, naye era bajja kufuuka ab’omugaso ennyo eri baganda baabwe. “Olyoke oyitibwe omuddaabiriza wa bbugwe eyamenyeka, omuddaabiriza wa mayumba ag’okusulamu.”

Naye ddala kiyinzika? Ddala kiyinzika abo abatasobolangako n’okutunuulira obuzibu buno, n’okusingawo okubuwangula, okufuuka ab’amaanyi mu kusaba? Mbuulira, ddala kyali kiyinzika Yakobo okufuuka Isirayiri—omulangira eyawangula ng’ameggana ne Katonda? Kyali kiyinzika. Ebitayinzika eri abantu, biyinzika eri Katonda. Mazima ddala tewaweebwa okuva eri Kitaffe, ng’ekibala ekikulu eky’okununula kwa Kristo, Omwoyo ow’okwegayirira, Omwoyo ow’okwegayiririra abalala? Yimirira katono olowooze kino kye kitegeeza. Era okyabuusabuusa oba Katonda ayinza okukufuula “ab’okumeggana ne Katonda,” abalangira abamuwangula? Ayi, ka tugobe okutya kwonna, era mu kukkiriza tusabe ekisa kye tulinira Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, ekisa ky’okwegayirira, ekisa ky’okwegayiririra abalala. Ka tukkirize mu kasirise era nga tetuddirira nti abeera mu ffe, era ajja kutusobozesa okukola omulimu gwaffe. Mu kukkiriza ka tuleme kutya okwaniriza n’okwewaayo eri amazima gano amakulu nti okwegayiririra abalala, nga bwe kuli omulimu omukulu ogwa Kabaka ali ku ntebe, kwe mulimu omukulu ogw’abaweereza be ku nsi. Tulina Omwoyo Omutukuvu, aleeta obulamu bwa Kristo mu mitima gyaffe, okututeekateeka olw’omulimu guno. Ka tutandikirewo era tuseese ekirabo ekiri mu ffe. Bwe tunaawangayo buli lunaku ekiseera kyaffe eky’okwegayiririra abalala, ne twesiga amaanyi g’Omwoyo agatusobozesa, obwesige bujja kukula nti tusobola, mu kigero kyaffe, okugoberera Pawulo nga naye bwe yagoberera Kristo.
fields.body_text: “Genda … omubuuze Sawulo ow’e Taluso. Ali eyo kaakano ng’asaba.”—Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:11. “Katonda kyeyava ansaasira, Kristo Yesu alyoke ayoleseze mu nze, omwonoonyi asingira ddala okugumiikiriza kwe okutakoma, era mbeere ekyokulabirako eri abo abalimukkiriza ne bafuna obulamu obutaggwaawo.”—1 Timoseewo 1:16. Katonda yatwala Omwana we yennyini n’amufuula ekyokulabirako kyaffe era ekifaananyi kye tulina okugoberera. Oluusi kiba ng’amaanyi g’ekyokulabirako kya Kristo gabula, kubanga tulowooza nti ye, atalina kibi, si muntu nga ffe. Mukama waffe yatwala Pawulo, omuntu ddala nga ffe, n’amufuula ekyokulabirako ky’ekyo ky’asobola okukolera omuntu eyali omwonoonyi asookera ddala. Era Pawulo, omuntu eyalekawo akabonero ku Kkanisa okusinga omulala yenna, bulijjo abadde ajjulizibwa ng’omuntu ow’okulabirako. Mu kutegeera kwe okw’amazima ga Katonda n’engeri gye yagayigirizangamu; mu kwewaayo kwe eri Mukama we, n’obunyiikivu bwe obwamwokya ng’amuweereza; mu kumanya kwe okw’omunda amaanyi ga Kristo abeera mu ye, n’okussa ekimu mu musaalaba gwe; mu bwetoowaze bwe obutaliimu bukuusa, n’okukkiriza kwe okwangu era okw’obuvumu; mu bunyiikivu bwe n’okugumiikiriza kwe ng’omuminsani—mu bino byonna, n’ebirala bingi, “ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu kyamujjulamu nnyo okusukkirira.” Kristo yamuwaayo, n’Ekkanisa n’emukkiriza, ng’ekyokulabirako ky’ekyo Kristo ky’ayagala, n’ekyo Kristo ky’ayinza okukola. Emirundi musanvu Pawulo ayogera ku bakkiriza okumugoberera: (1 Abakkolinso 4:16), “Noolwekyo mbongeramu amaanyi mulabire ku nze”; (11:1), “Mundabireko nga nange bwe ndabira ku Kristo”; Abafiripi 3:17, 4:9; 1 Basessaloniika 1:6; 2 Basessaloniika 3:7–9. Pawulo bw’aba nga, ng’ekyokulabirako mu kusaba, tasomebwa nnyo era tajjulizibwa nnyo nga bw’ali mu bintu ebirala, si lwa kuba nti ne mu kino si bukakafu bwa kitalo obw’ekyo ekisa kye kiyinza okukola, wadde nti ne mu nsonga eno tetwetaaga nnyo buyambi bwa kyokulabirako kye. Okwekenneenya Pawulo ng’ekyokulabirako mu kusaba kujja kuleeta empeera ennene ey’okuyigirizibwa n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi. Ebigambo Mukama waffe bye yamwogerako ku kukyuka kwe, “Ali eyo kaakano ng’asaba,” biyinza okutwalibwa ng’omusingi gw’obulamu bwe bwonna. Okwolesebwa okw’omu ggulu okwamufukaamiza, okuva olwo kwafuga obulamu bwe. Kristo ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, mu ye mwe twaweerwa buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo, ye yali buli kimu gy’ali; okusaba n’okusuubira amaanyi ag’omu ggulu mu mulimu gwe era ku mulimu gwe, nga gava butereevu mu ggulu olw’okusaba, kyali kibala kyangu eky’okukkiriza kwe mu Oyo Agulumiziddwa. Ne mu kino Kristo yayagala abeere ekyokulabirako, tulyoke tuyige nti obw’omu ggulu bwa Kristo n’ebirabo bye, n’amaanyi agakolera obulokozi agatali ga nsi muno, gye bikoma okumanyibwa n’okukkirizibwa, n’okusaba gye kukoma okufuuka okusituka kw’omutima okw’obwakyo eri ensibuko yokka ey’obulamu bwagwo. Ka tulabe kye tumanyi ku Pawulo. Empisa za Pawulo mu Kusaba. Zino zeeraga mu bigambo bye kumpi nga tagenderedde. Awandiika (Abaruumi 1:9), “Katonda … ye mujulirwa wange, nga bwe mbasabira bulijjo, nga mbegayiririra bulijjo mu kusaba kwange … Kubanga neesunga nnyo okubalaba, ndyoke mbawe ku kirabo eky’omwoyo, mulyoke munywezebwe.” Abaruumi 10:1, 9:2, 3: “Kye njagala mu mutima gwange era kye nsabira Abayisirayiri eri Katonda, kwe kulokolebwa”; “nga ndimunakuwavu nnyo era nga nnumwa mu mutima. Nnali njagala nze mwene nkolimirwe Katonda era njawukanyizibwe ku Kristo olwa baganda bange.” 1 Abakkolinso 1:4: “Nneebaza Katonda wange bulijjo ku lwammwe, olw’ekisa kya Katonda ekyabaweebwa mu Kristo Yesu.” 2 Abakkolinso 6:4, 6: “Tweyoleka nga tuli baweereza ba Katonda, … ne mu kutunula, ne mu kusiiba.” Abaggalatiya 4:19: “Baana bange be nnumirwa nate ng’alumwa okuzaala, okutuusa Kristo lw’alibumbibwa mu mmwe.” Abaefeso 1:16: “Sirekangayo kwebaza Katonda ku lwammwe. Mbajjukira ne mbasabira.” Abaefeso 3:14: “Nfukaamirira Kitaffe, … agumyenga era anywezenga omuntu wammwe ow’omunda, olw’Omwoyo we.” Abafiripi 1:3, 4, 8, 9: “Nneebaza Katonda wange buli lwe mbajjukira, era buli lwe mbasabira mwenna nsaba nga nzijudde essanyu. … Katonda ye mujulirwa wange nga mwenna bwe mbaagala n’okwagala okuva eri Kristo Yesu. Mbasabira”—Abakkolosaayi 1:3, 9: “Buli bwe tubasabira, twebaza Katonda. … Noolwekyo, okuviira ddala ku lunaku lwe twawulira ebibafaako, tetulekangayo kubasabira na kubeegayiririra”—Abakkolosaayi 2:1: “Njagala mumanye nga bwe nfuba ennyo okubasabira mmwe … era n’abo abatandabangako mu mubiri.” 1 Basessaloniika 1:2: “Bulijjo twebaza Katonda ku lwammwe mwenna era tubasabira obutayosa.” 3:9: “… essanyu lye tulina ku lwammwe mu maaso ga Katonda waffe … Katonda tumwegayirira nnyo nnyini emisana n’ekiro, atukkirize okubalabako tujjuulirize ebyo ebikyabulako mu kukkiriza kwammwe.” 2 Basessaloniika 1:3: “Kitugwanidde okwebazanga Katonda bulijjo ku lwammwe. … Kyetuva tubasabira bulijjo.” 2 Timoseewo 1:3: “Neebaza Katonda … nga nkujjukira obutayosa mu kusaba kwange emisana n’ekiro.” Firemooni 4: “Bulijjo bwe mba nga nkusabira neebaza Katonda.” Ebyawandiikibwa bino bwe bitwalibwa awamu bituwa ekifaananyi ky’omuntu ebigambo bye, “Musabenga obutayosa,” bye byali bulambulukufu obw’obulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku. Yali ategeera nnyo nti okukyuka kwokka tekumala; nti ekisa n’amaanyi ag’omu ggulu byetaaga okuleetebwa wansi olw’okusaba ku lw’abo abaakakyuka; nti kyetaagisa okusaba okungi era okutakoma, emisana n’ekiro, okubireeta wansi; era yali mukakafu nti okusaba kujja kubireeta—n’olwekyo obulamu bwe bwali kusaba okutakoma era okw’ensonga entegeerekeka ennyo. Yali ategeera nnyo nti buli kintu kiteekwa okuva waggulu, era yalina okukkiriza okw’amaanyi nti kijja kujja ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba, ne kiba nti okusaba tekwali mulimu gwa buvunaanyizibwa wadde omugugu, wabula okukyuka okw’obwakyo okw’omutima eri ekifo kyokka mwe guyinza okufunira bye gunoonyeza abalala. Ebyo Pawulo bye Yasabanga. Kikulu nnyo okumanya kiki Pawulo kye yasabanga, nga bwe kiri okumanya emirundi gye yasabanga n’obunyiikivu bwe yasabiranga. Okwegayiririra abalala mulimu gwa mwoyo. Obwesige bwaffe mu gwo bujja kwesigama nnyo ku kumanya nti tusaba nga Katonda bw’ayagala. Gye tukoma okusaba mu bulambulukufu ebintu eby’omu ggulu, bye tutegeerera amangu ago nti Katonda yekka y’ayinza okubiwa, era bye tukakasa nti alibiwa, gye tujja okukoma okwolekera Katonda yekka butereevu era n’obwagazi obungi. Ebintu bye tunoonya gye bikoma okuba ebitayinzika, gye tujja okukoma okuva ku mirimu gyonna egy’abantu ne tudda eri okusaba n’eri Katonda yekka. Mu bbaluwa ze, ng’oggyeeko ebigambo mw’ayogerera ku kusaba kwe, tulinamu essaala nnyingi ez’enjawulo Pawulo mw’ayogerera kye yeegomba mu mutima gwe ku lw’abo b’awandiikira. Mu zo tulaba nti kye yasooka okwegomba bulijjo kwe kuba nti “banywezebwe” mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Newaakubadde nga yatenderezanga nnyo Katonda bwe yawuliranga nti abantu bakyuse, yali amanyi obunafu bw’abo abaakakyuka, era nti okunywezebwa kwabwe tekuyinza kutuukirira awatali kisa kya Mwoyo ekireetebwa wansi olw’okusaba. Bwe tunaatunuulira ezimu ku ssaala ze enkulu, tujja kulaba bye yasaba n’ebyo bye yafuna. Twala essaala ebbiri eziri mu bbaluwa eri Abaefeso—emu esabira ekitangaala, endala esabira amaanyi. Mu esooka (1:15), asaba Omwoyo ow’amagezi abamulise bamanye okuyitibwa kwabwe kye kuli, obusika bwabwe kye buli, n’amaanyi amangi ga Katonda agakolera mu bo kye gali. Okumulisibwa mu mwoyo n’okumanya bye byali ebyetaago byabwe ebikulu, era nga bifunibwa ku lwabwe olw’okusaba. Mu ey’okubiri (3:15) asaba amaanyi ge baali balagiddwa mu Kristo gakolere mu bo, era banywezebwe n’amaanyi ga Katonda, Kristo alyoke abeere mu bo, n’okwagala okusukkiridde okutegeera kwonna, n’okujjula kwa Katonda, bijje ku bo ddala. Bino byali bintu ebiyinza okuva mu ggulu butereevu byokka; bino bye yasaba era bye yasuubira. Bwe tuba twagala okuyiga obukugu bwa Pawulo mu kwegayiririra abalala, tetulina kusabira bakkiriza ab’omu biseera byaffe kintu kitono ku kino. Tunuulira essaala eri mu bbaluwa eri Abafiripi (1:9–11). Era nayo esooka kusabira kumanya okw’omwoyo; oluvannyuma ne kuddako obulamu obutaliiko kya kunenyezebwa, n’oluvannyuma obulamu obubala ebibala olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Bwe kityo ne mu ssaala ennungi eri mu bbaluwa eri Abakkolosaayi (1:9–11). Okusooka, okumanya okw’omwoyo n’okutegeera Katonda by’ayagala, oluvannyuma okunywezebwa n’amaanyi gonna olw’okugumiikiriza kwonna n’essanyu. Oba twala essaala ebbiri eziri mu 1 Basessaloniika (3:12, 13, ne 5:23). Emu: “Mukama waffe aboongereko okwagala kwammwe, mwagalanenga mwekka na mwekka … alyoke anyweze emitima gyammwe nga temuliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu butukuvu.” Endala: “Katonda ow’emirembe abatukulize ddala, … bikuumibwenga nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa.” Ebigambo byennyini bya waggulu nnyo ne kiba nti tetubitegeera bulungi, n’okusingawo tetubikkiriza, n’okusingawo tetulaba mu bulamu bwaffe bye bitegeeza. Pawulo yabeeranga nnyo mu nsi ey’omu ggulu, yali ng’ali ewuwe mu butukuvu ne mu buyinza bwa Katonda obutakoma ne mu kwagala kwe, ne kiba nti essaala ng’ezo zaali bulambulukufu obw’obwakyo obw’ekyo kye yali amanyi nti Katonda ayinza era ajja kukikola. Katonda “anyweze emitima gyammwe nga temuliiko kya kunenyezebwa mu butukuvu,” Katonda “abatukulize ddala”—omuntu akkiriza ebintu bino era abyegomba ajja kubisabira abalala. Essaala zino zonna bukakafu nti abanoonyeza obulamu bwennyini obw’omu ggulu nga bali ku nsi. Tekyewuunyisa nti tagezesebwa kwesiga makubo gonna ag’abantu, wabula akinoonya mu ggulu mwokka. Nziramu nti, gye tukoma okutwala essaala za Pawulo ng’ekyokulabirako kyaffe, ne tufuula bye yeegomba okuba ebyaffe ku lw’abakkiriza be tusabira, gye kujja okukoma okusaba eri Katonda ow’omu ggulu okufuuka ng’omukka gwe tussa buli lunaku. Pawulo bwe Yasabanga Abalala Okumusabira. Ebyo tebiyigiriza kitono okusinga essaala ze yennyini ze yasabiranga abatukuvu. Bikakasa nti okusaba takutwala ng’enkizo ey’enjawulo ey’omutume yekka; ayita omukkiriza asinga obuwombeefu n’obwangu okukozesa eddembe lye. Bikakasa nti talowooza nti abaakakyuka bokka oba Abakristaayo abanafu be beetaaga okusabirwa; ye yennyini, ng’ekitundu ky’omubiri, yeesigama ku booluganda ne ku ssaala zaabwe. Bwe yamala okubuulira Enjiri okumala emyaka abiri, yali akyasaba abalala okumusabira alyoke ayogere nga bw’asaanidde okwogera. Si mulundi gumu gwokka, si kiseera kitono, wabula buli lunaku, era obutayosa, ekisa kiteekwa okunoonyezebwa n’okuleetebwa wansi okuva mu ggulu ku lw’omulimu gwe. Okulindirira Katonda awamu era obutakoma, eri Pawulo, lye ssuubi lyokka ery’Ekkanisa. Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yajja, obulamu obw’omu ggulu, obulamu bwa Mukama ali mu ggulu, bwayingira mu nsi; tewali kirala kiyinza kubukuuma okuggyako okussa ekimu n’eggulu obutasalako. Wuliriza engeri gy’asabamu abalala okumusabira, n’obunyiikivu bw’akikozesa—Abaruumi 15:30: “Kaakano mbakuutira abooluganda, mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ne mu kwagala kw’Omwoyo, okufubiranga awamu nange, nga munsabira eri Katonda, mpone abo abajeemu mu Buyudaaya, … ndyoke nsobole okujja gye muli olw’okwagala kwa Katonda, … nga ndi musanyufu.” Essaala zombi nga zaddibwamu mu ngeri ey’ekitalo: Abaruumi 15:5, 6, 13. Ekyewuunyo nti obuyinza bw’ensi obw’Abaruumi, obwali bulaze obulabe bwabwo eri obwakabaka bwa Katonda mu Piraato ku Kristo, mu Kerode ku Peetero, n’e Firipi, amangu ago ne bufuuka omukuumi wa Pawulo, ne bumuwa abamuwerekera okumutuusa e Ruumi nga talina kabi, kiyinza kunnyonnyolwa na ssaala zino zokka. 2 Abakkolinso 1:10, 11: “Gwe tulinamu essuubi ery’okutuwonyanga. Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira.” Abaefeso 6:18, 19: “Nga musabiririranga mu ssaala zonna nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera … nga mwegayiririranga abatukuvu, be bantu bonna aba Katonda. Era nange munsabirenga bwe nnaabanga njogera mpeebwe eby’okwogera, era mbyogerenga n’obuvumu nga ntegeeza abantu ekyama ky’Enjiri.” Abafiripi 1:19: “Kubanga mmanyi nti olw’okunsabira n’olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo, ndifuna okulokolebwa kwange.” Abakkolosaayi 4:2, 3, 4: “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, … nga mwenna awamu mutusabira Katonda atuggulirewo oluggi okubuulira Enjiri, n’okutegeeza ekyama kya Kristo, … Ndyoke njolesenga ekyama ekyo nga bwe kiŋŋwanidde okukyogerako.” 1 Basessaloniika 5:25: “Abooluganda, naffe, mutusabirenga.” Firemooni 22: “Nnina essuubi, nga Katonda okusaba kwammwe ajja kukuddamu anzikirize nkomewo gye muli.” Twalaba engeri Kristo gye yasabangamu, n’engeri gye yayigiriza abayigirizwa be okusaba. Tulaba engeri Pawulo gye yasabangamu, n’engeri gye yayigiriza ekkanisa okusaba. Ng’Omusomesa bwe yakola, n’omuweereza we bw’atyo atuyita okukkiriza n’okukakasa nti okusaba ge maanyi ag’obuweereza n’ag’Ekkanisa mu ngeri y’emu. Okukkiriza kwe tukulabira mu bufunze mu bigambo bino eby’ekitalo bye yayogera ku kintu ekyali kimunakuwaza: “… olw’okunsabira n’olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo, ndifuna okulokolebwa kwange.” Nga bwe yatunuuliranga Mukama we ali mu ggulu, bw’atyo bwe yatunuuliranga ne baganda be ku nsi, okumufunira amaanyi g’Omwoyo oyo. Omwoyo ava mu ggulu n’okusaba ku nsi, gy’ali, nga bwe kyali eri ekkumi n’ababiri oluvannyuma lwa Pentekooti, byali bigattiddwa wamu nga tebiyinza kwawulwa. Tutera okwogera ku bunyiikivu, n’okwewaayo, n’amaanyi eby’abatume—Katonda atuwe okuzuukuka kw’okusaba okw’abatume. Ka nzireemu okubuuza ekibuuzo kino: Omulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala gulina mu Kkanisa ekifo kye gusaanidde okubeera nakyo? Kye kintu ekitegeerwa abangi mu mulimu gwa Mukama, nti buli kimu kyesigama ku kufuna okuva eri Katonda “amaanyi g’Omwoyo wa Kristo” ku lwaffe ne mu ffe, agayinza okuwa omulimu gwaffe amaanyi gaagwo amatuufu ag’okuleeta omukisa? Eno ye nteekateeka ya Kristo ey’obwakatonda ku mirimu gyonna, egigye n’egy’abaweereza be; eno ye nteekateeka Pawulo gye yagoberera: sooka ojje buli lunaku, ng’atalina kintu, ofune okuva eri Katonda “amaanyi g’Omwoyo” mu kwegayiririra abalala—olwo ogende ogabire abalala ekyo ekikujjiddeko okuva mu ggulu. Mu kuyigiriza kwe kwonna, Mukama waffe Yesu yayogeranga n’abayigirizwa be ku kusaba kwabwe emirundi mingi nnyo okusinga ku kubuulira kwabwe. Mu bigambo bye eby’okusiibula, yayogera kitono ku kubuulira, naye n’ayogera nnyo ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ne ku kusaba kwabwe kyonna kye baagala mu linnya lye. Bwe tuba ab’okudda mu bulamu buno obw’abatume abaasooka n’obwa Pawulo, ne tukkiriza ddala amazima buli lunaku—omulimu gwange ogusooka, n’amaanyi gange gokka, kwe kwegayiririra abalala, okufuna amaanyi ga Katonda ku myoyo egyankwasibwa—tuteekwa okuba n’obuvumu okwatula ekibi ekyayita, n’okukkiriza nti waliwo okununulibwa. Okumenya empisa enkadde, okulwanyisa okuleekaana kw’emirimu egy’amangu egibadde gifuna bulijjo bye gyagala, okufuula buli kirala kye tuyitibwa okukola okuba wansi w’eno, abalala ka basiime oba bagaane, tekijja kuba kyangu ku ntandikwa. Naye abasajja oba abakazi abeesigwa tebajja kufuna mpeera bokka kyokka, naye era bajja kufuuka ab’omugaso ennyo eri baganda baabwe. “Olyoke oyitibwe omuddaabiriza wa bbugwe eyamenyeka, omuddaabiriza wa mayumba ag’okusulamu.” Naye ddala kiyinzika? Ddala kiyinzika abo abatasobolangako n’okutunuulira obuzibu buno, n’okusingawo okubuwangula, okufuuka ab’amaanyi mu kusaba? Mbuulira, ddala kyali kiyinzika Yakobo okufuuka Isirayiri—omulangira eyawangula ng’ameggana ne Katonda? Kyali kiyinzika. Ebitayinzika eri abantu, biyinzika eri Katonda. Mazima ddala tewaweebwa okuva eri Kitaffe, ng’ekibala ekikulu eky’okununula kwa Kristo, Omwoyo ow’okwegayirira, Omwoyo ow’okwegayiririra abalala? Yimirira katono olowooze kino kye kitegeeza. Era okyabuusabuusa oba Katonda ayinza okukufuula “ab’okumeggana ne Katonda,” abalangira abamuwangula? Ayi, ka tugobe okutya kwonna, era mu kukkiriza tusabe ekisa kye tulinira Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, ekisa ky’okwegayirira, ekisa ky’okwegayiririra abalala. Ka tukkirize mu kasirise era nga tetuddirira nti abeera mu ffe, era ajja kutusobozesa okukola omulimu gwaffe. Mu kukkiriza ka tuleme kutya okwaniriza n’okwewaayo eri amazima gano amakulu nti okwegayiririra abalala, nga bwe kuli omulimu omukulu ogwa Kabaka ali ku ntebe, kwe mulimu omukulu ogw’abaweereza be ku nsi. Tulina Omwoyo Omutukuvu, aleeta obulamu bwa Kristo mu mitima gyaffe, okututeekateeka olw’omulimu guno. Ka tutandikirewo era tuseese ekirabo ekiri mu ffe. Bwe tunaawangayo buli lunaku ekiseera kyaffe eky’okwegayiririra abalala, ne twesiga amaanyi g’Omwoyo agatusobozesa, obwesige bujja kukula nti tusobola, mu kigero kyaffe, okugoberera Pawulo nga naye bwe yagoberera Kristo.

fields.title: Katonda Anoonya Abegayirizi
fields.body_html:
“Ntadde abakuumi ku bbugwe wo, ggwe Yerusaalemi abataasirike emisana n’ekiro. Mmwe abakoowoola Mukama temuwummula. Era temumuganya kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi era ng’agifudde ettendo mu nsi.”—Isaaya 62:6, 7.

“N’alaba nga tewali muntu, ne yennyamira nti tewali muntu ayinza kudduukirira.”—Isaaya 59:16.

“Natunula naye nga tewali n’omu ayinza kunnyamba, newuunya okulaba nga tewaali n’omu ayinza kunkwatirako.”—Isaaya 63:5.

“Tewali n’omu akoowoola linnya lyo oba eyewaliriza okukukwatako.”—Isaaya 64:7.

“Ne nnoonya omuntu mu bo ayinza okuzimba ekisenge era ayinza okubeeyimiririra mu maaso gange ku lw’ensi, naye ne siraba n’omu.”—Ezeekyeri 22:30.

“Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala … buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.”—Yokaana 15:16.

Mu kwekenneenya eggulu erijjudde emmunyeenye, bingi nnyo byesigamye ku kutegeera obunene bw’ebintu nga bwe buli ddala. Awatali kumanya ku bunene bw’ebitangaala eby’omu ggulu — ebirabika nga bitono nnyo eri amaaso, songa binene nnyo — n’obugazi bw’ebbanga mwe bitambulira obukunukkiriza okuba obutakoma, wadde nga birabika nga biri kumpi era nga tubimanyidde, tewayinza kubaawo kumanya kwa mazima ku nsi ey’omu ggulu oba ku nkolagana yaayo n’ensi eno. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne ku ggulu ery’omwoyo, n’obulamu obw’omu ggulu bwe twayitibwa okubeeramu. Era kino kisinga nnyo okuba bwe kityo mu bulamu bw’okwegayiririra abalala, okukwatagana okwo okw’ekitalo ennyo wakati w’eggulu n’ensi. Buli kimu kyesigamye ku kutegeera obunene bw’ebintu nga bwe buli ddala.

Lowooza ku bintu ebisatu ebisooka: Waliwo ensi, n’ebyetaago byayo, eyesigamye ddala ku kwegayiririra abalala era erindirira okuyambibwa nakwo; waliwo Katonda mu ggulu, alina eby’okugaba ebimala ebyetaago ebyo byonna, alindirira okusabibwa; waliwo Ekkanisa, n’okuyitibwa kwayo okw’ekitalo n’ebisuubizo byayo ebikakafu, erindirira okuzuukusibwa etegeere obuvunaanyizibwa bwayo obw’ekitalo n’amaanyi g’erina.

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Waliwo ensi n’obukadde bwayo bw’abantu abazikirira, nga okwegayiririra abalala lye ssuubi lyayo lyokka. Okwagala n’emirimu bingi nnyo biba nga bya bwereere, kubanga okwegayiririra abalala kutono nnyo. Abantu akawumbi kamu babeera ng’abatalina Mwana wa Katonda eyabafiirira. Obukadde amakumi asatu buli mwaka bayingira mu kizikiza eky’ebweru nga tebalina ssuubi. Obukadde amakumi ataano abayitibwa Abakristaayo, naye abasinga obungi babeera mu butamanya obw’enkomeredde oba mu butafaayo. Obukadde n’obukadde bw’Abakristaayo abanafu era abalwadde mu mwoyo; enkumi n’enkumi z’abakozi abakooye, abandiyinzizza okuweebwa omukisa olw’okwegayiririra abalala, era abandiyinzizza okwesobozesa okufuuka ab’amaanyi mu kwegayiririra abalala. Ekkanisa n’emirimu gy’obuminsani biwaayo obulamu n’okutegana, naye emirundi mingi ne bivaamu bitono, olw’okubulwa okwegayiririra abalala. Emyoyo, nga buli gumu gusinga ensi nnyingi omuwendo, nga gwenkana omuwendo ogwagusasulirwa mu musaayi gwa Kristo, era nga gusobola okutuukibwako amaanyi agayinza okufunibwa mu kwegayiririra abalala. Mazima ddala tetutegeera n’akatono obunene bw’omulimu ogulina okukolebwa abegayirizi ba Katonda; bwe twandibadde tubutegeera, twandikaabiridde Katonda okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna atuwe okuva mu ggulu omwoyo gw’okwegayiririra abalala.

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Waliwo Katonda ow’ekitiibwa ayinza okutuukiriza ebyetaago bino byonna. Tubuulirwa nti asanyukira okusaasira, nti ayagala nnyo okuba ow’ekisa, nti yeegomba okufuka omukisa gwe; era nti okwagala okwawaayo Omwana okufa kye kipimo ky’okwagala okwetooloola buli muntu buli kaseera. Naye era tayamba. Era abantu bazikirira, akakadde kamu buli mwezi mu China mwokka, era kiringa Katonda atakola kantu. Bw’aba ddala ayagala bw’atyo era ng’ayagala nnyo okuwa omukisa, wateekwa okubaawo ensonga etategeerekeka lwaki tayamba. Eyinza kuba ki? Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti: olw’obutakkiriza bwammwe. Bwe butakkiriza bw’abantu ba Katonda n’obutali beesigwa obubuvaamu. Yabatwala n’abafuula bakolagana naye; yabawa ekitiibwa, era ne yeesiba yekka, bwe yafuula okusaba kwabwe ekimu ku bipimo ebikulu eby’enkola y’amaanyi ge. Okubulwa okwegayiririra abalala y’emu ku nsonga enkulu ezireeta okubulwa omukisa. Ayi, singa twandikyusizza amaaso n’omutima okuva ku buli kintu ekirala ne tubitunuuliza ku Katonda ono awulira okusaba, okutuusa obukulu bw’ebisuubizo bye, n’amaanyi ge, n’ekigendererwa kye eky’okwagala lwe binaatuwamba! Obulamu bwaffe bwonna n’omutima gwaffe byandifuuse kwegayiririra abalala!

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Waliwo obunene obwokusatu amaaso gaffe bwe galina okuzibulwa okulaba: enkizo ey’ekitalo n’amaanyi g’abegayirizi. Waliwo obwetoowaze obw’obulimba, obufuula okwenyooma okuba empisa ennungi ennyo, kubanga tebulabanga nti ddala si kintu n’akatono. Singa bwali bumanyi ekyo, tebwandyetonze lwa bunafu bwabwo, wabula bwandyenyumirizza mu bunafu bwabwo obw’enkomeredde, nga ye mbeera yokka amaanyi ga Kristo mwe gayinza okubutuulako. Bwandyepimye bwo bwennyini, n’amaanyi gaabwo n’obuyinza bwabwo mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba, nga tebwesigama ku ebyo bye bulaba oba bye buwulira, nga naffe bwe tutapima bunene bwa njuba oba bwa mmunyeenye okusinziira ku ebyo amaaso bye galaba. Okukkiriza kulaba omuntu eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda ne mu ngeri ye okubeera omubaka wa Katonda mu nsi eno n’okugifuga. Okukkiriza kulaba omuntu eyanunulibwa n’asitulibwa n’agattibwa ne Kristo, ng’abeera mu Ye, ng’ali kimu naye, era ng’ayambaziddwa amaanyi ge mu kwegayiririra abalala. Okukkiriza kulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’abeera era ng’asabira mu mutima, ng’atwegayiririra mu kusinda kwaffe ng’okusiima kwa Katonda bwe kuli. Okukkiriza kulaba okwegayiririra kw’abatukuvu ng’ekitundu ku bulamu bw’Obusatu Obutukuvu — omukkiriza, ng’omwana wa Katonda, ng’asaba Kitaffe, mu Mwana, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo. Okukkiriza kulaba ku bulungi n’obusaanyizi obw’obwakatonda obw’enteekateeka eno ey’obulokozi eyita mu kwegayiririra abalala, kuzuukusa emmeeme n’etegeera ekigendererwa kyayo eky’ekitalo, era kugisiba amaanyi olw’okwefiiriza okw’omukisa kwe kugiyitira.

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Bwe yayita abantu be okuva mu Misiri, yayawula ekika kya bakabona, okusembera gy’ali, n’okuyimirira mu maaso ge, n’okuwa abantu omukisa mu linnya lye. Buli lwe kyabanga kyetaagisa yanoonyanga abegayirizi, n’abafuna, n’abawa ekitiibwa, era ku lwabwe n’asonyiwa abantu be oba n’abawa omukisa. Mukama waffe bwe yali ava ku nsi, yagamba ekibinja eky’omunda kye yali akuŋŋaanyizza okumwetooloola — ekibinja eky’omunda ekyewaayo ennyo mu kumuweereza, era ekikyaggule eri buli muyigirizwa — nti: “Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala … buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.” Twalaba dda ebigambo ebisatu eby’ekitalo ebiddibwamu emirundi mukaaga — Buli kye munaasabanga—Mu linnya lyange—Kinaabakolerwanga. Mu byo Kristo yateeka amaanyi g’ensi ey’omu ggulu mu mikono gyabwe — si lwa kwefaako bokka, wabula olw’obwakabaka bwe. Tumanyi engeri ey’ekitalo gye baagakozesaamu. Era okuva olwo, mu mirembe gyonna, abasajja abo babaddenga n’abaddira mu bigere byabwe, abasajja abaakakasa nti ddala Katonda akola ng’addamu okusaba. Era tuyinza okutendereza Katonda nti ne mu biseera byaffe, waliwo omuwendo ogweyongera buli kiseera gw’abo abatandika okulaba n’okukakasa nti mu kkanisa ne mu buminsani, mu bibiina ebinene ne mu bibinja ebitono ne mu kufuba kw’omuntu kinnoomu, okwegayiririra abalala kye kintu ekisinga obukulu, amaanyi agaleetera Katonda okukola era agaggulawo eggulu. Bayiga, era beegomba okuyiga obulungi okusingawo, era nti bonna bayige, nti mu mulimu gwonna ogw’emyoyo okwegayiririra abalala kuteekwa okusooka, era nti abo abaafuna okuva mu ggulu mu kwegayiririra okwo, mu maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kye balina okugabira abalala, be bajja okusinga okusobola okukola omulimu gwa Mukama.

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Wadde nga Katonda yalina abaddu be be yalonda mu Isirayiri, abakuumi be yeeteerawo yekka okumukaabiriranga emisana n’ekiro n’obutamuganya kuwummula, emirundi mingi yeewuunyanga era ne yeemulugunya nti tewali mwegayirizi, tewali n’omu eyewaliriza okukwata ku maanyi ge. Era akyalindirira era akyewuunya ne mu biseera byaffe, nti abegayirizi tebali bangi okusingawo, nti abaana be bonna tebeewaayo ku mulimu guno ogusinga obugulumivu n’obutukuvu, nti bangi ku abo abagukola tebagukola n’amaanyi agasingawo n’obugumiikiriza. Yeewuunya okulaba abasumba b’Enjiri ye nga beemulugunya nti emirimu gyabwe tegibakkiriza kufuna budde bwa kino, ky’abalirira okuba omulimu gwabwe ogusooka, ogusinga obugulumivu, ogusinga okusanyusa, era omulimu gwabwe gwokka ogulina amaanyi. Yeewuunya okulaba batabani be ne bawala be, abaaleka amaka n’emikwano ku lulwe ne ku lw’Enjiri, nga balemererwa nnyo mu ekyo kye yali ayagala kibeere amaanyi gaabwe ag’olubeerera — okufuna buli lunaku byonna bye beetaaga okugabira abatamanyi Katonda abali mu kizikiza. Yeewuunya okulaba abaana be bangi nnyo abatategeera n’akatono okwegayiririra abalala kye kuli. Yeewuunya okulaba abalala bangi nnyo okusingawo abaayiga nti buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe, era abagezaako okubutuukiriza, naye nga baatula nti tebamanyi nnyo ku kukwata ku Katonda oba okuwangula mu maaso ge.

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Ayagala nnyo okugaba emikisa eminene okusingawo. Ayagala nnyo okubikkula mu bungi okusingawo amaanyi ge n’ekitiibwa kye nga Katonda, n’okwagala kwe okulokola. Anoonya abegayirizi abangi okusingawo, ab’amaanyi okusingawo, okuteekateeka ekkubo lya Mukama. Abanoonya. Yandibanoonyezza wa, okuggyako mu Kkanisa ye? Era asuubira kubafuna atya? Yakwasa Ekkanisa ye omulimu gw’okubabuulira ku bwetaavu bwa Mukama waabwe, omulimu gw’okubazzaamu amaanyi n’okubatendeka, n’okubateekateeka olw’obuweereza bwe obutukuvu. Era bulijjo addamu okujja, ng’anoonya ebibala, ng’anoonya abegayirizi. Mu Kigambo kye ayogedde ku bannamwandu ddala: “Oyo aba nnamwandu ddala, … essuubi lye aba alitadde mu Katonda, era anyiikire okwegayirira n’okusaba Katonda emisana n’ekiro.” Atunuulira alabe obanga Ekkanisa etendeka eggye eddene ery’abasajja n’abakazi abakadde, abataakyasobola kukola mirimu gya bweru, naye abayinza okunyweza eggye ly’abo “be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro.” Atunuulira ekibiina ekinene ekya Christian Endeavour, obukadde busatu oba buna obw’abavubuka abeewaayo mu kweyama okw’amaanyi nti, “Nsuubiza Mukama Yesu Kristo nti nja kufuba okukola buli ky’ayagala nkole,” era yeebuuza bameka abatendekebwa okuva mu kitangaala ky’olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olwa buli wiiki n’okwatula obwesigwa kwalwo, okwegatta ku kwegayiririra abalala okw’omu kyama okulina okulokola emyoyo. Atunuulira enkumi n’enkumi z’abavubuka abalenzi n’abawala abatendekebwa olw’omulimu gw’obusumba n’obuminsani, era atunuulira n’okwegomba okulaba obanga Ekkanisa ebayigiriza nti okwegayiririra abalala, amaanyi mu maaso ga Katonda, kye kirina okusooka okubafaako, era obanga efuba okubatendeka n’okubayamba okukutuukako. Atunuulira alabe obanga abasumba n’abaminsani bategeera omukisa gwe balina, era nga bafuba okutendeka abakkiriza b’ekibiina kyabwe okufuuka abo abayinza okukolera awamu nabo mu kusaba, nga Pawulo bwe yagamba nti “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira,” era abayinza, nga Pawulo bwe yakuutira, “okufubiranga awamu nange, nga munsabira eri Katonda.” Nga Kristo bw’anoonya endiga ebuze okutuusa lw’agiraba, Katonda anoonya abegayirizi. (Laba Ekyongerezo F.)

Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Tajja, era tayinza, kuggya mulimu guno mu mikono gy’Ekkanisa ye. N’olwekyo ajja, ng’ayita era nga yeegayirira mu ngeri nnyingi. Omuwala oyo omukozi w’awaka, omupakasi ono, omulwadde oyo agalamidde ku kitanda, omuwala ono mu maka ga nnyina, abasajja bano n’abavubuka abali mu bya bizinensi — bonna bayitiddwa, bonna, bonna beetaagibwa. Tunoonye ku lw’abantu baffe okufuna okuva eri Katonda yennyini Omwoyo n’Obulamu bye tubuulira. Omwoyo gwaffe n’obulamu bwaffe bwe biriba biweereddwayo eri Katonda mu kwegayiririra abalala, Omwoyo n’Obulamu Katonda by’abawa ng’ayita mu ffe tebiyinza butaba Bulamu bwa Kwegayiririra Abalala nabyo.
fields.body_text: “Ntadde abakuumi ku bbugwe wo, ggwe Yerusaalemi abataasirike emisana n’ekiro. Mmwe abakoowoola Mukama temuwummula. Era temumuganya kuwummula okutuusa nga azimbye Yerusaalemi era ng’agifudde ettendo mu nsi.”—Isaaya 62:6, 7. “N’alaba nga tewali muntu, ne yennyamira nti tewali muntu ayinza kudduukirira.”—Isaaya 59:16. “Natunula naye nga tewali n’omu ayinza kunnyamba, newuunya okulaba nga tewaali n’omu ayinza kunkwatirako.”—Isaaya 63:5. “Tewali n’omu akoowoola linnya lyo oba eyewaliriza okukukwatako.”—Isaaya 64:7. “Ne nnoonya omuntu mu bo ayinza okuzimba ekisenge era ayinza okubeeyimiririra mu maaso gange ku lw’ensi, naye ne siraba n’omu.”—Ezeekyeri 22:30. “Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala … buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.”—Yokaana 15:16. Mu kwekenneenya eggulu erijjudde emmunyeenye, bingi nnyo byesigamye ku kutegeera obunene bw’ebintu nga bwe buli ddala. Awatali kumanya ku bunene bw’ebitangaala eby’omu ggulu — ebirabika nga bitono nnyo eri amaaso, songa binene nnyo — n’obugazi bw’ebbanga mwe bitambulira obukunukkiriza okuba obutakoma, wadde nga birabika nga biri kumpi era nga tubimanyidde, tewayinza kubaawo kumanya kwa mazima ku nsi ey’omu ggulu oba ku nkolagana yaayo n’ensi eno. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne ku ggulu ery’omwoyo, n’obulamu obw’omu ggulu bwe twayitibwa okubeeramu. Era kino kisinga nnyo okuba bwe kityo mu bulamu bw’okwegayiririra abalala, okukwatagana okwo okw’ekitalo ennyo wakati w’eggulu n’ensi. Buli kimu kyesigamye ku kutegeera obunene bw’ebintu nga bwe buli ddala. Lowooza ku bintu ebisatu ebisooka: Waliwo ensi, n’ebyetaago byayo, eyesigamye ddala ku kwegayiririra abalala era erindirira okuyambibwa nakwo; waliwo Katonda mu ggulu, alina eby’okugaba ebimala ebyetaago ebyo byonna, alindirira okusabibwa; waliwo Ekkanisa, n’okuyitibwa kwayo okw’ekitalo n’ebisuubizo byayo ebikakafu, erindirira okuzuukusibwa etegeere obuvunaanyizibwa bwayo obw’ekitalo n’amaanyi g’erina. Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Waliwo ensi n’obukadde bwayo bw’abantu abazikirira, nga okwegayiririra abalala lye ssuubi lyayo lyokka. Okwagala n’emirimu bingi nnyo biba nga bya bwereere, kubanga okwegayiririra abalala kutono nnyo. Abantu akawumbi kamu babeera ng’abatalina Mwana wa Katonda eyabafiirira. Obukadde amakumi asatu buli mwaka bayingira mu kizikiza eky’ebweru nga tebalina ssuubi. Obukadde amakumi ataano abayitibwa Abakristaayo, naye abasinga obungi babeera mu butamanya obw’enkomeredde oba mu butafaayo. Obukadde n’obukadde bw’Abakristaayo abanafu era abalwadde mu mwoyo; enkumi n’enkumi z’abakozi abakooye, abandiyinzizza okuweebwa omukisa olw’okwegayiririra abalala, era abandiyinzizza okwesobozesa okufuuka ab’amaanyi mu kwegayiririra abalala. Ekkanisa n’emirimu gy’obuminsani biwaayo obulamu n’okutegana, naye emirundi mingi ne bivaamu bitono, olw’okubulwa okwegayiririra abalala. Emyoyo, nga buli gumu gusinga ensi nnyingi omuwendo, nga gwenkana omuwendo ogwagusasulirwa mu musaayi gwa Kristo, era nga gusobola okutuukibwako amaanyi agayinza okufunibwa mu kwegayiririra abalala. Mazima ddala tetutegeera n’akatono obunene bw’omulimu ogulina okukolebwa abegayirizi ba Katonda; bwe twandibadde tubutegeera, twandikaabiridde Katonda okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna atuwe okuva mu ggulu omwoyo gw’okwegayiririra abalala. Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Waliwo Katonda ow’ekitiibwa ayinza okutuukiriza ebyetaago bino byonna. Tubuulirwa nti asanyukira okusaasira, nti ayagala nnyo okuba ow’ekisa, nti yeegomba okufuka omukisa gwe; era nti okwagala okwawaayo Omwana okufa kye kipimo ky’okwagala okwetooloola buli muntu buli kaseera. Naye era tayamba. Era abantu bazikirira, akakadde kamu buli mwezi mu China mwokka, era kiringa Katonda atakola kantu. Bw’aba ddala ayagala bw’atyo era ng’ayagala nnyo okuwa omukisa, wateekwa okubaawo ensonga etategeerekeka lwaki tayamba. Eyinza kuba ki? Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti: olw’obutakkiriza bwammwe. Bwe butakkiriza bw’abantu ba Katonda n’obutali beesigwa obubuvaamu. Yabatwala n’abafuula bakolagana naye; yabawa ekitiibwa, era ne yeesiba yekka, bwe yafuula okusaba kwabwe ekimu ku bipimo ebikulu eby’enkola y’amaanyi ge. Okubulwa okwegayiririra abalala y’emu ku nsonga enkulu ezireeta okubulwa omukisa. Ayi, singa twandikyusizza amaaso n’omutima okuva ku buli kintu ekirala ne tubitunuuliza ku Katonda ono awulira okusaba, okutuusa obukulu bw’ebisuubizo bye, n’amaanyi ge, n’ekigendererwa kye eky’okwagala lwe binaatuwamba! Obulamu bwaffe bwonna n’omutima gwaffe byandifuuse kwegayiririra abalala! Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Waliwo obunene obwokusatu amaaso gaffe bwe galina okuzibulwa okulaba: enkizo ey’ekitalo n’amaanyi g’abegayirizi. Waliwo obwetoowaze obw’obulimba, obufuula okwenyooma okuba empisa ennungi ennyo, kubanga tebulabanga nti ddala si kintu n’akatono. Singa bwali bumanyi ekyo, tebwandyetonze lwa bunafu bwabwo, wabula bwandyenyumirizza mu bunafu bwabwo obw’enkomeredde, nga ye mbeera yokka amaanyi ga Kristo mwe gayinza okubutuulako. Bwandyepimye bwo bwennyini, n’amaanyi gaabwo n’obuyinza bwabwo mu maaso ga Katonda mu kusaba, nga tebwesigama ku ebyo bye bulaba oba bye buwulira, nga naffe bwe tutapima bunene bwa njuba oba bwa mmunyeenye okusinziira ku ebyo amaaso bye galaba. Okukkiriza kulaba omuntu eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda ne mu ngeri ye okubeera omubaka wa Katonda mu nsi eno n’okugifuga. Okukkiriza kulaba omuntu eyanunulibwa n’asitulibwa n’agattibwa ne Kristo, ng’abeera mu Ye, ng’ali kimu naye, era ng’ayambaziddwa amaanyi ge mu kwegayiririra abalala. Okukkiriza kulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’abeera era ng’asabira mu mutima, ng’atwegayiririra mu kusinda kwaffe ng’okusiima kwa Katonda bwe kuli. Okukkiriza kulaba okwegayiririra kw’abatukuvu ng’ekitundu ku bulamu bw’Obusatu Obutukuvu — omukkiriza, ng’omwana wa Katonda, ng’asaba Kitaffe, mu Mwana, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo. Okukkiriza kulaba ku bulungi n’obusaanyizi obw’obwakatonda obw’enteekateeka eno ey’obulokozi eyita mu kwegayiririra abalala, kuzuukusa emmeeme n’etegeera ekigendererwa kyayo eky’ekitalo, era kugisiba amaanyi olw’okwefiiriza okw’omukisa kwe kugiyitira. Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Bwe yayita abantu be okuva mu Misiri, yayawula ekika kya bakabona, okusembera gy’ali, n’okuyimirira mu maaso ge, n’okuwa abantu omukisa mu linnya lye. Buli lwe kyabanga kyetaagisa yanoonyanga abegayirizi, n’abafuna, n’abawa ekitiibwa, era ku lwabwe n’asonyiwa abantu be oba n’abawa omukisa. Mukama waffe bwe yali ava ku nsi, yagamba ekibinja eky’omunda kye yali akuŋŋaanyizza okumwetooloola — ekibinja eky’omunda ekyewaayo ennyo mu kumuweereza, era ekikyaggule eri buli muyigirizwa — nti: “Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala … buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.” Twalaba dda ebigambo ebisatu eby’ekitalo ebiddibwamu emirundi mukaaga — Buli kye munaasabanga—Mu linnya lyange—Kinaabakolerwanga. Mu byo Kristo yateeka amaanyi g’ensi ey’omu ggulu mu mikono gyabwe — si lwa kwefaako bokka, wabula olw’obwakabaka bwe. Tumanyi engeri ey’ekitalo gye baagakozesaamu. Era okuva olwo, mu mirembe gyonna, abasajja abo babaddenga n’abaddira mu bigere byabwe, abasajja abaakakasa nti ddala Katonda akola ng’addamu okusaba. Era tuyinza okutendereza Katonda nti ne mu biseera byaffe, waliwo omuwendo ogweyongera buli kiseera gw’abo abatandika okulaba n’okukakasa nti mu kkanisa ne mu buminsani, mu bibiina ebinene ne mu bibinja ebitono ne mu kufuba kw’omuntu kinnoomu, okwegayiririra abalala kye kintu ekisinga obukulu, amaanyi agaleetera Katonda okukola era agaggulawo eggulu. Bayiga, era beegomba okuyiga obulungi okusingawo, era nti bonna bayige, nti mu mulimu gwonna ogw’emyoyo okwegayiririra abalala kuteekwa okusooka, era nti abo abaafuna okuva mu ggulu mu kwegayiririra okwo, mu maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kye balina okugabira abalala, be bajja okusinga okusobola okukola omulimu gwa Mukama. Era akyalindirira era akyewuunya ne mu biseera byaffe, nti abegayirizi tebali bangi okusingawo, nti abaana be bonna tebeewaayo ku mulimu guno ogusinga obugulumivu n’obutukuvu, nti bangi ku abo abagukola tebagukola n’amaanyi agasingawo n’obugumiikiriza. Yeewuunya okulaba abasumba b’Enjiri ye nga beemulugunya nti emirimu gyabwe tegibakkiriza kufuna budde bwa kino, ky’abalirira okuba omulimu gwabwe ogusooka, ogusinga obugulumivu, ogusinga okusanyusa, era omulimu gwabwe gwokka ogulina amaanyi. Yeewuunya okulaba batabani be ne bawala be, abaaleka amaka n’emikwano ku lulwe ne ku lw’Enjiri, nga balemererwa nnyo mu ekyo kye yali ayagala kibeere amaanyi gaabwe ag’olubeerera — okufuna buli lunaku byonna bye beetaaga okugabira abatamanyi Katonda abali mu kizikiza. Yeewuunya okulaba abaana be bangi nnyo abatategeera n’akatono okwegayiririra abalala kye kuli. Yeewuunya okulaba abalala bangi nnyo okusingawo abaayiga nti buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe, era abagezaako okubutuukiriza, naye nga baatula nti tebamanyi nnyo ku kukwata ku Katonda oba okuwangula mu maaso ge. Katonda anoonya abegayirizi.—Ayagala nnyo okugaba emikisa eminene okusingawo. Ayagala nnyo okubikkula mu bungi okusingawo amaanyi ge n’ekitiibwa kye nga Katonda, n’okwagala kwe okulokola. Anoonya abegayirizi abangi okusingawo, ab’amaanyi okusingawo, okuteekateeka ekkubo lya Mukama. Abanoonya. Yandibanoonyezza wa, okuggyako mu Kkanisa ye? Era asuubira kubafuna atya? Yakwasa Ekkanisa ye omulimu gw’okubabuulira ku bwetaavu bwa Mukama waabwe, omulimu gw’okubazzaamu amaanyi n’okubatendeka, n’okubateekateeka olw’obuweereza bwe obutukuvu. Era bulijjo addamu okujja, ng’anoonya ebibala, ng’anoonya abegayirizi. Mu Kigambo kye ayogedde ku bannamwandu ddala: “Oyo aba nnamwandu ddala, … essuubi lye aba alitadde mu Katonda, era anyiikire okwegayirira n’okusaba Katonda emisana n’ekiro.” Atunuulira alabe obanga Ekkanisa etendeka eggye eddene ery’abasajja n’abakazi abakadde, abataakyasobola kukola mirimu gya bweru, naye abayinza okunyweza eggye ly’abo “be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro.” Atunuulira ekibiina ekinene ekya Christian Endeavour, obukadde busatu oba buna obw’abavubuka abeewaayo mu kweyama okw’amaanyi nti, “Nsuubiza Mukama Yesu Kristo nti nja kufuba okukola buli ky’ayagala nkole,” era yeebuuza bameka abatendekebwa okuva mu kitangaala ky’olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olwa buli wiiki n’okwatula obwesigwa kwalwo, okwegatta ku kwegayiririra abalala okw’omu kyama okulina okulokola emyoyo. Atunuulira enkumi n’enkumi z’abavubuka abalenzi n’abawala abatendekebwa olw’omulimu gw’obusumba n’obuminsani, era atunuulira n’okwegomba okulaba obanga Ekkanisa ebayigiriza nti okwegayiririra abalala, amaanyi mu maaso ga Katonda, kye kirina okusooka okubafaako, era obanga efuba okubatendeka n’okubayamba okukutuukako. Atunuulira alabe obanga abasumba n’abaminsani bategeera omukisa gwe balina, era nga bafuba okutendeka abakkiriza b’ekibiina kyabwe okufuuka abo abayinza okukolera awamu nabo mu kusaba, nga Pawulo bwe yagamba nti “Tukolere wamu nga mutusabira,” era abayinza, nga Pawulo bwe yakuutira, “okufubiranga awamu nange, nga munsabira eri Katonda.” Nga Kristo bw’anoonya endiga ebuze okutuusa lw’agiraba, Katonda anoonya abegayirizi. fields.title: Okuzuukuka Okujja
fields.body_html:
“Tolituzaamu ndasi, abantu bo basanyukirenga mu ggwe?”—Zabbuli 85:6.

“Ayi Mukama, … Bizze buggya mu nnaku zaffe, bimanyise mu biro bino.”—Kaabakuuku 3:2.

“Newaakubadde nga neetooloddwa ebizibu, naye ggwe okuuma obulamu bwange; … era omukono gwo ogwa ddyo ne gumponya.”—Zabbuli 138:7.

“Ntuula … awamu n’oyo alina omwoyo oguboneredde ogwetoowaza, okuzzaamu amaanyi omwoyo gw’abakkakkamu, era n’ogw’abo ababoneredde.”—Isaaya 57:15.

“Mujje, tudde eri Mukama. Atutaaguddetaagudde, naye alituwonya; … alituzzaamu obulamu.”—Koseya 6:1, 2.

Okuzuukuka Okujja—ebigambo bino bitera okuwulirwa. Waliwo abayigiriza abatali batono abalaba obubonero obulaga nti kusembedde, era abalangirira n’obuvumu nti kujja mangu. Mu kweyongera kw’omwoyo gw’obuminsani, mu mawulire g’okuzuukuka mu bifo awaali buli kimu nga kifudde oba nga kinnyogovu, mu nkumu z’abavubuka baffe abakuŋŋaanyiziddwa mu Bibiina by’Abayizi n’ebibiina ebirala oba mu Bibiina bya Christian Endeavour, mu nzigi eziggule buli wamu mu nsi y’Abakristaayo n’ey’abakaafiiri, mu buwanguzi obumaze okufunibwa mu nnimiro ezengedde okukungulwa—buli abakozi abakkiriza era abalina essuubi gye bayingira, basangayo obukakafu nti kiri kumpi ekiseera eky’amaanyi n’omukisa ebitamanyiddwangako. Ekkanisa eri kumpi okuyingira mu mulembe omuggya ogw’obulamu bw’omwoyo obweyongera n’okugaziwa okusingawo.

Waliwo abalala abakkiriza nti ebimu ku bino bituufu, naye ne batya nti ebisalibwawo okuva mu byo bitunuulira ludda lumu era byanguyiriziddwa. Balaba nga omwoyo gw’obuminsani gweyongedde, naye ne balaga nga bwe gukomye mu kibinja kitono nnyo, era nga bwe gutatuuka n’akatono ku kye gwandibadde. Eri abakkiriza abasinga obungi, eri ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’Ekkanisa, gukyali si nsonga ya bulamu n’akatono. Batujjukiza amaanyi g’okwagala ensi n’okusinza okw’okungulu obwereere, okweyongera kw’omwoyo gw’okunoonya ensimbi n’okwagala amasanyu mu abo abeeyita Abakristaayo, obutaba na bya mwoyo mu makanisa gaffe mangi nnyo, n’enkumu z’abantu ezeeyongera okwesamba Olunaku lwa Katonda n’Ekigambo kye—nga bwe bukakafu nti okuzuukuka okunene mazima tekunnatandika, era abasinga obungi tebakirowoozaako n’akatono. Bagamba nti tebalaba kwetoowaza okw’amaanyi, okwegomba okw’amaanyi, n’okusaba okw’omwoyo ogubuguma, ebirabika ng’ebikulembera buli kuzuukuka okwa nnamaddala.

Waliwo ensobi ez’oku mukono ogwa ddyo n’ez’oku mukono ogwa kkono, nga zonna za kabi kyenkanyi. Tulina okufuba okukuumibwa okuva mu ssuubi ery’okungulu, eritasobola kupima bunene bwa bubi, kyenkanyi n’okuva mu kuggwaamu essuubi okutasobola kutendereza Katonda olw’ebyo by’akoze, wadde okumwesiga olw’ebyo by’ali mwetegefu okukola. Ery’olubereberye lyebuzira mu kwesiima okw’essanyu, nga lisanyukira obunyiikivu bwalyo n’obukozi bwalyo n’obuwanguzi obulabika, ne litalaba bwetaavu bwa kwatula na kufuba nnyo mu kusaba nga tetunnaba kweteekateeka kusisinkana n’okuwangula amaggye g’ekizikiza. Okw’okubiri kumala gawaayo ensi eri Setaani, era kunaatera okusaba n’okusanyuka okulaba ebintu nga byonooneka okusingawo, okwanguya okujja kw’Oyo agenda okutereeza byonna. Katonda atukuume eri ensobi zino zombi, atuukirize ekisuubizo nti: “Bw’olidda ku mukono ogwa ddyo oba ku gwa kkono, amatu go galiwulira eddoboozi emabega wo nga ligamba nti, Lino ly’ekkubo, litambuliremu.” Ka tuwulirize amagezi agava mu byawandiikibwa bye tujulizza; gayinza okutuyamba okusaba obulungi essaala eno: “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”

1. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Ddamu osome ebyawandiikibwa ebyo, olabe nga byonna birimu ekirowoozo kimu: Okuzuukuka mulimu gwa Katonda; Ye yekka y’asobola okukuwa; kulina okuva waggulu. Tutera okuba mu kabi ak’okutunuulira ebyo Katonda by’akoze n’ebyo by’akyakola, ne tubyesigamako ng’omusingo nti amangu ddala ajja kukola n’okusingawo. Ate ekiseera kyonna kino kiyinza okuba nga kituufu nti atuwa omukisa okusinziira ku kigero ky’okukkiriza kwaffe oba eky’okwefiiriza kwaffe, era nga tasobola kutuwa kigero kinene okusingawo okutuusa ng’ekimulemesa kimaze okuzuulibwa obuggya n’okwatulwa. Oba tuyinza okuba nga tutunuulira obubonero bwonna obw’obulamu n’ebirungi ebitwetoolodde, ne twesiima olw’ebibiina byonna n’enkola ebitondebwawo, so nga obwetaavu bw’okuyingira mu nsonga kwa Katonda okw’amaanyi era okw’obutereevu tebuwulirwa nga bwe kisaanidde, n’okwesigama ku ye kwokka tekukuzibwa. Okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, okuweebwa obulamu obw’obwakatonda, ffenna tukkiriza nti kikolwa kya Katonda, kyamagero eky’amaanyi ge. Okuzzaawo oba okuzuukusa obulamu obw’obwakatonda, mu mwoyo gw’omuntu oba mu Kkanisa, nakwo mulimu ogusukkulumye ku butonde kyenkanyi. Okusobola okufuna okutegeera okw’omwoyo okumanya obubonero bw’eggulu, n’okulagula okuzuukuka okujja, tulina okuyingira ennyo mu kirowoozo kya Katonda n’ebyo by’ayagala ku bikwata ku mitendera gyakwo, n’okwetegeka kw’abo abakusabira oba abagenda okukozesebwa okukuleeta. “Naye ddala Mukama Katonda takola kintu kyonna nga tasoose kukibikkulira baweereza be, bannabbi.” Katonda y’agenda okuwa okuzuukuka; Katonda y’abikkula ekyama kye; era omwoyo ogw’okwesigamira ddala ku Katonda, nga tumuwa ekitiibwa n’ettendo, gwe gulikuteekerateekera.

2. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Ekyokuyiga eky’okubiri kye tulaba kiri nti okuzuukuka Katonda kw’agenda okuwa kujja kuweebwa ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba. Kulina okusabibwa n’okuweebwa butereevu okuva eri Katonda yennyini. Abo abamanyiiko ku byafaayo by’okuzuukuka bajja kujjukira emirundi emingi kino bwe kyakakasibwa—okuzuukuka okunene n’okw’omu bitundu kulondoolebwa butereevu okutuuka ku kusaba okw’enjawulo. Mu biseera byaffe waliwo ebibiina by’abakkiriza bingi n’emirimu gy’obuminsani mingi, omuli okuzuukuka okw’enjawulo oba okw’olutentezi—ekitiibwa kyonna kibe kya Katonda—okukwatagana n’okusaba okutegeke, okw’okukkiriza. Okuzuukuka okujja tekujja kuba kwa njawulo. Omwoyo gw’okusaba ogw’ekitalo, ogukubiriza abakkiriza okusaba ennyo mu kyama n’awamu, ogubakubiriza “okufuba” mu kwegayirira kwabwe, gujja kuba gumu ku bubonero obusingayo okukakasa nti enkuba n’amataba g’omukisa biri kumpi.

Bonna abazitoowereddwa obutaba na bya mwoyo, n’embeera ennafu ey’obulamu bwa Katonda mu bakkiriza, ka bawulirize omulanga oguyita bonna. Bwe kuba nga waliwo okuzuukuka okugenda okujja,—okuzuukuka okw’amaanyi, okuva eri Katonda,—kujja kwetaaga, ku ludda lwaffe, okwewaayo n’omutima gwonna mu kusaba ne mu kukkiriza okukwatagana nakwo. Tewabaawo mukkiriza n’omu alowooza nti munafu nnyo okuyamba, oba nti tewali alimusubwa. Bw’alisooka okutandika, ekirabo ekiri mu ye kiyinza okuseesebwa ne kiba nti, mu kibinja kye oba mu kitundu kye, aba omwegayirizi wa Katonda gwe yalonda. Ka tulowooze ku bwetaavu bw’emyoyo, ku bibi byonna n’obunafu mu bantu ba Katonda, ku maanyi amatono agali mu kubuulira okungi, era tutandike okukaaba buli lunaku nti, “Tolituzaamu ndasi, abantu bo basanyukirenga mu ggwe?” Era amazima gano ka gawandiikibwe nnyo ku mitima gyaffe: buli kuzuukuka kujja, nga Pentekooti bwe yajja, ng’ekibala ky’okusaba okw’awamu era okutakoma. Okuzuukuka okujja kulina okutandika n’okuzuukuka okunene okw’okusaba. Mu kisenge, nga tweggaliddemu, okubwatuka kw’enkuba ey’amaanyi we kujja okusooka okuwulirwa. Okweyongera kw’okusaba okw’ekyama mu basumba ne mu bakkiriza kujja kuba kabonero akakakafu ak’omukisa ogujja.

3. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Ekyokuyiga eky’okusatu ebyawandiikibwa byaffe kye biyigiriza kiri nti okuzuukuka kusuubizibwa abo abeetoowaze era ababoneredde. Twagala okuzuukuka kujje ku b’amalala n’abeematira, kubamenye era kubalokole. Katonda ajja kukuwa, naye ku kakwakkulizo kamu kokka: abo abalaba era abawulira ekibi ky’abalala basitule omugugu gw’okukyatula, era bonna abasabira era abakaayanira mu kukkiriza amaanyi ga Katonda agazuukusa ku lw’Ekkanisa ye beetoowaze nga baatula ebibi byayo. Obwetaavu bw’okuzuukuka bulijjo bulaga nti waasooka okuddirira; era okuddirira bulijjo kwaleetebwa kibi. Okwetoowaza n’okubonerera bulijjo bibadde bisaanyizo by’okuzuukuka. Mu kwegayiririra abalala kwonna, okwatula ekibi ky’omuntu n’omusango gwa Katonda ogw’obutuukirivu bulijjo kitundu ekikulu ekitayinza kubulawo.

Mu byafaayo byonna ebya Isirayiri tulaba kino buli kiseera. Kirabikira mu nkyukakyuka ez’okuzza obuggya ezaaliwo wansi wa bakabaka ba Yuda abatya Katonda. Tukiwulira mu kusaba kw’abasajja nga Ezera ne Nekkemiya ne Danyeri. Mu Isaaya ne Yeremiya ne Ezeekyeri, era ne mu bannabbi abatono, kye kigambo ekikulu mu kulabula kwonna era ne mu bisuubizo byonna. Bwe wataba kwetoowaza n’okuleka ekibi, tewayinza kubaawo kuzuukuka wadde okununulibwa: “Abasajja bano batadde bakatonda abalala ku mitima gyabwe … Mbakkirize banneebuuzeeko?” “Ono ye muntu gwe ntunulako; oyo ow’eggonjebwa era omwetoowaze mu mwoyo, oyo akankanira ekigambo kyange.” Wakati mu bisuubizo ebisingayo okujjula ekisa eby’okukyalira kwa Katonda, bulijjo wabaamu eddoboozi lino: “Muswale olw’ebikolwa byammwe, mmwe ennyumba ya Isirayiri.”

Kye kimu kye tusanga mu Ndagaano Empya. Okubuulira okw’oku Lusozi kusuubiza obwakabaka abaavu mu mwoyo n’abali mu nnaku. Mu Bbaluwa eri Abakkolinso n’eri Abaggalatiya, eddiini y’omuntu, ey’amagezi ag’ensi n’okwesiga omubiri, eyanikibwa era evumirirwa; bw’etaatulwa n’erekebwa, ebisuubizo byonna eby’ekisa n’eby’Omwoyo biriba bya bwereere. Mu Bbaluwa eri amakanisa omusanvu tusangamu amakanisa ataano, Oyo alina ekitala ekyogi eky’obwogi obubiri ekiva mu kamwa ke g’agamba nti alina ky’agalumiriza. Eri buli limu ku go, ekigambo ekikulu eky’obubaka bwe—si eri abatannakyuka, wabula eri Ekkanisa—kiri nti: Weenenye! Ebisuubizo byonna eby’ekitiibwa ebiri mu buli Bbaluwa ku zino, okutuuka ku esembayo, n’ekigambo kyayo nti “Buli awulira eddoboozi lyange n’aggulawo, nnaayingira omumwe”; “Buli awangula ndimukkiriza okutuula ng’anninaanye, ku ntebe yange ey’obwakabaka,” byesigamye ku kigambo ekyo kimu—Weenenye!

Era bwe kuba nga waliwo okuzuukuka okugenda okujja, si mu abo abatannalokoka, wabula mu makanisa gaffe, okuleeta abakkiriza abatukuvu era ab’omwoyo, eddoboozi eryo ery’ekkondeere teryetaagisa kuwulirwa—Weenenye? Mu Isirayiri mwokka, mu buweereza bwa bakabaka ne bannabbi, mwe mwali obubi obungi bwe butyo mu bantu ba Katonda obwali bwetaaga okunaazibwawo? Mu Kkanisa ey’omu kyasa ekyasooka mwokka Pawulo ne Yakobo ne Mukama waffe yennyini mwe baalina okwogerera ebigambo ebisala bwe bityo? Oba mu Kkanisa ey’omu biseera byaffe temuli kusinza nsimbi n’ebitone n’obuyigirize, omwoyo gw’ensi ogugifuula obutaba nnamwesigwa eri Bba waayo omu yekka era Mukama waayo, n’okwesiga omubiri okunakuwaza n’okuziyiza Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda? Kumpi buli wamu tewali kwatula nti tewali bya mwoyo n’amaanyi ag’omwoyo? Bonna abeegomba okuzuukuka okujja, era abaagala okukwanguya n’okusaba kwabwe, ka basabe kino okusinga byonna, Mukama ateeketeeke bannabbi be okumukulemberamu nga bw’abalagira: “Kyogere mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka, tokisirikira. Yimusa eddoboozi lyo ng’ekkondeere, obuulire abantu bange okusobya kwabwe.” Buli kuzuukuka okw’amaanyi mu bantu ba Katonda kulina okuba n’emirandira gyakwo mu kuwulira okw’amaanyi n’okwatula ekibi. Okutuusa abo abaagala okukulembera Ekkanisa mu kkubo ery’okuzuukuka lwe banaawa obujulirwa obw’obwesigwa ku bibi by’Ekkanisa, kitiisa nti kunaasanga abantu nga tebetegese. Abantu bandyagadde okuzuukuka kujje ng’ekibala ky’enkola zaabwe n’enkulaakulana yaabwe. Ekkubo lya Katonda lya kikontana: azuukusa ng’ayita mu kufa—okufa okukkirizibwa ng’empeera y’ekibi, okwatulwa ng’obutaba na maanyi n’akatono. Azzaamu amaanyi omutima gw’oyo aboneredde.

4. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Waliwo ekirowoozo ekisembayo, ekiva mu kyawandiikibwa kya Koseya. Okuzuukuka kujja kujja nga tudda eri Mukama; kubanga singa tetwamuvaako, obulamu bwe bwandibadde mu ffe n’amaanyi. “Mujje, tudde eri Mukama. Atutaaguddetaagudde, naye alituwonya; atuleeseeko ebiwundu, naye ebiwundu alibinyiga. … alituzzaamu obulamu, … ne tubeera balamu mu maaso ge.” Nga bwe tumaze okwogera, tewayinza kubaawo kudda eri Mukama awatali kuwulira oba kwatula nti twawaba. Tudde eri Mukama kye kirina okuba ekigambo ekikulu eky’okuzuukuka. Tudde, nga tukkiriza era nga tuleka buli kyonna ekibadde mu Kkanisa ekitakwatagana ddala na kirowoozo kye n’omwoyo gwe. Tudde, nga tuwaayo era nga tugoba buli kyonna ekibadde mu ddiini yaffe oba ekigiwerekedde eky’amaanyi g’abalabe ba Katonda ababiri abakulu—okwesiga omubiri oba omwoyo gw’ensi. Tudde, nga tukkiriza nti Katonda ateekwa okututwala ffenna awatali kwawulamu, atujjuze Omwoyo we, era atukozese ku lw’obwakabaka bw’Omwana we. Ayi, tudde, mu kwewaayo okw’okwesigama n’okwemalira okutaliiko kipimo kirala okuggyako obwannannyini obujjuvu obw’Oyo ye Mukama! Tudde eri Mukama n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, alyoke atufuule era atukuume nga tuli babe ddala. Alituzzaamu obulamu, ne tubeera balamu mu maaso ge. Tukyukire Katonda wa Pentekooti, nga Kristo bwe yakulembera abayigirizwa be okumukyukira, era Katonda wa Pentekooti ajja kutukyukira.

Okudda kuno eri Mukama kwe kwetaagisa omulimu omunene ogw’okwegayiririra abalala. Wano okuzuukuka okujja we kulina okusanga amaanyi gaakwo. Ka tutandike nga buli muntu ku lulwe mu kyama okwegayirira Katonda, nga twatula kyonna kye tulaba eky’ekibi oba ekiremesa, mu ffe oba mu balala. Singa tewaali kibi kirala n’ekimu, mazima obutasaba bwokka bumala okuba ensonga ey’okwenenya n’okwatula n’okudda eri Mukama. Ka tufube okukuza omwoyo gw’okwatula n’okwegayirira n’okwegayiririra abalala mu abo abatwetoolodde. Ka tuyambe okuzzaamu amaanyi n’okutendeka abo abalowooza nti banafu nnyo. Ka tuyimuse eddoboozi lyaffe okulangirira amazima gano amakulu. Okuzuukuka kulina okuva waggulu; okuzuukuka kulina okufunibwa mu kukkiriza okuva waggulu era okuleetebwa wansi n’okusaba; okuzuukuka kujja eri abeetoowaze n’ababoneredde, bakutwale eri abalala; bwe tudda eri Mukama n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, alituzzaamu obulamu. Ku abo abalaba amazima gano, kwe kuli obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amaanyi obw’okwewaayo okugajulira n’okugakolerako.

Era nga buli omu ku ffe bw’asabira okuzuukuka mu Kkanisa yonna, ka tukaabirire Katonda mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, mu kiseera kye kimu, ku lw’ekitundu kyaffe oba ennimiro y’omulimu gwaffe. Ka wabeewo mu buli musumba na buli mukozi “okufumiitiriza ennyo mu mitima gyabwe,” oba nga beetegefu okuwaayo ekitundu ky’ebiseera n’amaanyi eri okusaba nga Katonda bw’ayagala. Nga bwe bakulembera mu lwatu ebibinja byabwe ebinene oba ebitono, ka beewe mu kyama okutwala ebifo byabwe mu lunyiriri olw’omu maaso olw’eggye eddene ery’abegayirizi, eriteekwa okuwangula mu maaso ga Katonda, okuzuukuka okunene n’amataba g’omukisa nga tebinnajja. Ku bonna aboogera ku kuzuukuka, oba abakulowoozaako, oba abakwegomba, tewabaawo n’omu asigala emabega mu mulimu guno omunene ogw’okwegayirira okw’obwesimbu, okw’amaanyi era okutongole: Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama! Tolituzaamu ndasi?

Mujje, tudde eri Mukama: alituzzaamu obulamu! Era tumanye Mukama; tunyiikire okumumanya. “Ng’enjuba bw’evaayo enkya, bw’atyo bw’alirabika; alijja gye tuli ng’enkuba ey’omu kiseera ky’omuzira, era ng’enkuba eya ddumbi efukirira ettaka.” Amiina. Kibe bwe kityo.
