Katonda atukuume eri ensobi zino zombi, atuukirize ekisuubizo nti: “Bw’olidda ku mukono ogwa ddyo oba ku gwa kkono, amatu go galiwulira eddoboozi emabega wo nga ligamba nti, Lino ly’ekkubo, litambuliremu.” Ka tuwulirize amagezi agava mu byawandiikibwa bye tujulizza; gayinza okutuyamba okusaba obulungi essaala eno: “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!” 1. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Ddamu osome ebyawandiikibwa ebyo, olabe nga byonna birimu ekirowoozo kimu: Okuzuukuka mulimu gwa Katonda; Ye yekka y’asobola okukuwa; kulina okuva waggulu. Tutera okuba mu kabi ak’okutunuulira ebyo Katonda by’akoze n’ebyo by’akyakola, ne tubyesigamako ng’omusingo nti amangu ddala ajja kukola n’okusingawo. Ate ekiseera kyonna kino kiyinza okuba nga kituufu nti atuwa omukisa okusinziira ku kigero ky’okukkiriza kwaffe oba eky’okwefiiriza kwaffe, era nga tasobola kutuwa kigero kinene okusingawo okutuusa ng’ekimulemesa kimaze okuzuulibwa obuggya n’okwatulwa. Oba tuyinza okuba nga tutunuulira obubonero bwonna obw’obulamu n’ebirungi ebitwetoolodde, ne twesiima olw’ebibiina byonna n’enkola ebitondebwawo, so nga obwetaavu bw’okuyingira mu nsonga kwa Katonda okw’amaanyi era okw’obutereevu tebuwulirwa nga bwe kisaanidde, n’okwesigama ku ye kwokka tekukuzibwa. Okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, okuweebwa obulamu obw’obwakatonda, ffenna tukkiriza nti kikolwa kya Katonda, kyamagero eky’amaanyi ge. Okuzzaawo oba okuzuukusa obulamu obw’obwakatonda, mu mwoyo gw’omuntu oba mu Kkanisa, nakwo mulimu ogusukkulumye ku butonde kyenkanyi. Okusobola okufuna okutegeera okw’omwoyo okumanya obubonero bw’eggulu, n’okulagula okuzuukuka okujja, tulina okuyingira ennyo mu kirowoozo kya Katonda n’ebyo by’ayagala ku bikwata ku mitendera gyakwo, n’okwetegeka kw’abo abakusabira oba abagenda okukozesebwa okukuleeta. “Naye ddala Mukama Katonda takola kintu kyonna nga tasoose kukibikkulira baweereza be, bannabbi.” Katonda y’agenda okuwa okuzuukuka; Katonda y’abikkula ekyama kye; era omwoyo ogw’okwesigamira ddala ku Katonda, nga tumuwa ekitiibwa n’ettendo, gwe gulikuteekerateekera. 2. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Ekyokuyiga eky’okubiri kye tulaba kiri nti okuzuukuka Katonda kw’agenda okuwa kujja kuweebwa ng’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba. Kulina okusabibwa n’okuweebwa butereevu okuva eri Katonda yennyini. Abo abamanyiiko ku byafaayo by’okuzuukuka bajja kujjukira emirundi emingi kino bwe kyakakasibwa—okuzuukuka okunene n’okw’omu bitundu kulondoolebwa butereevu okutuuka ku kusaba okw’enjawulo. Mu biseera byaffe waliwo ebibiina by’abakkiriza bingi n’emirimu gy’obuminsani mingi, omuli okuzuukuka okw’enjawulo oba okw’olutentezi—ekitiibwa kyonna kibe kya Katonda—okukwatagana n’okusaba okutegeke, okw’okukkiriza. Okuzuukuka okujja tekujja kuba kwa njawulo. Omwoyo gw’okusaba ogw’ekitalo, ogukubiriza abakkiriza okusaba ennyo mu kyama n’awamu, ogubakubiriza “okufuba” mu kwegayirira kwabwe, gujja kuba gumu ku bubonero obusingayo okukakasa nti enkuba n’amataba g’omukisa biri kumpi. Bonna abazitoowereddwa obutaba na bya mwoyo, n’embeera ennafu ey’obulamu bwa Katonda mu bakkiriza, ka bawulirize omulanga oguyita bonna. Bwe kuba nga waliwo okuzuukuka okugenda okujja,—okuzuukuka okw’amaanyi, okuva eri Katonda,—kujja kwetaaga, ku ludda lwaffe, okwewaayo n’omutima gwonna mu kusaba ne mu kukkiriza okukwatagana nakwo. Tewabaawo mukkiriza n’omu alowooza nti munafu nnyo okuyamba, oba nti tewali alimusubwa. Bw’alisooka okutandika, ekirabo ekiri mu ye kiyinza okuseesebwa ne kiba nti, mu kibinja kye oba mu kitundu kye, aba omwegayirizi wa Katonda gwe yalonda. Ka tulowooze ku bwetaavu bw’emyoyo, ku bibi byonna n’obunafu mu bantu ba Katonda, ku maanyi amatono agali mu kubuulira okungi, era tutandike okukaaba buli lunaku nti, “Tolituzaamu ndasi, abantu bo basanyukirenga mu ggwe?” Era amazima gano ka gawandiikibwe nnyo ku mitima gyaffe: buli kuzuukuka kujja, nga Pentekooti bwe yajja, ng’ekibala ky’okusaba okw’awamu era okutakoma. Okuzuukuka okujja kulina okutandika n’okuzuukuka okunene okw’okusaba. Mu kisenge, nga tweggaliddemu, okubwatuka kw’enkuba ey’amaanyi we kujja okusooka okuwulirwa. Okweyongera kw’okusaba okw’ekyama mu basumba ne mu bakkiriza kujja kuba kabonero akakakafu ak’omukisa ogujja. 3. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Ekyokuyiga eky’okusatu ebyawandiikibwa byaffe kye biyigiriza kiri nti okuzuukuka kusuubizibwa abo abeetoowaze era ababoneredde. Twagala okuzuukuka kujje ku b’amalala n’abeematira, kubamenye era kubalokole. Katonda ajja kukuwa, naye ku kakwakkulizo kamu kokka: abo abalaba era abawulira ekibi ky’abalala basitule omugugu gw’okukyatula, era bonna abasabira era abakaayanira mu kukkiriza amaanyi ga Katonda agazuukusa ku lw’Ekkanisa ye beetoowaze nga baatula ebibi byayo. Obwetaavu bw’okuzuukuka bulijjo bulaga nti waasooka okuddirira; era okuddirira bulijjo kwaleetebwa kibi. Okwetoowaza n’okubonerera bulijjo bibadde bisaanyizo by’okuzuukuka. Mu kwegayiririra abalala kwonna, okwatula ekibi ky’omuntu n’omusango gwa Katonda ogw’obutuukirivu bulijjo kitundu ekikulu ekitayinza kubulawo. Mu byafaayo byonna ebya Isirayiri tulaba kino buli kiseera. Kirabikira mu nkyukakyuka ez’okuzza obuggya ezaaliwo wansi wa bakabaka ba Yuda abatya Katonda. Tukiwulira mu kusaba kw’abasajja nga Ezera ne Nekkemiya ne Danyeri. Mu Isaaya ne Yeremiya ne Ezeekyeri, era ne mu bannabbi abatono, kye kigambo ekikulu mu kulabula kwonna era ne mu bisuubizo byonna. Bwe wataba kwetoowaza n’okuleka ekibi, tewayinza kubaawo kuzuukuka wadde okununulibwa: “Abasajja bano batadde bakatonda abalala ku mitima gyabwe … Mbakkirize banneebuuzeeko?” “Ono ye muntu gwe ntunulako; oyo ow’eggonjebwa era omwetoowaze mu mwoyo, oyo akankanira ekigambo kyange.” Wakati mu bisuubizo ebisingayo okujjula ekisa eby’okukyalira kwa Katonda, bulijjo wabaamu eddoboozi lino: “Muswale olw’ebikolwa byammwe, mmwe ennyumba ya Isirayiri.” Kye kimu kye tusanga mu Ndagaano Empya. Okubuulira okw’oku Lusozi kusuubiza obwakabaka abaavu mu mwoyo n’abali mu nnaku. Mu Bbaluwa eri Abakkolinso n’eri Abaggalatiya, eddiini y’omuntu, ey’amagezi ag’ensi n’okwesiga omubiri, eyanikibwa era evumirirwa; bw’etaatulwa n’erekebwa, ebisuubizo byonna eby’ekisa n’eby’Omwoyo biriba bya bwereere. Mu Bbaluwa eri amakanisa omusanvu tusangamu amakanisa ataano, Oyo alina ekitala ekyogi eky’obwogi obubiri ekiva mu kamwa ke g’agamba nti alina ky’agalumiriza. Eri buli limu ku go, ekigambo ekikulu eky’obubaka bwe—si eri abatannakyuka, wabula eri Ekkanisa—kiri nti: Weenenye! Ebisuubizo byonna eby’ekitiibwa ebiri mu buli Bbaluwa ku zino, okutuuka ku esembayo, n’ekigambo kyayo nti “Buli awulira eddoboozi lyange n’aggulawo, nnaayingira omumwe”; “Buli awangula ndimukkiriza okutuula ng’anninaanye, ku ntebe yange ey’obwakabaka,” byesigamye ku kigambo ekyo kimu—Weenenye! Era bwe kuba nga waliwo okuzuukuka okugenda okujja, si mu abo abatannalokoka, wabula mu makanisa gaffe, okuleeta abakkiriza abatukuvu era ab’omwoyo, eddoboozi eryo ery’ekkondeere teryetaagisa kuwulirwa—Weenenye? Mu Isirayiri mwokka, mu buweereza bwa bakabaka ne bannabbi, mwe mwali obubi obungi bwe butyo mu bantu ba Katonda obwali bwetaaga okunaazibwawo? Mu Kkanisa ey’omu kyasa ekyasooka mwokka Pawulo ne Yakobo ne Mukama waffe yennyini mwe baalina okwogerera ebigambo ebisala bwe bityo? Oba mu Kkanisa ey’omu biseera byaffe temuli kusinza nsimbi n’ebitone n’obuyigirize, omwoyo gw’ensi ogugifuula obutaba nnamwesigwa eri Bba waayo omu yekka era Mukama waayo, n’okwesiga omubiri okunakuwaza n’okuziyiza Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda? Kumpi buli wamu tewali kwatula nti tewali bya mwoyo n’amaanyi ag’omwoyo? Bonna abeegomba okuzuukuka okujja, era abaagala okukwanguya n’okusaba kwabwe, ka basabe kino okusinga byonna, Mukama ateeketeeke bannabbi be okumukulemberamu nga bw’abalagira: “Kyogere mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka, tokisirikira. Yimusa eddoboozi lyo ng’ekkondeere, obuulire abantu bange okusobya kwabwe.” Buli kuzuukuka okw’amaanyi mu bantu ba Katonda kulina okuba n’emirandira gyakwo mu kuwulira okw’amaanyi n’okwatula ekibi. Okutuusa abo abaagala okukulembera Ekkanisa mu kkubo ery’okuzuukuka lwe banaawa obujulirwa obw’obwesigwa ku bibi by’Ekkanisa, kitiisa nti kunaasanga abantu nga tebetegese. Abantu bandyagadde okuzuukuka kujje ng’ekibala ky’enkola zaabwe n’enkulaakulana yaabwe. Ekkubo lya Katonda lya kikontana: azuukusa ng’ayita mu kufa—okufa okukkirizibwa ng’empeera y’ekibi, okwatulwa ng’obutaba na maanyi n’akatono. Azzaamu amaanyi omutima gw’oyo aboneredde. 4. “Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama!”—Waliwo ekirowoozo ekisembayo, ekiva mu kyawandiikibwa kya Koseya. Okuzuukuka kujja kujja nga tudda eri Mukama; kubanga singa tetwamuvaako, obulamu bwe bwandibadde mu ffe n’amaanyi. “Mujje, tudde eri Mukama. Atutaaguddetaagudde, naye alituwonya; atuleeseeko ebiwundu, naye ebiwundu alibinyiga. … alituzzaamu obulamu, … ne tubeera balamu mu maaso ge.” Nga bwe tumaze okwogera, tewayinza kubaawo kudda eri Mukama awatali kuwulira oba kwatula nti twawaba. Tudde eri Mukama kye kirina okuba ekigambo ekikulu eky’okuzuukuka. Tudde, nga tukkiriza era nga tuleka buli kyonna ekibadde mu Kkanisa ekitakwatagana ddala na kirowoozo kye n’omwoyo gwe. Tudde, nga tuwaayo era nga tugoba buli kyonna ekibadde mu ddiini yaffe oba ekigiwerekedde eky’amaanyi g’abalabe ba Katonda ababiri abakulu—okwesiga omubiri oba omwoyo gw’ensi. Tudde, nga tukkiriza nti Katonda ateekwa okututwala ffenna awatali kwawulamu, atujjuze Omwoyo we, era atukozese ku lw’obwakabaka bw’Omwana we. Ayi, tudde, mu kwewaayo okw’okwesigama n’okwemalira okutaliiko kipimo kirala okuggyako obwannannyini obujjuvu obw’Oyo ye Mukama! Tudde eri Mukama n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, alyoke atufuule era atukuume nga tuli babe ddala. Alituzzaamu obulamu, ne tubeera balamu mu maaso ge. Tukyukire Katonda wa Pentekooti, nga Kristo bwe yakulembera abayigirizwa be okumukyukira, era Katonda wa Pentekooti ajja kutukyukira. Okudda kuno eri Mukama kwe kwetaagisa omulimu omunene ogw’okwegayiririra abalala. Wano okuzuukuka okujja we kulina okusanga amaanyi gaakwo. Ka tutandike nga buli muntu ku lulwe mu kyama okwegayirira Katonda, nga twatula kyonna kye tulaba eky’ekibi oba ekiremesa, mu ffe oba mu balala. Singa tewaali kibi kirala n’ekimu, mazima obutasaba bwokka bumala okuba ensonga ey’okwenenya n’okwatula n’okudda eri Mukama. Ka tufube okukuza omwoyo gw’okwatula n’okwegayirira n’okwegayiririra abalala mu abo abatwetoolodde. Ka tuyambe okuzzaamu amaanyi n’okutendeka abo abalowooza nti banafu nnyo. Ka tuyimuse eddoboozi lyaffe okulangirira amazima gano amakulu. Okuzuukuka kulina okuva waggulu; okuzuukuka kulina okufunibwa mu kukkiriza okuva waggulu era okuleetebwa wansi n’okusaba; okuzuukuka kujja eri abeetoowaze n’ababoneredde, bakutwale eri abalala; bwe tudda eri Mukama n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, alituzzaamu obulamu. Ku abo abalaba amazima gano, kwe kuli obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amaanyi obw’okwewaayo okugajulira n’okugakolerako. Era nga buli omu ku ffe bw’asabira okuzuukuka mu Kkanisa yonna, ka tukaabirire Katonda mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, mu kiseera kye kimu, ku lw’ekitundu kyaffe oba ennimiro y’omulimu gwaffe. Ka wabeewo mu buli musumba na buli mukozi “okufumiitiriza ennyo mu mitima gyabwe,” oba nga beetegefu okuwaayo ekitundu ky’ebiseera n’amaanyi eri okusaba nga Katonda bw’ayagala. Nga bwe bakulembera mu lwatu ebibinja byabwe ebinene oba ebitono, ka beewe mu kyama okutwala ebifo byabwe mu lunyiriri olw’omu maaso olw’eggye eddene ery’abegayirizi, eriteekwa okuwangula mu maaso ga Katonda, okuzuukuka okunene n’amataba g’omukisa nga tebinnajja. Ku bonna aboogera ku kuzuukuka, oba abakulowoozaako, oba abakwegomba, tewabaawo n’omu asigala emabega mu mulimu guno omunene ogw’okwegayirira okw’obwesimbu, okw’amaanyi era okutongole: Zuukusa omulimu gwo, Ayi Mukama! Tolituzaamu ndasi? Mujje, tudde eri Mukama: alituzzaamu obulamu! Era tumanye Mukama; tunyiikire okumumanya. “Ng’enjuba bw’evaayo enkya, bw’atyo bw’alirabika; alijja gye tuli ng’enkuba ey’omu kiseera ky’omuzira, era ng’enkuba eya ddumbi efukirira ettaka.” Amiina. Kibe bwe kityo.

fields.title: Ebyongerezo
fields.body_html:
EKYONGEREZO A, Essuula 6, olup. 73

Leero lwennyini mbadde nsisinkanye omukyala omuminsani anyiikivu ennyo okuva e Buyindi. Akkiriza era akungubagira obutasaba kimala. Naye—e Buyindi waakiri—kizibu okuba nga kiri bulala. Olina essaawa za ku makya zokka, okuva ku ssaawa kumi na bbiri okutuuka ku ssaawa ttaano, okukola omulimu gwo. Abamu bagezezzaako okugolokoka ku ssaawa kumi, bafune ebiseera bye balowooza nti beetaaga, ne babonaabona, ne kibeetaagisa okukireka. Abamu bagezezzaako okufuna ebiseera oluvannyuma lw’ekyemisana, ne basangibwa nga beebase nga bafukamidde. Toli mukama wa bulamu bwo, era olina okukola wamu n’abalala. Tewali n’omu atabangako mu Buyindi ayinza kutegeera buzibu buno; ebiseera ebimala okwegayiririra abalala ennyo tebiyinza kufunika.

Singa obuzibu buno bwali mu bbugumu lya Buyindi lyokka, omuntu yandisirise. Naye, zitusanze! mu butiti obusingayo mu London, ne mu mbeera y’obudde ey’ekigero mu South Africa, obuzibu bwe bumu buli wamu. Singa twawulira ddala omulundi gumu nti—okwegayiririra abalala kye kitundu ky’omulimu gwaffe ekisinga obukulu, okufuna okubeerawo kwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge mu bujjuvu kye kintu ekyetaagisa ennyo, guno gwe mulimu gwaffe ogusooka—essaawa zaffe zonna ez’okukola zandifuuliddwa okuba wansi w’ekintu kino ekimu.

Katonda atulage ffenna obanga ddala waliwo obuzibu obutayinza kuvvuunukibwa bwe tutavunaanyizibwako, obanga nsobi bunsobi gye tukola, oba kibi kye tumunakuwaza nakyo era kye tuziyiza nakyo Omwoyo we!

Bwe tubuuza ekibuuzo George Muller kye yabuuza Omukristaayo eyeemulugunya nti yali tasobola kufuna biseera bimala okusoma Ekigambo n’okusaba—obanga essaawa emu ey’omulimu entono, ka tugambe essaawa nnya, nga emmeeme ebeera mu kitangaala kya Katonda ekijjuvu, teyandibadde na buwanguzi na kibala okusinga essaawa ttaano ng’omuntu anyigirizibwa omwoyo olw’okumanya nti si mwesigwa, era ng’afiiriddwa amaanyi agandifunise mu kusaba—okuddamu tekujja kuba kuzibu. Gye tukoma okukirowoozaako, gye tukoma okuwulira nti abakozi abanyiikivu era abatya Katonda bwe bakkiriza, ne bwe kiba nga kikontana n’okwagala kwabwe okusingako obulungi, eby’omwoyo okusindiikirizibwa ebweru olw’emirimu egitakoma n’obukoowu bwe gireeta, kiteekwa okuba nga kiri bwe kityo kubanga obulamu obw’omwoyo tebulina maanyi gamala mu bo okulagira ekyo ekitali kikulu okwesamba okutuusa okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu Kristo n’amaanyi g’Omwoyo lwe binaaba bifuniddwa mu bujjuvu.

Ka tuwulirize Kristo ng’agamba nti, “ebya Kayisaali mubiwenga Kayisaali”—omulimu n’obuvunaanyizibwa bibeere mu kifo kyabyo—“n’ebya Katonda mubiwenga Katonda.” Okusinza mu Mwoyo, okwesigama ku Katonda ddala n’okumulindirira obutayosa olw’okufuna mu bujjuvu okubeerawo kwe n’amaanyi ge buli lunaku, n’amaanyi ga Kristo agakolera mu ffe, bibeerenga bulijjo mu kifo ekisooka. Ensonga yonna eri bweti bwokka: Katonda anaaweebwa ekifo, okwagala, okwesigibwa, n’ebiseera eby’okussa ekimu naye ku bubwe by’asaba, emirimu gyaffe gyonna gibeere Katonda yennyini ng’akolera mu ffe?

EKYONGEREZO B, Essuula 7, olup. 89

Ka mbuulire wano olugero oluli mu kimu ku bitabo bya Dr. Boardman. Yali ayitiddwa omukyala ow’ekitiibwa, eyali amanyiddwa ennyo olw’omulimu gwe ogw’obuwanguzi mu bakozi ba bba, okujja okubayigiriza. “Era oluvannyuma,” bwe yayongerako, “njagala okwogera naawe ku buddu obutono bwe ndimu nze kennyini.” Bwe yamala okwogera mu lukuŋŋaana lwe, n’asanga nga bangi baali baleeteddwa eri Kristo ku bubwe, ne yeebuuza obuzibu bwe bwali ki. Mangu ddala n’amubuulira. Katonda yali awadde omulimu gwe omukisa, naye, zitusanze, essanyu lye yalina edda mu kigambo kya Katonda ne mu kusaba okw’ekyama lyali libuze. Era yali agezezzaako n’amaanyi ge gonna okulizza, naye n’alemererwa. “Ah! eyo y’ensobi yo ddala,” bwe yagamba. “Kitya? Siteekwa kukola kyonna kye nsobola okuggyawo obunnyogovu buno?” “Mbuulira,” bwe yagamba, “walokolebwa lwa kukola kyonna kye wasobola?” “Nedda! Nagezaako ebbanga ddene okukola ekyo, naye nafuna ekiwummulo lwe nalekera awo okugezaako, ne neesiga Kristo.” “Era ekyo kye weetaaga okukola kaakano. Yingira mu kisenge kyo ku kiseera ekyateekebwawo, ne bw’oba ng’owulira ng’omwoyo gwo munafu, weeteeke mu maaso ga Mukama wo. Togezaako kwezuukusaamu bunyiikivu bw’otowulira; naye mugambe mu kasirise nti alaba bwe byonna byonoonese, era nga bw’otalina ky’oyinza, era mwesige akuwe omukisa. Ajja kukikola; bw’onoomwesiga mu kasirise, Omwoyo we ajja kukola.”

Olugero luno olwangu luyinza okuyigiriza Abakristaayo bangi essomo ery’omukisa ennyo mu bulamu obw’okusaba. Wakkiriza Kristo Yesu akuwonye, akuwe amaanyi okutambulira mu bulamu obuggya; wasaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeere mu ggwe Omwoyo ow’Okwegayirira n’Okwegayiririra Abalala; naye teweewuunya obanga enneewulira zo tezikyuka mbagirawo, oba obanga amaanyi go ag’okusaba tegajja mu ngeri gy’oyagala. Buno bulamu bwa kukkiriza. Olw’okukkiriza tufuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’emirimu gye gyonna. Okukkiriza tekutunuulira birabika wadde enneewulira, wabula kuwummulira, ne bwe kiba nga tewali maanyi ga kusaba, mu bukakafu nti Omwoyo asabira mu ffe nga tukutamye mu kasirise mu maaso ga Katonda. Oyo alindirira bw’atyo mu kukkiriza, n’assa ekitiibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n’amwewaayo, mangu ajja kukizuula nti okusaba kutandika okujja. Era oyo agumiikiriza mu kukkiriza nti okuyita mu Kristo era olw’Omwoyo buli kusaba, ne bwe kuba kunafu kutya, kusiimibwa Katonda, ajja kuyiga essomo nti kisoboka okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo, n’okukulemberwa okutambula nga tusiimibwa Mukama era nga tumusanyusa mu buli kimu.

EKYONGEREZO C, Essuula 9, olup. 111

Jjo nate—ennaku ssatu oluvannyuma lw’emboozi eyogerwako mu kyongerezo ku ssuula 7—nasisinkana omukyala omuminsani omuto eyeewaddeyo ennyo, ng’ava mu bitundu eby’omunda. Bwe twali tukyanyumya ku kusaba, n’ayingizaamu, nga tewali amubuuzizza, nti, “Naye ddala tekisoboka kufuna biseera kusaba nga bwe twandyagadde.” Nasobola kuddamu kino kyokka: “Ebiseera kintu ekyekyusa okukwatagana n’okwagala kwaffe; ekyo emitima gyaffe kye gitwala ddala nga kye kisinga obukulu mu lunaku, tetujja kulwa kukifunira biseera.” Kiteekwa ddala okuba nti obuweereza obw’okwegayiririra abalala tebuteekebwangako mu maaso g’abayizi baffe mu matendekero g’eby’eddiini ne mu maka g’okutendekerwamu abaminsani ng’ekitundu ekisinga obukulu eky’omulimu gw’obulamu bwabwe. Tutwalidde omulimu gwaffe ogw’okubuulira oba okukyalira abantu nga gwe mulimu gwaffe ogwa nnamaddala, n’okusaba ng’ekkubo eriri wansi ery’okukola omulimu ogwo obulungi. Embeera yonna teyandikyuse singa twatwala obuweereza obw’okwegayiririra abalala ng’ekintu ekikulu—okufuna omukisa n’amaanyi ga Katonda ku lw’emmeeme ezaatukwasibwa? Awo omulimu gwaffe gwandifunye ekifo kyagwo ekituufu, ne gufuuka omulimu ogw’okubiri ogw’okugabira ddala abalala emikisa gye twafuna okuva eri Katonda. Mukwano gwe eyajja mu ttumbi bwe yamala okufuna okuva eri Omulala byonna bye yali yeetaaga, ng’okusaba kwe kuddiddwamu, n’alyoka asobola okuwa mukwano gwe eyali enjala emuluma. Okwegayirira kwe, okugenda n’okukonkona obutayosa, gwe gwali omulimu omuzibu; okuddayo eka n’ebingi bye yafuna okubigabira abalala gwali mulimu mwangu, ogw’essanyu. Eno y’entegeka ya Kristo ey’obwakatonda mu mulimu gwo gwonna, muganda wange: Sooka ojje, mu bwavu obw’enkomeredde, buli lunaku, ofune okuva eri Katonda omukisa mu kwegayiririra abalala, olyoke ogende n’essanyu okugugabira abalala.

EKYONGEREZO D, Essuula 10, olup. 123

Ka nzizeeyo nate abasomi bange eri William Law, nziremu kye nnayogera edda, nti tewali kitabo kinnyambye nnyo okutegeera ekifo n’omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu nteekateeka y’okununulibwa ng’Obubaka bwe eri Abaweereza b’Ekkanisa.

Engeri gy’annyonnyolamu nti ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekimu kyali kubeera mu muntu, amufuule omugabane ku bulungi bwe n’ekitiibwa kye, si mu ngeri ndala wabula ye yennyini okubeera n’okukolera mu ye, kiwa omuntu ekisumuluzo ky’amakulu ga nnamaddala aga Pentekooti n’okutuma Omwoyo w’Omwana we okubeera mu mitima gyaffe. Ye Kristo, mu linnya lya Katonda, ng’addamu ddala okwefunira n’okwetwalira amaka ge yali yeetondera. Ye Katonda ng’ayingira mu buziba obw’ekyama obw’obutonde bwaffe okukolerayo ekyo ekyawandiikibwa nti “Katonda yakolera mu mmwe, era yabaagazisa n’abasobozesa okukola by’ayagala,” era nti “atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo.” Amazima gano bwe gayingira mu ffe, ne tulaba nti tewali era tewayinza kubaawo kirungi kyonna mu ffe okuggyako ekyo Katonda ky’akola, lwe tulifuna ekitangaala ku kyama kya Katonda eky’okusaba, ne tukkiriza Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’assiza mu ffe okwegomba Katonda kw’alituukiriza bwe tukugondera, ne tukutwala mu maaso ge n’okukkiriza mu linnya lya Kristo. Olwo tulilaba nti ng’okwegayiririra abalala n’okusaba okuva eri Omwana eyafuuka omuntu okugenda eri Kitaffe ali mu ggulu bwe kwewuunyisa era bwe kuwangula, n’okwogerezeganya kwaffe ne Katonda bwe kutyo bwe kuli; Omwoyo, ye Katonda, ng’assiza era ng’asabira mu ffe, wakati mu bunafu bwaffe bwonna, okwegayirira kwe okw’obwakatonda okuzaalibwa mu ggulu: okusaba nga kufuuka kintu kya ggulu nnyo!

Ekitundu eky’enkomerero eky’ekitabo ekyogeddwako waggulu kirimu ebitundu ebiggiddwa mu bbaluwa za Law. Bino bifulumiziddwa byokka mu kitabo ekitono eky’esiringi emu. Tewali n’omu alyewaayo okubisoma mu kasirise n’okutegeera obulungi okuyigiriza kwabyo okwangu ennyo naye okw’obuziba, nga tannanywezebwa nnyo mu bwesige obwetaagisa, bwe tuba ab’okusaba ennyo era n’obuvumu. Bwe tuyiga nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu ffe okubikkulirayo Kristo, atufuule mu bulamu obwa nnamaddala abagabane ku kufa kwe, ku bulamu bwe, ku butuukirivu bwe, ku mpisa ze, Kristo alyoke abumbibwe mu ffe, tujja kutandika okulaba nga bwe kiri ekituufu era ekikakafu mu ngeri ey’obwakatonda nti okwegayiririra abalala kwaffe mu linnya lye kuteekwa okuwulirwa; Omwoyo we yennyini akuuma obumu obulamu naye, mwe tusembezebwa eri Katonda, era atuwa obuvumu okusembera; bye nnayogera mu bunafu bwe butyo mu ssuula ku Mwoyo ow’Okwegayirira bijja kufuna amakulu amaggya; era, ekisingawo, okukola omulimu gw’okusaba kujja kufuna obulungi obupya obusikiriza; ekyama kyakwo eky’obwakatonda ekitiibwa kijja kutuwombeeka, n’enkizo yaakwo etayogerekeka ejja kutusitula mu kukkiriza n’okusinza.

EKYONGEREZO E, Essuula 11, olup. 136

Waliwo ekibuuzo, ekisinga byonna obuziba, kye sinnayingiramu mu kitabo kino. Njogedde ku bbula ly’okusaba mu Mukristaayo kinnoomu ng’akabonero k’endwadde. Naye tunaagamba ki ku kino, nti okulemererwa kuno okuwaayo ebiseera n’amaanyi ebisaanidde eri okusaba kubunye nnyo bwe kutyo? Tetwetaaga kwebuuza nti, Kiva ku ki Ekkanisa ya Kristo, eyambazibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, obutasobola kutendeka basumba baayo n’abakozi baayo n’abakkiriza baayo okukulembeza ekisooka? Kiva ku ki okwatula nti tusaba kitono, n’okukoowoola okusaba okusingawo, okuwulirwa emirundi mingi bwe kutyo, naye ate obubi ne bugenda mu maaso? Omwoyo wa Katonda, Omwoyo ow’Okwegayirira n’Okwegayiririra Abalala, ali mu Kkanisa ne mu buli mukkiriza. Mazima ddala wateekwa okubaawo omwoyo omulala ow’amaanyi amangi oguziyiza era ogulemesa Omwoyo wa Katonda ono. Bwe kiri ddala. Omwoyo gw’ensi, ogwo wansi w’emirimu gyagwo gyonna emirungi era n’egy’eddiini gwe mwoyo gwa katonda w’emirembe gino, kye kiziyiza ekinene. Buli kintu ekikolebwa ku nsi, ka kibe munda oba ebweru w’Ekkanisa, kikolebwa emu ku myoyo gino ebiri. Ekyo omubiri kye guli mu muntu kinnoomu, gwe mwoyo gw’ensi mu bantu bonna awamu; era amaanyi gonna omubiri ge gulina mu muntu kinnoomu gava ku kifo omwoyo gw’ensi kye guweebwa mu Kkanisa ne mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo. Omwoyo gw’ensi gwe guziyiza ennyo omwoyo gw’okusaba. Okukoowoola kwaffe kwonna okusinga obunyiikivu abantu basabe nnyo kujja kuba kwa bwereere okuggyako ng’obubi buno bukkirizibwa, ne bulwanyisibwa, ne buwangulwa. Omukkiriza n’Ekkanisa bateekwa okusumululwa ddala okuva mu mwoyo gw’ensi.

Kale kino kinaakolebwa kitya? Waliwo ekkubo limu lyokka—Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, “olw’omusaalaba ogwo,” nga Pawulo bw’agamba, “nkomereddwa eri ensi, n’ensi ekomereddwa eri nze.” Okuyita mu kufa eri ensi kwokka mwe tuyinza okusumululwa okuva mu mwoyo gwayo. Okwawukana kuteekwa okuba okw’obulamu era okujjuvu. Okuyita mu kukkiriza kwokka nti twakomererwa wamu ne Kristo mwe tuyinza okutambuza obulamu bwaffe nga bwe twatula, era, ng’abaakomererwa eri ensi, okunywerera mu mbeera ey’obulabe obutayinza kutabaganyizibwa n’ekintu kyonna eky’omwoyo gwayo ekitali kya Mwoyo wa Katonda; era Katonda yekka ye ayinza, olw’amaanyi ge ag’obwakatonda, okutuyingiza mu mbeera eyo n’okutukuuma buli lunaku nga tuli abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Omusaalaba, n’ensonyi zaagwo n’okwawula kwagwo okuva ku nsi, n’okufa kwagwo eri byonna eby’omubiri n’eby’okwerowoozaako, ge maanyi gokka agayinza okuwangula omwoyo gw’ensi.

Mpulidde nnyo nti amazima gano geetaaga okulangirirwa obuggya, ne kiba nti nsuubira, Katonda bw’alisiima, okufulumya ekitabo, Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, nga kirimu okunoonyereza ku Kigambo kya Katonda kye kiyigiriza ku kugabana kwaffe okwa nnamaddala ne Kristo mu kukomererwa kwe. Kristo yasaba ng’ali mu kkubo erigenda ku musaalaba. Yasaba okutuusa lwe yatuuka ku musaalaba. Yasaba ng’ali ku musaalaba. Asaba bulijjo ng’ekibala ky’omusaalaba. Ng’Ekkanisa bw’ebeera ku musaalaba, n’omusaalaba ne gubeera mu Kkanisa, omwoyo gw’okusaba gujja kuweebwa. Mu Kristo, omwoyo gw’okukomererwa n’okufa kwe bye byali ensibuko y’Omwoyo n’Amaanyi ag’Okwegayiririra Abalala. Naffe tekiyinza kuba kirala.

EKYONGEREZO F, Essuula 14, olup. 177

Nnayogedde emirundi egisukka mu gumu ku bwetaavu bw’okutendeka Abakristaayo mu mulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala. Mu kyongerezo ekyasooka nnabuuzizza obanga, mu kuyigiriza kw’amatendekero gaffe ag’eby’eddiini ne mu maka g’okutendekerwamu abaminsani, okusaba kufiibwako ekimala ng’ekitundu ekisinga obukulu, era mu ngeri ezimu ekisinga obuzibu, eky’omulimu abayizi gwe bategekerwa. Neebuuzizza obanga tekyandisobose okuwa abo abayagala, mu bulamu bwabwe obw’obuyizi, okwewaayo okuyita mu ntendeka, obuyambi mu ngeri y’amagezi n’ebiteeso ku kyetaagisa okuwa okusaba ekifo n’amaanyi bye kusaanidde okuba nabyo mu buweereza bwaffe.

Ebiseera ebisinga, mu bulamu bw’obuyizi empisa mwe ziteekwa okubumbibwa olw’emyaka egijja, era mu nsi y’abayizi ey’ennaku zino Ekkanisa ey’omu maaso mw’eteekwa okukwatibwako. Katonda bw’anandeka okutuukiriza enteekateeka etannaggwa bulungi, nandyagadde okufulumya ekitabo, Ekitabo ky’Okusaba eky’Omuyizi, ekigatta okuyigiriza kw’Ebyawandiikibwa ku kyetaagisa ennyo okutufuula abantu ab’okusaba, n’obulagirizi obw’omugaso obuyinza okuyamba Omukristaayo omuto, eyeeteekateeka okuwaayo obulamu bwe mu buweereza bwa Katonda n’obuwanguzi, okukuza omwoyo n’empisa ey’okusaba ebinaabeeranga naye mu bulamu bwe bwonna obujja ne mu mirimu gye.
fields.body_text: EKYONGEREZO A, Essuula 6, olup. 73 Leero lwennyini mbadde nsisinkanye omukyala omuminsani anyiikivu ennyo okuva e Buyindi. Akkiriza era akungubagira obutasaba kimala. Naye—e Buyindi waakiri—kizibu okuba nga kiri bulala. Olina essaawa za ku makya zokka, okuva ku ssaawa kumi na bbiri okutuuka ku ssaawa ttaano, okukola omulimu gwo. Abamu bagezezzaako okugolokoka ku ssaawa kumi, bafune ebiseera bye balowooza nti beetaaga, ne babonaabona, ne kibeetaagisa okukireka. Abamu bagezezzaako okufuna ebiseera oluvannyuma lw’ekyemisana, ne basangibwa nga beebase nga bafukamidde. Toli mukama wa bulamu bwo, era olina okukola wamu n’abalala. Tewali n’omu atabangako mu Buyindi ayinza kutegeera buzibu buno; ebiseera ebimala okwegayiririra abalala ennyo tebiyinza kufunika. Singa obuzibu buno bwali mu bbugumu lya Buyindi lyokka, omuntu yandisirise. Naye, zitusanze! mu butiti obusingayo mu London, ne mu mbeera y’obudde ey’ekigero mu South Africa, obuzibu bwe bumu buli wamu. Singa twawulira ddala omulundi gumu nti—okwegayiririra abalala kye kitundu ky’omulimu gwaffe ekisinga obukulu, okufuna okubeerawo kwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge mu bujjuvu kye kintu ekyetaagisa ennyo, guno gwe mulimu gwaffe ogusooka—essaawa zaffe zonna ez’okukola zandifuuliddwa okuba wansi w’ekintu kino ekimu. Katonda atulage ffenna obanga ddala waliwo obuzibu obutayinza kuvvuunukibwa bwe tutavunaanyizibwako, obanga nsobi bunsobi gye tukola, oba kibi kye tumunakuwaza nakyo era kye tuziyiza nakyo Omwoyo we! Bwe tubuuza ekibuuzo George Muller kye yabuuza Omukristaayo eyeemulugunya nti yali tasobola kufuna biseera bimala okusoma Ekigambo n’okusaba—obanga essaawa emu ey’omulimu entono, ka tugambe essaawa nnya, nga emmeeme ebeera mu kitangaala kya Katonda ekijjuvu, teyandibadde na buwanguzi na kibala okusinga essaawa ttaano ng’omuntu anyigirizibwa omwoyo olw’okumanya nti si mwesigwa, era ng’afiiriddwa amaanyi agandifunise mu kusaba—okuddamu tekujja kuba kuzibu. Gye tukoma okukirowoozaako, gye tukoma okuwulira nti abakozi abanyiikivu era abatya Katonda bwe bakkiriza, ne bwe kiba nga kikontana n’okwagala kwabwe okusingako obulungi, eby’omwoyo okusindiikirizibwa ebweru olw’emirimu egitakoma n’obukoowu bwe gireeta, kiteekwa okuba nga kiri bwe kityo kubanga obulamu obw’omwoyo tebulina maanyi gamala mu bo okulagira ekyo ekitali kikulu okwesamba okutuusa okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu Kristo n’amaanyi g’Omwoyo lwe binaaba bifuniddwa mu bujjuvu. Ka tuwulirize Kristo ng’agamba nti, “ebya Kayisaali mubiwenga Kayisaali”—omulimu n’obuvunaanyizibwa bibeere mu kifo kyabyo—“n’ebya Katonda mubiwenga Katonda.” Okusinza mu Mwoyo, okwesigama ku Katonda ddala n’okumulindirira obutayosa olw’okufuna mu bujjuvu okubeerawo kwe n’amaanyi ge buli lunaku, n’amaanyi ga Kristo agakolera mu ffe, bibeerenga bulijjo mu kifo ekisooka. Ensonga yonna eri bweti bwokka: Katonda anaaweebwa ekifo, okwagala, okwesigibwa, n’ebiseera eby’okussa ekimu naye ku bubwe by’asaba, emirimu gyaffe gyonna gibeere Katonda yennyini ng’akolera mu ffe? EKYONGEREZO B, Essuula 7, olup. 89 Ka mbuulire wano olugero oluli mu kimu ku bitabo bya Dr. Boardman. Yali ayitiddwa omukyala ow’ekitiibwa, eyali amanyiddwa ennyo olw’omulimu gwe ogw’obuwanguzi mu bakozi ba bba, okujja okubayigiriza. “Era oluvannyuma,” bwe yayongerako, “njagala okwogera naawe ku buddu obutono bwe ndimu nze kennyini.” Bwe yamala okwogera mu lukuŋŋaana lwe, n’asanga nga bangi baali baleeteddwa eri Kristo ku bubwe, ne yeebuuza obuzibu bwe bwali ki. Mangu ddala n’amubuulira. Katonda yali awadde omulimu gwe omukisa, naye, zitusanze, essanyu lye yalina edda mu kigambo kya Katonda ne mu kusaba okw’ekyama lyali libuze. Era yali agezezzaako n’amaanyi ge gonna okulizza, naye n’alemererwa. “Ah! eyo y’ensobi yo ddala,” bwe yagamba. “Kitya? Siteekwa kukola kyonna kye nsobola okuggyawo obunnyogovu buno?” “Mbuulira,” bwe yagamba, “walokolebwa lwa kukola kyonna kye wasobola?” “Nedda! Nagezaako ebbanga ddene okukola ekyo, naye nafuna ekiwummulo lwe nalekera awo okugezaako, ne neesiga Kristo.” “Era ekyo kye weetaaga okukola kaakano. Yingira mu kisenge kyo ku kiseera ekyateekebwawo, ne bw’oba ng’owulira ng’omwoyo gwo munafu, weeteeke mu maaso ga Mukama wo. Togezaako kwezuukusaamu bunyiikivu bw’otowulira; naye mugambe mu kasirise nti alaba bwe byonna byonoonese, era nga bw’otalina ky’oyinza, era mwesige akuwe omukisa. Ajja kukikola; bw’onoomwesiga mu kasirise, Omwoyo we ajja kukola.” Olugero luno olwangu luyinza okuyigiriza Abakristaayo bangi essomo ery’omukisa ennyo mu bulamu obw’okusaba. Wakkiriza Kristo Yesu akuwonye, akuwe amaanyi okutambulira mu bulamu obuggya; wasaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeere mu ggwe Omwoyo ow’Okwegayirira n’Okwegayiririra Abalala; naye teweewuunya obanga enneewulira zo tezikyuka mbagirawo, oba obanga amaanyi go ag’okusaba tegajja mu ngeri gy’oyagala. Buno bulamu bwa kukkiriza. Olw’okukkiriza tufuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’emirimu gye gyonna. Okukkiriza tekutunuulira birabika wadde enneewulira, wabula kuwummulira, ne bwe kiba nga tewali maanyi ga kusaba, mu bukakafu nti Omwoyo asabira mu ffe nga tukutamye mu kasirise mu maaso ga Katonda. Oyo alindirira bw’atyo mu kukkiriza, n’assa ekitiibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n’amwewaayo, mangu ajja kukizuula nti okusaba kutandika okujja. Era oyo agumiikiriza mu kukkiriza nti okuyita mu Kristo era olw’Omwoyo buli kusaba, ne bwe kuba kunafu kutya, kusiimibwa Katonda, ajja kuyiga essomo nti kisoboka okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo, n’okukulemberwa okutambula nga tusiimibwa Mukama era nga tumusanyusa mu buli kimu. Ye Katonda ng’ayingira mu buziba obw’ekyama obw’obutonde bwaffe okukolerayo ekyo ekyawandiikibwa nti “Katonda yakolera mu mmwe, era yabaagazisa n’abasobozesa okukola by’ayagala,” era nti “atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo.” Amazima gano bwe gayingira mu ffe, ne tulaba nti tewali era tewayinza kubaawo kirungi kyonna mu ffe okuggyako ekyo Katonda ky’akola, lwe tulifuna ekitangaala ku kyama kya Katonda eky’okusaba, ne tukkiriza Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’assiza mu ffe okwegomba Katonda kw’alituukiriza bwe tukugondera, ne tukutwala mu maaso ge n’okukkiriza mu linnya lya Kristo. Olwo tulilaba nti ng’okwegayiririra abalala n’okusaba okuva eri Omwana eyafuuka omuntu okugenda eri Kitaffe ali mu ggulu bwe kwewuunyisa era bwe kuwangula, n’okwogerezeganya kwaffe ne Katonda bwe kutyo bwe kuli; Omwoyo, ye Katonda, ng’assiza era ng’asabira mu ffe, wakati mu bunafu bwaffe bwonna, okwegayirira kwe okw’obwakatonda okuzaalibwa mu ggulu: okusaba nga kufuuka kintu kya ggulu nnyo! Ekitundu eky’enkomerero eky’ekitabo ekyogeddwako waggulu kirimu ebitundu ebiggiddwa mu bbaluwa za Law. Bino bifulumiziddwa byokka mu kitabo ekitono eky’esiringi emu. Tewali n’omu alyewaayo okubisoma mu kasirise n’okutegeera obulungi okuyigiriza kwabyo okwangu ennyo naye okw’obuziba, nga tannanywezebwa nnyo mu bwesige obwetaagisa, bwe tuba ab’okusaba ennyo era n’obuvumu. Bwe tuyiga nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu ffe okubikkulirayo Kristo, atufuule mu bulamu obwa nnamaddala abagabane ku kufa kwe, ku bulamu bwe, ku butuukirivu bwe, ku mpisa ze, Kristo alyoke abumbibwe mu ffe, tujja kutandika okulaba nga bwe kiri ekituufu era ekikakafu mu ngeri ey’obwakatonda nti okwegayiririra abalala kwaffe mu linnya lye kuteekwa okuwulirwa; Omwoyo we yennyini akuuma obumu obulamu naye, mwe tusembezebwa eri Katonda, era atuwa obuvumu okusembera; bye nnayogera mu bunafu bwe butyo mu ssuula ku Mwoyo ow’Okwegayirira bijja kufuna amakulu amaggya; era, ekisingawo, okukola omulimu gw’okusaba kujja kufuna obulungi obupya obusikiriza; ekyama kyakwo eky’obwakatonda ekitiibwa kijja kutuwombeeka, n’enkizo yaakwo etayogerekeka ejja kutusitula mu kukkiriza n’okusinza. EKYONGEREZO E, Essuula 11, olup. 136 Waliwo ekibuuzo, ekisinga byonna obuziba, kye sinnayingiramu mu kitabo kino. Njogedde ku bbula ly’okusaba mu Mukristaayo kinnoomu ng’akabonero k’endwadde. Naye tunaagamba ki ku kino, nti okulemererwa kuno okuwaayo ebiseera n’amaanyi ebisaanidde eri okusaba kubunye nnyo bwe kutyo? Tetwetaaga kwebuuza nti, Kiva ku ki Ekkanisa ya Kristo, eyambazibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, obutasobola kutendeka basumba baayo n’abakozi baayo n’abakkiriza baayo okukulembeza ekisooka? Kiva ku ki okwatula nti tusaba kitono, n’okukoowoola okusaba okusingawo, okuwulirwa emirundi mingi bwe kutyo, naye ate obubi ne bugenda mu maaso? Omwoyo wa Katonda, Omwoyo ow’Okwegayirira n’Okwegayiririra Abalala, ali mu Kkanisa ne mu buli mukkiriza. Mazima ddala wateekwa okubaawo omwoyo omulala ow’amaanyi amangi oguziyiza era ogulemesa Omwoyo wa Katonda ono. Bwe kiri ddala. Omwoyo gw’ensi, ogwo wansi w’emirimu gyagwo gyonna emirungi era n’egy’eddiini gwe mwoyo gwa katonda w’emirembe gino, kye kiziyiza ekinene. Buli kintu ekikolebwa ku nsi, ka kibe munda oba ebweru w’Ekkanisa, kikolebwa emu ku myoyo gino ebiri. Ekyo omubiri kye guli mu muntu kinnoomu, gwe mwoyo gw’ensi mu bantu bonna awamu; era amaanyi gonna omubiri ge gulina mu muntu kinnoomu gava ku kifo omwoyo gw’ensi kye guweebwa mu Kkanisa ne mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo. Omwoyo gw’ensi gwe guziyiza ennyo omwoyo gw’okusaba. Okukoowoola kwaffe kwonna okusinga obunyiikivu abantu basabe nnyo kujja kuba kwa bwereere okuggyako ng’obubi buno bukkirizibwa, ne bulwanyisibwa, ne buwangulwa. Omukkiriza n’Ekkanisa bateekwa okusumululwa ddala okuva mu mwoyo gw’ensi. Kale kino kinaakolebwa kitya? Waliwo ekkubo limu lyokka—Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, “olw’omusaalaba ogwo,” nga Pawulo bw’agamba, “nkomereddwa eri ensi, n’ensi ekomereddwa eri nze.” Okuyita mu kufa eri ensi kwokka mwe tuyinza okusumululwa okuva mu mwoyo gwayo. Okwawukana kuteekwa okuba okw’obulamu era okujjuvu. Okuyita mu kukkiriza kwokka nti twakomererwa wamu ne Kristo mwe tuyinza okutambuza obulamu bwaffe nga bwe twatula, era, ng’abaakomererwa eri ensi, okunywerera mu mbeera ey’obulabe obutayinza kutabaganyizibwa n’ekintu kyonna eky’omwoyo gwayo ekitali kya Mwoyo wa Katonda; era Katonda yekka ye ayinza, olw’amaanyi ge ag’obwakatonda, okutuyingiza mu mbeera eyo n’okutukuuma buli lunaku nga tuli abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Omusaalaba, n’ensonyi zaagwo n’okwawula kwagwo okuva ku nsi, n’okufa kwagwo eri byonna eby’omubiri n’eby’okwerowoozaako, ge maanyi gokka agayinza okuwangula omwoyo gw’ensi. Mpulidde nnyo nti amazima gano geetaaga okulangirirwa obuggya, ne kiba nti nsuubira, Katonda bw’alisiima, okufulumya ekitabo, Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, nga kirimu okunoonyereza ku Kigambo kya Katonda kye kiyigiriza ku kugabana kwaffe okwa nnamaddala ne Kristo mu kukomererwa kwe. Kristo yasaba ng’ali mu kkubo erigenda ku musaalaba. Yasaba okutuusa lwe yatuuka ku musaalaba. Yasaba ng’ali ku musaalaba. Asaba bulijjo ng’ekibala ky’omusaalaba. Ng’Ekkanisa bw’ebeera ku musaalaba, n’omusaalaba ne gubeera mu Kkanisa, omwoyo gw’okusaba gujja kuweebwa. Mu Kristo, omwoyo gw’okukomererwa n’okufa kwe bye byali ensibuko y’Omwoyo n’Amaanyi ag’Okwegayiririra Abalala. Naffe tekiyinza kuba kirala. EKYONGEREZO F, Essuula 14, olup. 177 Nnayogedde emirundi egisukka mu gumu ku bwetaavu bw’okutendeka Abakristaayo mu mulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala. Mu kyongerezo ekyasooka nnabuuzizza obanga, mu kuyigiriza kw’amatendekero gaffe ag’eby’eddiini ne mu maka g’okutendekerwamu abaminsani, okusaba kufiibwako ekimala ng’ekitundu ekisinga obukulu, era mu ngeri ezimu ekisinga obuzibu, eky’omulimu abayizi gwe bategekerwa. Neebuuzizza obanga tekyandisobose okuwa abo abayagala, mu bulamu bwabwe obw’obuyizi, okwewaayo okuyita mu ntendeka, obuyambi mu ngeri y’amagezi n’ebiteeso ku kyetaagisa okuwa okusaba ekifo n’amaanyi bye kusaanidde okuba nabyo mu buweereza bwaffe. Ebiseera ebisinga, mu bulamu bw’obuyizi empisa mwe ziteekwa okubumbibwa olw’emyaka egijja, era mu nsi y’abayizi ey’ennaku zino Ekkanisa ey’omu maaso mw’eteekwa okukwatibwako. Katonda bw’anandeka okutuukiriza enteekateeka etannaggwa bulungi, nandyagadde okufulumya ekitabo, Ekitabo ky’Okusaba eky’Omuyizi, ekigatta okuyigiriza kw’Ebyawandiikibwa ku kyetaagisa ennyo okutufuula abantu ab’okusaba, n’obulagirizi obw’omugaso obuyinza okuyamba Omukristaayo omuto, eyeeteekateeka okuwaayo obulamu bwe mu buweereza bwa Katonda n’obuwanguzi, okukuza omwoyo n’empisa ey’okusaba ebinaabeeranga naye mu bulamu bwe bwonna obujja ne mu mirimu gye.
